  • Maintain accountability for the scientific quality, accuracy, and strategic integrity of client deliverables across the portfolio.
  • Oversee complex and high-impact initiatives, including product launches, advisory boards, speaker development programs, congress activities, publications, medical education, and strategic planning engagements.
  • Partner with cross-functional leaders across account management, engagement strategy, project management, editorial, and creative teams to ensure seamless execution and successful delivery of client programs.
  • Drive operational excellence by identifying risks, removing barriers, and ensuring effective allocation of scientific resources across projects and accounts.
  • Contribute to business growth through strategic planning, proposal development, client relationship expansion, and new business opportunities.
  • Provide leadership during project challenges, stepping in as needed to guide teams and ensure successful outcomes.
  • Support talent acquisition, onboarding, succession planning, and workforce development initiatives.
  • Represent ENOVA and IQVIA at key client meetings, advisory boards, congresses, and other external engagements.

Qualifications:

Required

  • PhD, PharmD, MD, or equivalent advanced scientific degree.
  • 7+ years of experience in medical affairs, medical communications, the pharmaceutical industry, or a related healthcare environment.
  • Proven success leading and developing scientific teams within a fast-paced, client-focused organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to oversee multiple complex projects and scientific portfolios while maintaining exceptional quality standards.
  • Strong client management and stakeholder engagement experience.
  • Experience leading and influencing cross-functional teams and driving alignment among diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong business acumen, including resource planning, operational effectiveness, and organizational growth.
  • Exceptional communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.

jobs.title: Field Engineer
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT FLOVISIONFloVision is a remote-first startup focused on improving the food supply chain, starting with protein processing.
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLOVISION

FloVision is a remote-first startup focused on improving the food supply chain, starting with protein processing. We design computer vision and machine learning-assisted production processes that reduce food waste, improve quality assurance, and help customers operate more efficiently. Our mission is to reduce global CO₂ emissions by 1% by minimizing food waste.

FloVision is a U.S.-based Series A startup with a distributed team across the United States, United Kingdom, and Ireland.

POSITION OVERVIEW

As a Field Engineer at FloVision, you will install, maintain, troubleshoot, design, and improve the hardware systems that power our computer vision products. Field service and installations are the primary focus of this role, with opportunities to contribute to product design, manufacturing, and R&D.

This is a hands-on position for an engineer who can identify a problem in the field, develop a practical solution, and implement it with limited oversight. You will work directly with customers, internal engineering teams, vendors, and fabricators to ensure our equipment is installed successfully and continues operating reliably.

We are looking for a self-driven, inquisitive individual who genuinely enjoys field work, frequent travel, and the variety of an early-stage startup. The right person will be comfortable moving between customer sites, hands-on hardware work, and focused design projects as business priorities evolve. You'll play a vital role in shaping the continuous improvement of our products, services, and internal processes.

LOCATION & TRAVEL

⁠This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States. Proximity to a major international airport is strongly preferred. This role requires approximately 75% domestic travel, with occasional international travel.

Travel may include:

  • Customer-site installations, repairs, and maintenance
  • Pre-installation engineering and site-scoping visits
  • Multi-day or weekend installation work
  • Team meetups and collaborative work sessions

Candidates must be comfortable working in active food-production environments, which may include exposure to cold temperatures, loud noise, blood and animal byproducts, wet conditions, or physical demands.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Travel to domestic and international customer sites to scope, install, commission, maintain, and troubleshoot equipment, leading installations from site preparation through post-installation validation
  • Perform on-site mechanical and electrical maintenance, emergency repairs, modifications, and fault-finding, both independently and with remote support teams
  • Build strong customer relationships and represent FloVision with professionalism, responsiveness, and sound judgment, making sure work aligns with customer needs and company procedures
  • Turn recurring field problems into practical, scalable hardware improvements, and partner with the hardware team on product improvements, new designs, prototypes, and R&D when not traveling
  • Create and modify mechanical and full-system designs using SolidWorks or comparable 3D modeling and CAD software
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, including site findings, service records, maintenance procedures, bills of materials, fabrication drawings, assembly instructions, schematics, and wiring diagrams
  • Coordinate with engineering teams, vendors, and fabricators to prepare equipment for installations and repairs, and support external manufacturing, component sourcing, hardware inventory, and product-line ownership as needs evolve
  • Identify and implement internal process improvements, using AI and other digital tools to work more efficiently across design, troubleshooting, and documentation
  • Uphold Quality, Health, Safety, and Environment standards in the field and workspaces, keeping tools, equipment, parts, and workspaces safe, clean, and organized

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Automation Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • At least four years of experience in automation, controls, field engineering, or a related industrial environment
  • Hands-on mechanical and electrical skills, including installing, commissioning, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing equipment, and confidence with common tools such as multimeters, hand tools, and power tools
  • Experience programming and troubleshooting PLC and HMI systems
  • Proficiency with SolidWorks or equivalent CAD software, and experience creating and working from drawings, bills of materials, schematics, wiring diagrams, and assembly instructions
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to identify a field issue, design a practical fix, and implement it with limited oversight
  • Strong computer literacy and willingness to learn and use AI-enabled tools
  • Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to represent FloVision professionally, stay calm under pressure, work clearly with customers, remote engineers, and cross-functional teams, and keep progress, risks, and blockers visible while managing changing priorities
  • Genuine enthusiasm for field work, the ability to travel approximately 75% (including international and occasional weekend travel), and a valid driver's license and passport, or the ability to obtain one

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience designing equipment for food-production, washdown, or hygienic environments, including stainless-steel equipment and fabrication
  • Experience with industrial automation, controls, sensors, cameras, or computer vision systems, including creating electrical schematics or designing control panels
  • Experience leading complex equipment installations, including international field service
  • Experience owning a hardware product from concept and prototyping through testing, manufacturing, and field support
  • Experience managing vendors, fabricators, or external manufacturing partners, and familiarity with component sourcing and hardware inventory management
  • A jack-of-all-trades mindset, with the curiosity to keep learning and grow your skills beyond your area of expertise
  • A natural sleuth who enjoys digging into problems, uncovering root causes, and choosing the best course of action with the customer's needs in mind

INTERVIEW PROCESS OVERVIEW

Throughout the process, you'll have multiple opportunities to showcase your skills and experience, and we will aim to keep communication transparent and timely as we move through each step.

Stage 1: Application & Intro Video - As part of your application, please submit a short 1–2 minute video introducing yourself and sharing why you’re excited about this role at FloVision. This helps us get to know you beyond your resume and understand what draws you to our mission. Your video doesn’t need to be polished - a simple phone recording is perfect. Applications without a video will not be considered.Stage 2: Behavioral Interview (via Google Meets)
Stage 3: Technical Interview (via Google Meets)
Stage 4: Final Interview (via Google Meets)
Stage 5: Job Offer - Upon successful completion of all interview stages, selected candidates will receive a formal job offer.

COMPENSATION

Compensation for this role is designed to be competitive while reflecting the needs of an early-stage, high-growth startup. Starting base salary will be determined based on experience, skills, and demonstrated ability to make an immediate impact. We anticipate a total target compensation range of approximately $85-110K inclusive of any performance-based bonus opportunities.

BENEFITS

Home Office Stipend

Medical Insurance

Dental Insurance
Vision Insurance
401(k) Plan

Health Savings Account (HSA)

WHY JOIN US?
Impactful Work - Contribute to meaningful projects that directly affect sustainability and the global food industry. Your voice impacts decisions on day one.
Collaborative Environment - Work closely with a dedicated team of professionals passionate about making a difference.
Growth Opportunities - Expand your skill set by tackling diverse challenges.
Flexible Work Arrangements - Enjoy the flexibility of a remote position with opportunities for in-person collaboration. Flexible work hours allow you to plan work around your life, not the other way around.

At FloVision, we believe innovation stems from diverse perspectives. Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.

U.S. Remote Pay Range
$85,000—$110,000 USD

The Hawaiian Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Hawaiianand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**

Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inHawaiianand English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.

  • High school diploma or equivalent.

  • Ability to read and write the requested languages - highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**

Technical Requirements:

jobs.description:
Job Title: Medical Liaison & Operations Coordinator (Radiology)

Position type: Full-Time

Work hours:

  • Shift 1: 8:00 AM–5:00 PM ET, including a 1-hour unpaid lunch
  • Shift 2: 4:00 PM–1:00 AM ET, including a 1-hour unpaid lunch

Work days: Monday to Friday

Salary: $5 - $7 per hour, depending on experience

Workplace: Remote

Preferred Candidate Location: Philippines

DESCRIPTION

Our client is a U.S.-based teleradiology practice that works closely with radiologists, clinics, hospital systems, and healthcare teams to support efficient medical imaging services and communication.

We are seeking a highly organized and dependable Medical Liaison and Operations Coordinator to serve as a central point of communication across the practice. This is a phone- and coordination-focused position that combines inbound call management, radiologist support, communication triage, and administrative assistance.

You will be responsible for answering incoming calls, determining what each caller needs, and efficiently connecting or routing them to the appropriate sales, recruitment, support, medical, or technical contact. You will also serve as an important liaison for radiologists, helping relay requests and coordinate communication between doctors, clinics, clients, and internal teams.

The ideal candidate has previous healthcare experience, excellent English communication skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to remain calm and organized while managing multiple requests and stakeholders.

If you're a dependable healthcare professional who enjoys solving problems, connecting people, and keeping operations moving smoothly behind the scenes, this could be an excellent long-term opportunity.

Key Responsibilities

Inbound Call Handling & Triage

  • Answer and manage inbound company calls professionally and efficiently
  • Identify the purpose and urgency of incoming calls
  • Triage calls into the appropriate pipeline, including sales, recruitment, support, or medical/operational needs
  • Connect callers with the appropriate department, team member, or radiologist
  • Take accurate messages and ensure information reaches the correct person
  • Maintain a professional and helpful experience for all callers
  • Handle multiple incoming requests while prioritizing appropriately
  • Follow established communication and escalation procedures

Radiologist Support & Medical Liaison

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for radiologists when they need assistance from other members of the team
  • Act as an intermediary between radiologists, clinics, hospital systems, technical teams, and internal departments
  • Handle and coordinate phone calls on behalf of radiologists when they are unavailable or occupied
  • Receive requests from radiologists and connect them with the appropriate team or resource
  • Receive calls from clients or clinics that require assistance from a radiologist and coordinate the appropriate next step
  • Relay messages, requests, and information accurately between multiple parties
  • Help doctors quickly connect with the information, department, or individual they need
  • Escalate urgent or complex concerns according to established procedures
  • Maintain professionalism and confidentiality when handling healthcare-related communications

Administrative & Operations Support

  • Provide general administrative support across sales, recruitment, support, medical, and operational departments
  • Assist with communication coordination and follow-up between departments
  • Help organize and manage requests that require involvement from multiple teams
  • Perform administrative tasks that support the day-to-day operation of the practice
  • Help reduce the administrative workload of the Operations Manager
  • Take ownership of routine coordination and administrative responsibilities so leadership can focus on higher-level operational priorities
  • Support additional administrative and coordination needs as assigned
  • Maintain organized and accurate records of relevant calls, messages, and follow-up actions

Top 3 Priorities

1. Inbound Call Handling & Triage
Professionally manage incoming calls, quickly understand what each caller needs, and accurately route requests to the appropriate sales, recruitment, support, medical, or operational pipeline.

2. Medical Liaison & Radiologist Support
Serve as a reliable communication link between radiologists, clinics, hospital systems, technical teams, and internal departments. Ensure requests and important information are communicated accurately and efficiently.

3. Administrative Support & Operational Relief
Take ownership of routine administrative and coordination responsibilities to reduce the Operations Manager's workload and allow leadership to focus on larger operational priorities.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this position means becoming a dependable communication and coordination hub for the practice.

Performance may be measured through:

  • Effective and professional handling of inbound calls
  • Accurate triaging and routing of calls
  • Accurate relay of information between radiologists and departments
  • Timely coordination and follow-up on requests
  • Productivity and active versus idle time
  • Professional communication across internal and external teams
  • Effective support of radiologists, clinics, and other stakeholders
  • Reduction of routine administrative responsibilities handled by the Operations Manager
  • Reliability, responsiveness, and consistent availability during the assigned shift

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • Previous experience working in a healthcare or medical environment
  • Strong understanding of healthcare terminology and workflows
  • Ability to communicate effectively with medical professionals and healthcare organizations
  • Excellent inbound phone handling and customer service skills
  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills
  • Ability to listen carefully, understand the purpose of a call, and determine the appropriate next step
  • Ability to accurately relay messages and information between multiple parties
  • Comfortable communicating with radiologists, clinics, hospital systems, technical teams, clients, and internal departments
  • Strong organizational and coordination skills
  • Ability to manage multiple calls, requests, and priorities simultaneously
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to remain calm and professional in a fast-paced healthcare environment
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to appropriately escalate issues
  • General administrative support experience
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with multiple departments
  • Dependable, motivated, and committed to providing consistent, high-quality support
  • Strong interest in a stable, long-term remote opportunity

Healthcare & HIPAA Requirements

  • Familiarity with healthcare terminology and operational workflows
  • Understanding of the importance of HIPAA compliance and patient confidentiality
  • Ability to handle sensitive healthcare information professionally and securely
  • Willingness to complete required HIPAA and cybersecurity training
  • Previous exposure to radiology or teleradiology operations is strongly preferred
  • Ability to understand and appropriately coordinate requests involving medical professionals without independently providing clinical guidance

Systems & Tools

The role will work with:

  • Grasshopper – VoIP/phone system
  • Data Health – Healthcare/EHR-related platform; prior experience is not required
  • Slack – Internal team communication
  • Microsoft Office – Administrative and productivity tasks

Prior experience with Grasshopper is beneficial, but candidates should at minimum be comfortable learning and working with cloud-based VoIP and communication systems.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We're looking for someone who is:

  • Professional and confident on the phone
  • Clear and articulate in English
  • Highly dependable and responsive
  • Organized and detail-oriented
  • Comfortable interacting with physicians and healthcare professionals
  • Able to communicate with multiple stakeholders without losing important details
  • Proactive about following up and resolving requests
  • Capable of determining where a request should be routed or escalated
  • Comfortable learning new healthcare systems and workflows
  • Motivated to become a reliable, long-term member of the team
  • Able to maintain focus and dedication throughout the assigned working hours

Basic Requirements

  • Must be proficient in speaking and writing clear, professional English
  • Must have relevant healthcare, medical, administrative, call handling, or coordination experience
  • Must be able to submit an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory)
  • Must be available for video meetings with camera on when required
  • Must be available to consistently work the assigned full-time shift
  • Must maintain appropriate confidentiality and HIPAA-compliant work practices

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

Performance Drone Works (PDW) is building the next generation of tactical robotic systems used across defense, national security, and public safety missions. We are building a new center of engineering excellence to design our new category of tactical robotic systems and the industrial capacity to deliver them, bringing decisive airpower into the hands of every operator. We are not here to make promises; we are here to deliver real systems with real capabilities for real missions. 

You will join a team of operators, engineers, and builders who solve hard problems with humility and focus. We design and produce multi-mission aerial systems that operators trust to perform in real-world conditions, reliably, repeatedly, and at scale. Our approach is grounded in operator-centered design, rapid iteration from field use, and U.S.-based manufacturing. We operate by a clear set of values: Mission First, Aim Farther, Own It, Win Together. This is how we build advantage and how we help protect our service members, our communities, and our country. 

Now, we’re entering a new phase of growth and are looking for a sUAS trainer to join our team, contributing to the successful field operation and training of our unmanned aerial systems (UAS). The ideal candidate will thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, possess strong technical and instructional skills, and excel at problem-solving. This role requires significant travel, up to 70%. Trainers will be certified to instruct on multiple PDW sUAS platforms.

What You’ll Do

  • Deliver training to PDW clients on PDW sUAS products, UAS operations, mission planning, safety protocols, and regulatory compliance.
  • Coordinate training events including PDW trainer assignments, travel logistics, access to client locations and ranges, daily situation reports, and event closeout.

  • Excellent communication and instructional abilities.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in UAS field operations, maintenance, and training.

  • Familiarity with mission planning software, GPS systems, and telemetry tools.

Physical Requirements

Must be physically capable of CONUS and OCONUS travel.

Work Environment

This position is remote and may involve work in a standard office and manufacturing environment. This role requires use of standard office equipment and will require occasional travel to domestic and international training events, exercises, and PDW headquarters and facilities. This position may have exposure to outdoor weather conditions, noise, and non-climate-controlled environments. EEO Statement

We ensure a fair and unbiased evaluation for employment for all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, marital status, medical condition, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Job Title: Director of Electrical Engineering

GENERAL SUMMARY
The Director of Electrical Engineering at SCEG, a GF company, is responsible for leading the design, management, and successful execution of electrical engineering projects across a diverse portfolio of sectors, including hospitality, multifamily residential, luxury single-family estate homes, entertainment, retail, commercial, educational, healthcare, civic, and mixed-use developments. Project types include hotels, apartments, condominiums, theaters, shopping centers, restaurants, retail stores, schools, offices, hospitals, libraries, museums, and amusement parks, with projects located throughout Hawaii, Washington, South Carolina, Florida, Arizona, and California.

Reporting to a Managing Director, this role is responsible for overall project performance, client satisfaction, technical quality, team leadership, and project profitability. This position serves as both a technical leader and client manager, overseeing project teams, coordinating multidisciplinary efforts, managing project schedules and budgets, and ensuring compliance with applicable codes and standards. This position also plays a key role in mentoring engineering staff, maintaining client relationships, supporting business development efforts, and contributing to the firm's continued growth and reputation.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES
This position provides leadership, mentorship, and oversight to electrical engineers, designers, and project team members. This role is responsible for guiding staff development, assigning project responsibilities, reviewing work for quality and accuracy, and fostering collaboration across multidisciplinary teams.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements below represent the required knowledge, skill, and/or ability. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. General duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

Project Leadership & Management

  • Plan, direct, and manage all phases of electrical engineering projects from concept through construction administration.
  • Manage multiple projects and client relationships simultaneously while maintaining high levels of quality, responsiveness, and technical accuracy.
  • Monitor project schedules, budgets, staffing, and deliverables to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
  • Manage client expectations and proactively communicate project progress, challenges, and solutions.
  • Solve project and technical issues independently with minimal oversight.
  • Assist in the preparation of project proposals, scopes of work, fee estimates, and additional service requests.

Technical Design & Engineering

  • Lead the design and coordination of electrical systems including power distribution, lighting, and low-voltage systems.
  • Perform electrical system layouts, load calculations, and equipment sizing for commercial, industrial, institutional, hospitality, residential, and mixed-use projects.
  • Assist in the selection, evaluation, and specification of electrical equipment and systems.
  • Perform site evaluations, field investigations, and engineering assessments and prepare related technical reports.
  • Oversee field observations and reporting during construction phases.
  • Review contractor submittals, RFIs, and related construction documentation for compliance with design intent and project requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable building codes, energy standards, industry regulations, and engineering best practices.

Quality Assurance & Coordination

  • Perform and oversee QA/QC reviews to ensure technical accuracy, consistency, and quality across all project deliverables.

jobs.excerpt: Position:Chief Financial Officer (CFO) About the RoleWe are seeking an accomplished and commercially strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the financial strategy, financial performance, capital management, investment finance, treasury, reporting, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investment organization.
jobs.description:
Position:Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the financial strategy, financial performance, capital management, investment finance, treasury, reporting, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investment organization.

The CFO will serve as a key member of the executive leadership team and strategic advisor to the CEO/President and Board, providing leadership across financial planning, insurance accounting, capital and solvency management, investment portfolio performance, asset-liability management, treasury, risk, regulatory reporting, and corporate development.

The successful candidate will combine deep financial expertise with strong commercial and investment acumen and will be capable of operating in a highly regulated financial-services environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Strategy & Executive Leadership

Develop and execute the organization's overall financial strategy.

Advise the CEO, President, and Board on financial performance, capital allocation, investment strategy, and enterprise value creation.

Translate corporate strategy into financial plans, budgets, forecasts, and measurable objectives.

Lead financial decision-making across insurance, investment, and corporate operations.

Establish strong financial governance and accountability across the organization.

2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Performance

Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.

Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support strategic decisions.

Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, capital efficiency, and operating performance.

Establish financial KPIs and executive dashboards.

Identify opportunities to improve profitability, efficiency, and shareholder returns.

3. Insurance Finance & Performance

Oversee financial management of insurance operations, including premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, and underwriting performance.

Monitor key insurance financial metrics including loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting profitability.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk teams to assess financial performance and emerging exposures.

Ensure appropriate financial treatment and reporting of insurance liabilities and reserves.

Support pricing, product profitability, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions from a financial perspective.

4. Investment Finance & Portfolio Management

Provide financial oversight of the organization's investment portfolio and investment activities.

Partner with the CIO/Chief Investment Officer and Investment Committee on portfolio strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, realized/unrealized gains, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted returns.

Evaluate investment opportunities and strategic asset-allocation decisions.

Ensure investment activities are aligned with the organization's liabilities, liquidity requirements, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements.

5. Capital, Solvency & Balance Sheet Management

Lead capital planning and balance-sheet optimization.

Monitor solvency, capital adequacy, liquidity, leverage, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize the organization's capital structure and return on capital.

Assess the financial impact of major business, investment, and insurance decisions on capital requirements.

Work closely with Risk and Actuarial functions on capital and solvency assessments.

6. Asset-Liability Management (ALM)

Provide executive financial oversight of asset-liability management.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support development of ALM strategies and balance-sheet optimization initiatives.

Ensure appropriate financial stress testing and scenario analysis.

7. Treasury & Liquidity

Oversee treasury, cash management, liquidity planning, and banking relationships.

Maintain adequate liquidity to meet claims, operating obligations, investment commitments, and strategic requirements.

Optimize cash deployment and short-term investment strategies.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

Establish robust treasury policies and controls.

8. Regulatory & Financial Reporting

Ensure accurate, timely, and transparent financial reporting to the Board, shareholders, regulators, and other stakeholders.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and consolidated financial statements.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Lead relationships with external auditors, regulators, actuarial advisers, tax advisers, and other professional stakeholders.

Maintain strong financial controls and governance frameworks.

9. Risk Management & Financial Controls

Establish effective financial risk-management frameworks.

Monitor exposure to market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, operational, interest-rate, and foreign-exchange risks.

Strengthen internal controls, financial policies, and governance processes.

Work closely with the CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and other executives to manage enterprise-wide financial risks.

Ensure appropriate stress testing and contingency planning.

10. Reinsurance & Capital Optimization

Provide financial oversight of reinsurance strategy and economics.

Evaluate the financial and capital implications of reinsurance arrangements.

Monitor reinsurance recoverables, counterparty exposure, and profitability.

Support optimization of risk transfer, capital efficiency, and balance-sheet resilience.

11. Corporate Development & Strategic Investments

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, strategic investments, joint ventures, and business expansion opportunities.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and investment cases.

Assess potential M&A opportunities and their impact on capital, solvency, earnings, and shareholder value.

Support negotiations with investors, financial institutions, and strategic partners.

12. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, banks, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Communicate financial performance, capital strategy, investment results, and business outlook to key stakeholders.

Support investor presentations, Board materials, and strategic financial communications.

13. Finance Transformation & Technology

Modernize finance systems, reporting infrastructure, ERP platforms, and financial analytics.

Improve automation, data quality, forecasting, and management reporting.

Establish real-time visibility into financial, insurance, investment, and risk performance.

Drive continuous improvement within the finance function.

14. Leadership & Talent Development

Lead Finance, FP&A, Treasury, Accounting, Financial Reporting, Tax, and related functions.

Build a high-performing and commercially focused finance organization.

Develop finance leadership talent and succession plans.

Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, financial discipline, and business partnership.

Key Performance Indicators

The CFO will be accountable for:

Revenue and earnings growth

Operating and net profitability

Return on equity (ROE)

Return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Investment income and risk-adjusted returns

Combined ratio / underwriting profitability

Expense efficiency

Liquidity and cash-flow management

Balance-sheet optimization

Budget and forecast accuracy

Regulatory and financial reporting quality

Cost of capital

Financial risk management

Shareholder value creation

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive finance experience, including significant executive leadership.

Previous experience as CFO, Group CFO, Finance Director, VP Finance, Deputy CFO, or equivalent.

Significant experience within insurance, asset management, investment management, banking, pensions, financial services, or a related regulated financial institution.

Strong understanding of insurance financial statements, investment portfolios, capital management, and regulatory requirements.

Proven experience managing complex balance sheets, liquidity, capital, and financial performance.

Strong experience working with Boards, regulators, auditors, investors, rating agencies, and senior executives.

Demonstrated experience in financial strategy, investment analysis, and capital allocation.

Preferred Experience

Experience as Group CFO within a diversified insurance or financial-services group.

Experience across both insurance and investment/asset-management businesses.

Experience with life insurance, general insurance, health insurance, pensions, or reinsurance.

Exposure to institutional investment portfolios and alternative investments.

Experience with M&A, strategic investments, capital raising, restructuring, or corporate transformation.

Experience operating across multiple jurisdictions or regulated markets.

Experience interacting with insurance regulators and rating agencies.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

MBA or Master's degree in Finance/Business is an advantage.

Relevant insurance, actuarial, investment, or risk-management qualifications are advantageous.

Core Competencies

Insurance Finance

Corporate Finance

Investment Finance

Capital & Solvency Management

Asset-Liability Management

Treasury & Liquidity

Financial Planning & Analysis

Investment Analysis

Financial Modeling

Risk Management

Regulatory Reporting

Insurance Accounting

M&A & Corporate Development

Capital Allocation

Investor Relations

Corporate Governance

Financial Transformation

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CFO will be:

Strategic, commercially minded, and financially rigorous

Highly analytical and investment-oriented

Experienced in highly regulated environments

Strong in capital and balance-sheet management

Comfortable engaging with Boards, regulators, investors, and rating agencies

Able to balance growth, profitability, liquidity, capital, and risk

An effective strategic partner to the CEO, CIO, CRO, and Chief Actuary

Strong in complex financial decision-making

A transformational finance leader capable of building high-performing teams

Compensation

A competitive executive compensation package comprising base salary, performance-based incentives, executive benefits, and other benefits commensurate with experience and market benchmarks.

jobs.title: Team Lead, Android Core Product - Lausanne, Switzerland
jobs.excerpt: RemoteThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

The Switzerland Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-160,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced and passionate University Counsellor to join our team on a freelance/part-time basis. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in advising students on university placements, particularly for institutions in the UK, Australia, and US. This role is designed for a dynamic individual with a strong understanding of the application processes, who can provide personalized advice to our students. Experience with university placements in the UK and Australia is essential, while knowledge of US university admissions is a plus.
The University Counsellor will work with students on a fee-per-hour basis, providing insights on application strategies, personal statements, entrance exams, scholarships, and university selection.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide expert advice and guidance to students applying to universities in the UK, Australia, and US.
  • Assist students in identifying suitable universities based on their academic profile, career aspirations, and personal preferences.
  • Help students craft compelling personal statements and essays tailored to specific university applications.
  • Offer guidance on the completion of university application forms, including UCAS (for UK universities) and similar platforms for Australia and the US.
  • Advise on the preparation and completion of entrance exams (e.g., IELTS, SAT, ACT) as required by target universities.
  • Counsel students on available scholarships, financial aid, and other funding opportunities.
  • Keep abreast of university application deadlines and assist students in meeting these critical dates.
  • Provide feedback on interview preparation for specific universities that require them.
  • Collaborate with our internal team to ensure smooth communication and follow-up with students and their families.
  • Support the development of partnerships with university agents or placement agencies to streamline admissions processes and explore commission-based opportunities.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Experience: Minimum of 2-3 years of experience as a University Counsellor or Admissions Consultant with a focus on the UK, Australia, and US university systems.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree (required); a degree from a university in the UK, Australia, or US is a plus.
  • Knowledge: Deep knowledge of the university application processes, entrance exams, scholarships, and student visa requirements for the UK, Australia, and US.
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills; ability to build rapport with students and parents.
  • Advisory Skills: Experience providing one-on-one counseling sessions, creating tailored university application plans, and offering detailed feedback on applications and essays.
  • Flexibility: Ability to work remotely and manage a flexible schedule.
  • Preferred: Experience as a university agent or working directly with placement agencies to secure university contracts.


What Were Looking For

  • Someone with hands-on experience in applying and securing university placements for students, particularly in the UK and Australia.
  • US university experience is a bonus, but not mandatory.
  • Ideally, a candidate who has personally studied or worked in the UK, Australia, or US, as this adds first-hand experience to their guidance.
  • Were also open to candidates who may have entered the freelance market as they possess this unique background (e.g., professionals or housewives who studied abroad and are now offering consultancy services).


Why Join Us?

  • Flexibility: Work part-time on your own schedule, managing your own hours and appointments.
  • Impact: Help shape the academic future of students from diverse backgrounds by supporting them in securing top university placements.
  • Growth: Be part of a dynamic team in a growing industry with the potential to expand your role as our platform scales.

Remuneration
This is a freelance position, and compensation will be based on an hourly rate agreed upon prior to engagement.

jobs.excerpt: RemoteThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

The United States Based Salary range for this role is: 140,000-200,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Refer them!

About the Role

We’re looking for an Editorial Developer to join our growing in-house Typesetting team. You’ll take supplied content through typesetting, proofs and amendments, producing accessible print and digital assessment materials where accuracy matters at every stage.

The work brings together established publishing tools, structured content and repeatable digital workflows. You’ll take responsibility for the quality and completeness of your assigned work, with technical guidance from a Technical Lead and allocation and scheduling support from a Production Coordinator.

What You’ll Do

  • Typeset assessment materials in Adobe InDesign, using approved templates and styles to bring together text, tables, artwork and page layout.
  • Work with traditional documents and structured sources such as XML and AsciiDoc, preparing PDF and, where required, HTML outputs through agreed production workflows.
  • Apply and check amendments through successive proofs, preserving question meaning, numbering, marks and instructions.
  • Follow accessibility and modified-paper requirements, and create or adapt illustrations and graphics in Adobe Illustrator where needed.
  • Keep files, versions and Jira records accurate, flagging unclear instructions or missing assets early and providing clear handovers.
  • Identify recurring errors, unnecessary manual steps and opportunities for automation, sharing suggestions with colleagues to reduce avoidable rework.

What We’re Looking For

You’ll have experience in publishing or editorial production, typesetting, prepress, technical documentation, document production or a comparable environment where accuracy and controlled processes matter.

  • A responsible approach to confidential material, established standards and feedback.
  • Curiosity about how content is structured and processed, and a willingness to learn new tools and workflows.

Experience with InDesign, Acrobat Pro, Illustrator or Jira is valuable. Familiarity with structured content, HTML/CSS or scripted content-processing tools would also be useful. You do not need experience with every tool, and previous assessment-sector experience is welcome rather than essential.

Location & Working Pattern

This is a UK-based, fully remote role with London as the base office. Quarterly attendance at a Pearson office is expected.

Why Join Pearson?

We’re bringing more standard and modified assessment production in house. You’ll gain experience across different formats and accessibility requirements, while contributing to improvements grounded in the production work you do every day. You’ll receive onboarding and support on Pearson-specific tools, templates, standards and workflows, alongside guidance from experienced colleagues. This is a chance to build on your publishing skills in a specialist setting where careful production and better processes directly support the quality of learners' assessment materials. The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS.

The focus is on capturing real-world variation across lighting, poses, expressions, accessories, environments, and aging to improve model accuracy and robustness. The collection includes:

  • Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings.
  • Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation.
  • Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes.

To qualify for payment, you must submit a minimum of 20 valid images. The maximum payout is based on 24 accepted images. Due to the strict automated and manual Quality Control (QC) process, we strongly recommend submitting 30 images to help ensure that enough images remain valid after review

The project compensation rate is $0.55 USD per accepted image.

Note: Please use a Gmail address as your primary account when applying for this project.

Qualification path

No specific education is needed to perform the project task.

Year of Birth

jobs.excerpt: Join our mission to provide governments with exceptional experiences so they can do the same for their communities!
jobs.description:
Join our mission to provide governments with exceptional experiences so they can do the same for their communities!

What do we do?💥

We empower governments to deliver exceptional citizen experiences.

Check out our ‘About Us’page for a deep dive into our product and what makes us exceptional.

How will you help us make an impact? 👩‍💻👨‍💻

Reporting to the Head of Professional Services, the Director of Engagement Managers (Principal Engagement Manager) is Clariti's most senior client-facing delivery leader: a recognized thought leader, trusted executive advisor, and force multiplier for the broader Professional Services organization. Operating at the Expert level across all competency pillars, you won't simply manage implementations - you'll define how they are delivered, shape the frameworks the organization scales with, and mentor the next generation of Clariti delivery talent. While this is not a management role, you will leverage your experience to influence and develop the team.

At this level, you see beyond the project to the system. You unlock new business opportunities, forecast trends before they surface, and balance customer, partner, and business priorities with the nuance that comes only from deep institutional knowledge and battle-tested judgment. You hold the attention of executive audiences, navigate the most complex stakeholder dynamics, and build the organizational structures and cultures through which great delivery consistently happens.

If you have a proven track record of leading high-visibility, high-risk programs across government and civic technology - and you're driven to shape how a high-growth SaaS company delivers transformation at scale - this role is built for you.

As a Director, Engagement Managers at Clariti, you’ll be accountable of:

Strategic Delivery Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of Clariti's most complex, highest-visibility engagements, managing project governance, schedules, budgets, milestones, and success criteria across concurrent implementations with multiple client organizations.
  • Articulate clear delivery vision and strategic priorities to align large, cross-functional teams, including Implementation Consultants, Delivery Architects, Technical Account Managers, and Product and Engineering, ensuring every team has clear authority and targets that ladder up to shared outcomes.
  • Support continuously improving Clariti's repeatable delivery frameworks, structured retrospectives, and customer feedback loops, pioneering innovative solutions where no standard playbook yet exists and driving sustainable process improvement across the PS organization.
  • Anticipate risks and crises before they materialize; proactively devise and execute contingency plans, managing project scope changes and emerging threats with high autonomy and minimal escalation.

Executive Advisory & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to the most senior client stakeholders, mayors, CIOs, department directors, and agency heads, building deep relationships before dependencies arise and breaking down barriers between client functions and Clariti teams.
  • Lead recurring executive steering committees and check-ins, connecting project progress to city outcomes in a way that holds the attention of, and inspires, senior audiences, adjusting presentations in real time based on audience reaction and handling challenging Q&As with confidence.
  • Anticipate stakeholders' agendas and potential objections; proactively prepare and deploy effective engagement strategies that gain alignment across competing motivations and diffuse tension before it escalates.
  • Understand and manage the full spectrum of stakeholder interests, across regions, functions, and organizational levels, determining the appropriate style and depth of engagement for every interaction.

Delivery Excellence & Quality

  • Champion a delivery culture grounded in structured, data-backed metrics and storytelling, connecting performance to tangible government outcomes such as reduced permitting times, faster intake cycles, and measurable throughput improvements that give stakeholders the evidence to trust and advocate for Clariti.
  • Design systems and organizational structures for delivery teams that translate into consistently high-quality output, including resource models, delegation frameworks, and performance review cadences that keep teams engaged and accountable.
  • Apply advanced process improvement principles to deploy sustainable delivery initiatives; build a data-driven culture of continuous improvement and defect reduction across PS engagements.
  • Implement rigorous quality control processes; ask targeted questions that surface potential challenges without getting lost in the weeds, and validate impact through structured, transparent performance reviews.
  • Plan and prioritize resources across multiple concurrent engagements to ensure sufficient resourcing for targeted timelines, balancing utilization, team health, and delivery quality without burnout.

Organizational Learning & Knowledge Leadership

  • Build city personas, engagement playbooks, and scalable frameworks that translate project-level insights into organizational learning, distributing knowledge across PS and feeding structured product feedback into Clariti's roadmap.
  • Surface customer insights that influence Clariti's product and go-to-market strategy, acting as the voice of the customer in cross-functional conversations with Product, Engineering, Sales, and executive leadership.
  • Teach and develop the next generation of Clariti delivery talent, mentoring Principal ICs, Lead ICs, and Engagement Managers through coaching, modeled behavior, and structured development opportunities.
  • Leverage network and external influence to recruit and hire strong delivery talent; use institutional knowledge to identify and champion high-potential team members.
  • Consistently seek out new sources of knowledge and best practices; develop and distribute written knowledge pieces, playbooks, guides, frameworks, that enrich Clariti's delivery capability at scale.

Reporting & Cross-Functional Contribution

  • Provide regular reports and updates to the PS Director of Implementation and COO on the performance, risks, and strategic progress of all assigned engagements, structured for executive consumption and actionable by leadership.
  • Engage senior leadership through planning cycles, progress reports, and presentations for highly visible, broad-scale programs requiring extensive cross-functional coordination.
  • Contribute to Clariti's strategic planning by identifying new business opportunities with measurable impact to company objectives, informed by deep understanding of customer and partner nuances.

What do you bring to the team? 🧠

Experience & Track Record

  • 12+ years of experience leading and delivering enterprise-level or government transformation engagements in a SaaS, professional services, or civic technology environment.
  • Demonstrated track record of managing the most complex, highest-risk, multi-stakeholder programs end-to-end, including situations requiring recovery from dissatisfied clients or failed prior implementations.
  • Acknowledged thought leader within at least one prior organization on delivery methodology, client engagement, or public sector implementation.
  • Experience designing and owning delivery frameworks and feedback loops at an organizational level, not just executing within them.

Expert-Level Competencies

  • Business Acumen: Sees and unlocks new business opportunities with measurable impact; leverages understanding of customer and partner nuances to balance competing priorities; forecasts trends and builds strategic relationships across functions.
  • Financial Acumen: Own and actively manage engagement-level financial performance, including project budget forecasting, cost tracking, margin analysis, and variance reporting across a portfolio of concurrent engagements. Apply expert-level financial acumen to model delivery scenarios, assess trade-offs between scope, cost, and timeline, and make or recommend resource allocation decisions that protect both client outcomes and Clariti's financial health.
  • Communication: Holds the attention of large executive audiences; adapts presentations in real time; handles challenging Q&As and ad hoc speaking requests without preparation; structures all communication types for any audience.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identifies problems before they surface; persuades cross-org stakeholders to undertake innovative process improvement; pioneers solutions where no standard exists; builds data-driven improvement cultures.
  • Customer Centricity: Intimately understands customer journey; builds and inspires a culture of high-quality service across the organization; drives NPS improvement through cross-functional collaboration and influence.
  • Executional Excellence: Designs organizational systems and structures for teams that translate into high-quality output; motivates and inspires through challenging periods; plans across multiple initiatives without burnout.
  • Functional Expertise: Recognized thought leader and go-to advisor for delivery and implementation; teaches next-generation experts; uses network to recruit and develop strong talent.
  • Planning & Organizing: Articulates clear strategic vision; manages high-visibility, high-risk, broad-scale programs; proactively manages scope changes, crises, and contingencies.
  • Problem Solving: Drives organizational alignment for solutions affecting Clariti's overall position; develops new frameworks for complex problems; operates efficiently at top-level stakeholder scale.
  • Stakeholder Management: Breaks down barriers across functions and organizations; invests in relationships before dependencies arise; effectively manages complex conflict and ensures productive cross-team relationships.
  • Teamwork: Cultivates collaborative environments across levels, functions, and geographies; champions and develops high-potential team members; balances team protection with broader company objectives.

Technical & Methodological

  • Deep expertise in project management and agile methodologies with demonstrable evidence of applying them to large-scale transformation.
  • Strong data literacy, ability to establish baselines, define the right success metrics, connect project health to measurable outcomes, and communicate data-backed stories to executive audiences.
  • Proficiency in leading organizational change and managing ambiguity; exceeds customer expectations in dynamic, high-growth environments.
  • Familiarity with public sector or civic technology projects strongly preferred.
  • Ability to travel within the United States and Canada approximately 30-40%.

Bonus Points 🎉

  • Experience with Salesforce-based platforms or GovTech/civic technology ecosystems
  • Familiarity with permitting, licensing, or government service delivery workflows
  • Experience managing System Integrator (SI) partner relationships on joint delivery programs
  • Background in organizational change management (Prosci, ADKAR, or equivalent)
  • Demonstrated interest or hands-on experience applying AI tools to improve implementation workflows, documentation, or delivery efficiency
  • Experience in teams or practices transitioning toward AI-assisted delivery models

What’s in it for you?🫵

We invest in and empower our team members with competitive compensation packages, well deserved time off and benefits to keep you and your family healthy! *

💰 The base salary range for this role is expected to be between $195-235K CAD based on the candidate’s skills, experience, and qualifications while considering internal pay equity and our broader pay philosophy. 💰

If you have questions about compensation as we move through the process, we’re happy to discuss further.

*Benefits depend on employment type (full-time, part-time, contract, etc).

Things to Note 📝

Background checks - Because our customers trust us with sensitive information, we require all successful candidates to undergo comprehensive background checks before joining our team. We focus strictly on global sanctions and criminal offences that are directly relevant to employment at Clariti, and follow all applicable privacy and human rights legislation.

Travel- Although we operate as a remote company, all roles are expected to participate in occasional travel for in-person company-wide or departmental meetings, typically 1-2 times per year. Additional travel requirements specific to the role, if any, will be outlined in the job description.

We're committed to building an inclusive culture where our team members take ownership over projects, tasks, and outcomes; bring a growth mindset to drive continuous learning and self-development; have the ability to communicate courageously in a direct but respectful way; and are customer-focused by keeping the customer at the heart of decision-making. It’s the diversity of our team that helps us make better decisions, by leveraging the diversity in thought & experience across to create impactful solutions as we explore new paths & challenges as we grow. We’re working to create a workplace and team that is as diverse as the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

Questions? We are here to help

If you require accommodations in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in our hiring process for any reason, please direct your questions to and we’ll be happy to support you.
