The Opportunity


This is a remote position within Abbott Cancer Diagnostics. Abbott's Cancer Diagnostics business was established through the acquisition of Exact Sciences', bringing together Abbott's global diagnostics leadership with Exact Sciences' expertise in cancer screening and diagnostic testing. Together, we're advancing the early detection of cancer and improving outcomes for patients through innovative, accessible testing solutions. Our combined portfolio and reach allow us to bring life-changing diagnostic technology to more patients, providers, and health systems worldwide.


As the Senior Manager, Regulatory & Market Access Strategy, you’ll have the chance to serve as a strategic advisor on the regulatory, reimbursement, and health policy environment affecting ACD’s cancer screening and diagnostic portfolio, helping leaders navigate complex policy requirements and protect patient access.


What You’ll Work On

  • Represent ACD in trade associations, coalitions, and advocacy organizations to help develop and advance policy positions that support patient access and the ACD portfolio, while maintaining current expertise in emerging reimbursement requirements, industry trends, and market-access practices.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field aligned with the essential duties; advanced degree preferred.
  • 8+ years of experience advising healthcare organizations on legal, regulatory, and strategic matters related to government and commercial insurance coverage, billing and reimbursement, fraud, waste and abuse, provider licensing, and patient or consumer protection.
  • 5+ years of experience advising CLIA laboratories on legal and/or Market Access strategy matters related to diagnostics.
  • Advanced knowledge of official healthcare billing and coding guidelines, including requirements from CMS and other agencies within the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS).
  • Basic knowledge of the Medicare Molecular Diagnostics (MolDx) program.
  • Demonstrated experience engaging with trade associations, coalitions, and state advocacy groups and translating legislative and regulatory language into business and operational impact.
  • Experience translating legislative and regulatory language into business and operational impact.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex policy and reimbursement issues into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders and senior leadership.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and large cross-functional initiatives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • J.D. degree.
  • Advanced understanding of healthcare provider revenue cycle functions, processes, and healthcare IT systems.
  • Advanced knowledge of and experience engaging directly with MolDx, including submissions of Technical Assessments.

jobs.excerpt: Who are Evotix? We're a growing global EHS SaaS company with a clear ambition: to combine world-class software, data and AI to help our customers operate smarter, safer and more efficiently.
jobs.description:
Who are Evotix?

We're a growing global EHS SaaS company with a clear ambition: to combine world-class software, data and AI to help our customers operate smarter, safer and more efficiently. For exceptional talent, Evotix offers something rare-the pace of a growth company, the scale to make a real difference, and the opportunity to influence strategy, technology and outcomes at a global level.

At Evotix, we're creating the future of workplace health, safety and wellbeing—and we need ELITE people to help us do it. People who pursue Excellence, show Leadership, deliver Impact, earn Trust, and Empower those around them.

The Role

As a GTM Product Operations Specialist, you will own the operating process that takes product launches from plan to market. You will bring structure to new feature, pricing and strategic platform launches, creating clear plans, aligning teams and ensuring the business is ready to deliver a strong customer and commercial outcome.

Your main focus will be launch operations, cross-functional delivery and field readiness across Product, Product Marketing, Marketing, Sales Enablement, Sales, and Strategy & Operations. You will also strengthen launch measurement, turn customer and field feedback into practical improvements, and improve the systems, templates and operating rhythms that make product GTM scalable.

What You'll Do

Product Launch Management

  • Draft and maintain the core Product GTM Brief for each launch, with clear scope, timelines, dependencies, owners and deliverables.
  • Create consistent launch processes, templates and operating rhythms that improve clarity and make Product GTM more scalable.
  • Work cross-functionally to ensure release readiness across the wider business (such as Marketing with launch messaging and channel strategy, or Sales Enablement with clear enablement planning and materials).

System and Process Governance

  • Own the Go-to-Market operating process for product launches, from new features, to pricing changes, and strategic platform updates.
  • Own important systems for Product (Aha!, Jira, AI-DLC and more), and implement improvements to these systems.

Launch Performance and Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with Product to define and track launch success measures and adoption Key Risk Indicators for newly launched products.
  • Translate field feedback, customer needs and launch learnings into actionable recommendations for future GTM motions and product improvements.
  • Review launch performance and identify where plans, handovers or readiness activities should be improved.

What You Bring

Essential

  • Experience in product operations, go-to-market, business operations, strategy and operations, product marketing, consulting or a related field.
  • Experience leading cross-functional workstreams in a high-growth environment.
  • Ability to turn ambiguity into clear plans, timelines, dependencies and deliverables.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distil complex product information into clear messaging for internal teams.
  • Good product and commercial judgement, with the ability to connect customer needs, product capabilities and business implications.
  • Confidence managing multiple stakeholders and driving alignment without direct authority.
  • Strong attention to detail and operational discipline across launch timelines, dependencies and field readiness.
  • A proactive, resourceful approach and the ability to build new processes in a fast-moving environment.
  • A customer-first mindset, with humility, curiosity and sound judgement.

Desirable

  • Experience in SaaS or B2B product launches.
  • Experience in sales enablement or another field-facing GTM role.
  • Experience using Aha!, Jira, Rovo, Claude or comparable product and release operations tools.
  • Experience in a fast-paced, scaling organisation.

Please note that Evotix is unable to offer visa sponsorship. You must have the legal right to work in the country where the role is based at the time of application.

Interview Process

We aim to keep our interview process transparent, fair, and respectful of your time. While steps may vary slightly by role, you can typically expect:

  • Initial chat: A conversation with a member of our Talent team to learn more about your background, motivations, and answer any initial questions.
  • Hiring Manager interview: A role-focused discussion exploring your experience, skills, and how you approach real-world scenarios relevant to the role.
  • Key Stakeholder interview: A discussion with a member of senior leadership in another department that you will be working with should you join.
  • Final Panel interview: A conversation with key stakeholders to dive deeper into collaboration, alignment, and mutual fit. This stage may involve a Case Study or Presentation to allow you to show off your skills!
  • Offer: If successful, we’ll move quickly to share an offer and next steps.

We’re happy to make reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process — just let us know what you need.

Why join Evotix?

  • Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive base salary and company-based performance bonus.
  • Time to Recharge: Unlimited Annual Leave because we trust you to balance your work and wellbeing.
  • Support for You: Access to our Employee Assistance Program, including mental health, legal, and financial guidance.
  • Growth Opportunities: Educational benefits to help you keep learning and growing.
  • Team Culture: Regular team events, an inclusive environment, and a shared commitment to making an impact.

Ready to Make a Difference?
If you’re a bold, results-driven leader who thrives on challenges, loves scaling success, and is passionate about making a difference—we want to hear from you!

Thank you for your interest. Please note, we are not seeking support from external recruitment agencies at this time. Direct applications from candidates are warmly welcomed.

The Solution Consultant partners with sales and other internal stakeholders to address and develop technical customer requirements for Workiva solutions. The Community Development Manager will play a critical role in driving sales, optimizing care pathways for of cross-lysosomal storage disease patients, and ensuring formulary access to enhance patient outcomes and achieve organizational goals.

The Community Development Manager will not only cultivate existing business but will be responsible for identifying growth opportunities via lead/trigger follow-up. This role will report to the Commercial Strategic Account Director (CSAD).

We chase the miracles of science every single day, pursuing progress to make a real impact on millions of patients around the world.

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth.   • Product Mindset: You'll be a central figure, coordinating with various teams to build and support the product

Work Environment
  • Remote-First Culture: At Incubyte, we thrive on a culture of structured flexibility — while you have control over where and how you work, everyone commits to a consistent rhythm that supports their team during core working hours for smooth collaboration and timely project delivery. By striking the perfect balance between freedom and responsibility, we enable ourselves to deliver high-quality standards our customers recognize us by. With asynchronous tools and push for active participation, we foster a vibrant, hands-on environment where each team member’s engagement and contributions drive impactful results.
  • Work-In-Person: Twice a year, we come together for two-week sprints to collaborate in person, foster stronger team bonds, and align on goals. Additionally, we host an annual retreat to recharge and connect as a team. All travel expenses are covered.

Are you a former journalist or PR professional who can explain complicated things clearly, and stay calm when people are upset?

Smartland Energy is looking for a communications professional to be the clear, trusted voice between our company and the communities where we work.

Our projects, including data centers and energy infrastructure, raise real questions for local residents about water, power bills, land, and their future. Some people are curious. Some are worried. Some are frustrated and distrustful. We need someone who can communicate with all of them honestly, accurately, and respectfully.

This is not a generic content writing job. You'll be working on high-stakes communication where accuracy matters and every word counts.

What you'll do:

  • Write clear, accurate public communications, including FAQs, fact sheets, emails, web updates, social posts, and print materials, on technical and sometimes sensitive topics
  • Research complex subjects and work with engineers, leadership, and experts to make sure everything is correct before it's published
  • Draft responses to resident questions and concerns, even when people are upset, with honesty and empathy
  • Plan and execute multi-channel campaigns such as public meeting announcements across social, email, web, and print
  • Prepare materials and messaging for community meetings and stakeholder outreach
  • Keep one consistent, trustworthy voice across every channel
  • Track what's working, such as open rates, attendance, questions received, and sentiment, and report on results
  • Handle sensitive and not-yet-public information with complete discretion

You're a great fit if you:

  • Have a background in journalism, communications, PR, or a related field (Mass Comm, DevComm, English, Humanities, etc.)
  • Write excellent, natural English and can simplify technical topics without dumbing them down
  • Research first and ask questions instead of guessing
  • Know the difference between what's known, what's projected, what's undecided, and what can actually be promised, and communicate each clearly
  • Stay steady and respectful when dealing with frustrated or skeptical people
  • Can work independently while coordinating closely with leadership
  • Have experience running campaigns across multiple channels and measuring results

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience in energy, utilities, infrastructure, government, NGO, or crisis communications
  • Worked with US or international clients before
  • A portfolio of published work such as articles, press releases, or campaign materials

This role is NOT for you if:

  • You mostly write SEO blogs or product descriptions
  • You rely on AI to write for you
  • You avoid conflict or difficult conversations
  • You're looking for a short-term gig

  1. Your resume
  2. 2–3 writing samples, ideally at least one on a technical or sensitive topic
  3. A short answer (150–250 words) to this question: "A resident believes our project will drain their well and raise their power bill. Write the first reply you'd send them."

Start your application with the subject line "Clear and Honest" so we know you read the full post. Applications without it won't be reviewed.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

Bonus

Technologies we use

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Als europäische Digitalisierungsberatung treiben wir die Transformation im Energiesektor konsequent voran – mit dem Ziel, echte Wertschöpfung in allen Unternehmensbereichen zu entfalten. Unsere Mission: Die Energiebranche fit für die Zukunft machen – effizienter, nachhaltiger und digitaler.
Was uns auszeichnet? Neben spannenden und anspruchsvollen Projekten bieten wir Dir viel unternehmerische Freiheit, Raum für eigene Ideen und kontinuierliches persönliches Wachstum. Unsere Unternehmenskultur lebt von einem starken Miteinander, geprägt durch gegenseitige Wertschätzung, Vertrauen und Unterstützung.
Wir fördern individuelle Karrierewege und bieten exzellente Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten – ganz ohne starre Hierarchien. Unsere Mitarbeitenden stehen im Mittelpunkt: Deshalb sind überdurchschnittliche Vergütung, flexible Arbeitsmodelle und zahlreiche Zusatzleistungen für uns selbstverständlich.

Unsere Aufgaben konzentrieren sich auf Transformationsprojekte im Energiesektor:

  • Definition und Umsetzung von IT-, Cloud- und KI-Strategien
  • Durchführung von Prozessanalysen und Identifikation digitaler Potenziale
  • Entwicklung von Governance-Strukturen und strategischen Transformationskonzepten zur Unterstützung nachhaltiger Veränderungen und zur Sicherstellung von Value Assurance
  • Verantwortung für Digitalisierungsvorhaben entlang der gesamten energiewirtschaftlichen Wertschöpfungskette – von Erzeugung über Transmission und Distribution bis hin zu Vertrieb und Kundenservice
  • Konzeption und Umsetzung von Lösungsansätzen, Target Operating Models sowie Programmsteuerung und Projektmanagement
  • Begleitung von Projekten über alle Phasen hinweg – von der Strategieentwicklung bis zur Implementierung
  • Aufbau und Einführung von Managementinstrumenten sowie IT/OT-Convergence-Lösungen, z. B. Smart Grids
  • Analyse und Optimierung von Organisationsstrukturen, Geschäftsprozessen und IT-Architekturen
  • Unterstützung bei der Pitchvorbereitung und Entwicklung maßgeschneiderter Kundenlösungen

das bist du

Du bist analytisch, kommunikativ und neugierig. Du arbeitest gerne im Team und bringst eine hohe Eigeninitiative sowie eine unternehmerische „Can-Do“-Mentalität mit. Darüber hinaus zeichnen Dich folgende Eigenschaften aus:

  • 5-7 Jahre Beratungserfahrung, darunter auch in der Beratung imEnergiesektor
  • Praktische Erfahrung bei einem Energieversorger oder in branchenrelevanten Projekten
  • Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, sowie energienahen Fächern oder einem relevanten Studium im Bereich der Naturwissenschaften(z.B. Energiewirtschaft, Erneuerbare Energien, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau, Physik)
  • Affinität zu Themen wie Digitalisierung und Informationstechnologie
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse der gängigen Consulting Methoden und Werkzeuge
  • Innovationsfreude und die Bereitschaft Verantwortung zu übernehmen
  • Strategisches Mindset und sehr gutes Verständnis der Geschäftsprozesse im Energiesektor
  • Erfahrung im Aufbau und Umgang mit Kernplattformen von Energieversorgern, wie Salesforce oder SAP, sowie Interesse an der Gestaltung zukünftiger Energy Platforms
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis von Energieerzeugung, Transmission, Metering, Vertrieb und Customer Care, einschließlich der Anforderungen an deren Flexibilisierung auf Business-Seite sowie der zugrunde liegenden technischen Zusammenhänge
  • Freude bei derUmsetzung der Energiewende
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch (C1), Englisch verhandlungssicher
  • Reisebereitschaft
Zusätzlich von Vorteil:
  • Kenntnisse im Bereich Metering, IT/OT Konvergenzsowie bei der Auswahl und Implementierung von relevanten Plattformen (ServiceNow, Salesforce, Jira)
  • Erfahrung bei der Definition und Umsetzung von IT-, Cloud- und KI-Strategien
  • ErfahrungmitProjektmanagement-Methoden (PRINCE2, Agile, Six Sigma) und IT Service Management (ITSM)
  • KI-Skills und erste Erfahrungenbei dem Aufbau und Umsetzung von KI-Initiativen
  • Erfahrung mit AI Value Cases zur Schaffung neuer Geschäftswerte oder mit GenAI-Insourcing-Optionen

das sind wir

Wir glauben an eine offene und geradlinige Kommunikation, die von einem starken Teamgeist getragen wird. Grundwerte wie Kundenorientierung, Engagement im Job, Vertrauen und Integrität werden vorausgesetzt. Unsere Projekte sind oft international und erfordern Reisen. Associate Medical Director | Relevate Health

WHO WE ARE

At Relevate Health, we believe every HCP communication should be relevant, and we've built a company of exceptional people committed to making that vision a reality. We're healthcare communications experts who push ourselves every single day to deliver meaningful scientific and medical education for the clients, providers, and patients who depend on us. Our culture is collaborative, growth-minded, and energized by purpose.

We're not a company where you stay in one lane. Our Associate Medical Directors work across therapeutic areas, stretch their scientific range, and do work that genuinely reaches HCPs and impacts patient care. If you're someone who thrives on variety, wants to be challenged, and is looking for a place where scientific expertise is at the core of everything — read on.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We're looking for an Associate Medical Director to join our team and serve as a key scientific resource across both our Agency and Engagement Solutions practices. This role puts you at the intersection of science, strategy, and collaboration — developing and reviewing high-quality medical content across a range of accounts and therapeutic areas, and partnering with cross-functional teams to bring that content to life.

You'll own scientific deliverables from outline through final delivery. You'll be the medical voice in the room — partnering with account, editorial, design, and project management colleagues — and you'll bring that same credibility and expertise into client-facing settings. No two projects look alike here, and that's exactly the point.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Serve as the primary scientific resource on assigned accounts, providing strategic and tactical medical expertise across a wide range of deliverables for both Agency and Engagement Solutions
  • Develop, write, and review scientific and medical content, including slide decks, medical education programs, advisory board materials, manuscripts, symposia content, and more
  • Conduct thorough medical/scientific reviews to ensure accuracy, clarity, and alignment with client objectives and regulatory standards
  • Partner closely with cross-functional teams — account management, editorial, design, and project management — to support seamless execution from outline through final delivery
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, showing up as a credible, trusted scientific partner in calls and meetings
  • Stay current on the evolving therapeutic landscape, competitive intelligence, and product-level data across multiple therapeutic areas
  • Contribute scientific input to proposals, pitch materials, and new business initiatives as needed
  • Consistently meet project deadlines and provide clear, timely feedback to keep projects on track

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must-Haves:

  • Advanced degree: PhD, PharmD, or MD
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in medical communications, a pharmaceutical/biotech company, or a healthcare agency
  • Demonstrated scientific breadth across multiple therapeutic areas
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills — you can take complex data and make it clear, compelling, and accurate
  • Experience working closely with non-scientific team members (account managers, designers, editors) on cross-functional deliverables
  • Proven ability to juggle multiple projects and deadlines without dropping the ball
  • Client-facing experience with a track record of earning trust as a scientific partner

Big Pluses:

  • Experience supporting both promotional and medical education deliverables
  • Familiarity with pharmaceutical regulatory and compliance standards
  • Comfort in a fast-paced, multi-client agency environment

Education:

  • Advanced degree required: PhD, PharmD, or MD
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant industry experience (agency or pharma)

Travel is required as business needs demand in support of both Engagement Solutions and Agency accounts.

WHY RELEVATE?

We offer more than a job. We offer a place to grow, do meaningful work, and feel genuinely supported doing it.

Our Culture & Values
Be a part of a compassionate, driven team that emphasizes open communication through our PACT Core Values: Pioneering, Accountable, Caring, and Transparent.

PACT Bonus Program
We put our money where our values are. Every month, we recognize colleagues who go above and beyond to exemplify our PACT Core Values with a monetary bonus ranging from $500 to $2,500. At Relevate, living our values doesn't go unnoticed.

Be a Part of Our FUN!

  • Team Impact: Bringing our colleagues together to think outside the box and implement ingenious activities to involve, inspire, and facilitate positivity and caring.
  • Team HOPE: Seeks out philanthropic opportunities so that we can proactively care, respect, help, serve, and grow.

Set Up for Success
A welcoming onboarding program with the focus on setting our new colleagues up for success from day one.

Competitive Pay & Top Benefits, Including:

  • Unlimited PTO
  • 401K
  • Pet Insurance
  • Health, Dental & Vision
  • Employer-paid STD, LTD, Critical Illness, Accident, Hospital, and Life Insurance
  • ...and more!

READY TO APPLY?

If you're a scientist who loves the craft of medical communications, thrives on collaboration, and wants to do work that actually makes a difference for HCPs and patients, we want to hear from you.

Apply today and let's talk.

jobs.excerpt: Join ProMach and shine.  Whether you're creative, strategic, persuasive, or mechanically inclined, there’s a place for you here.
jobs.description:
Join ProMach and shine. Whether you're creative, strategic, persuasive, or mechanically inclined, there’s a place for you here. Be a problem-solver, a closer, a futurist - whatever drives you.


At ProMach, you'll be challenged and rewarded as you help improve packaging performance and shape the future of automation. And we’ll be proud to have you on the journey.


Do we have your attention? Keep reading.


We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Data Architect to lead the design, development, and optimization of enterprise-grade data platforms. This role will shape the future of scalable data architecture, powering analytics, reporting, and operational efficiency across diverse business units. The ideal candidate brings hands-on expertise in Databricks, relational databases, ERP/CRM systems, data modeling, data migration, and building and maintaining complex data pipelines. Experience integrating and modeling data from platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, and SyteLine is critical.

Duty/Responsibility:

· Design and implement scalable data architectures across hybrid cloud and on-premise environments.

· Lead data integration efforts from multiple enterprise systems, including ERP (SAP, Oracle, SyteLine) and CRM (e.g., Salesforce).

· Develop and optimize robust, scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using distributed data processing and orchestration frameworks.

· Lead large-scale data migration projects ensuring integrity, lineage, and minimal business disruption.

· Design and maintain logical and physical data models for both transactional and analytical use cases (e.g., star schema, normalized forms).

· Collaborate with data engineers and analysts to operationalize and enhance data solutions that meet business goals.

· Ensure performance, scalability, and reliability of data workflows and storage through best practices in indexing, partitioning, and caching.

· Champion data quality, governance, and metadata management across enterprise reporting and analytics ecosystems.

· Provide technical leadership and mentorship to data engineering teams and advocate for modern data practices and tools.

· Monitor evolving trends and emerging technologies in data architecture to drive innovation and modernization.

Qualifications:

· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (Master’s preferred).

· 7+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or related roles with a demonstrated hands-on approach.

· Hands-on experience with Databricks, including building data pipelines, working with Delta Lake, and leveraging Spark-based transformations.

· Proficiency with relational database development (e.g., T-SQL, schema design, indexing) across platforms such as SQL Server or PostgreSQL.

· Strong experience integrating and modeling data from ERP and CRM systems, including SAP, Oracle, SyteLine, and Salesforce.

· Proficiency in SQL and Python for data transformation, analysis, and automation.

· Experience building robust ETL/ELT processes and supporting data migrations at scale.

· Solid understanding of data governance principles, metadata management, and data security best practices.

· Excellent communication and collaboration skills with both technical and business stakeholders.

· Preferred:

· Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog or other enterprise data cataloging solutions.

· Knowledge of real-time data processing and streaming architectures.

· Familiarity with business intelligence platforms like Power BI or Tableau.

· Understanding of manufacturing, financial, and supply chain data domains.

· Experience with CI/CD practices, infrastructure automation, and DevOps for data solutions.

Physical Demands:

  • Minimal reaching, lifting, walking.
  • Consistent use of computer, telephone, typing, and talking.

What’s in it for you?


There's no monopoly on innovative ideas or limits to how far you can advance with our team. We offer an open, communicative environment that fosters individual initiative. We pride ourselves in being a company where people are happy and choose to build a career.


In addition to growth opportunities, as a ProMach employee, you receive more than just a paycheck. Total compensation includes your salary, comprehensive medical/dental programs, as well as life insurance, a generous paid time off program, and a retirement savings plan with a company match. And because we understand the importance of feeling protected, there is no waiting period for benefits – you are eligible on your first day of employment!


Please note that the pay ranges listed on external job boards, outside our posting details, do not accurately reflect our internal compensation ranges.



Pro Mach, Inc. was named to the Inc. 5,000 list of the fastest growing private companies in the U.S. seven times. We continue to introduce innovative products, enter new markets, expand our global presence, and actively acquire new capabilities.


We have the rewards, opportunities, and the market strength of a large organization combined with the entrepreneurial culture of a small, fast-paced company. You will enjoy the benefits of working with a growing company that competes globally, with the personal touch and feel of a smaller company where you can make an impact every day.



ProMach is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Pro Mach uses E-Verify to verify employment eligibility of all new hires to work in the United States. Pro Mach is a drug-free workplace.

jobs.excerpt: Who We Are: InGenius Prep was founded in 2013 by law students at Harvard and Yale.
jobs.description:
Who We Are:
InGenius Prep was founded in 2013 by law students at Harvard and Yale. In that time, the company has grown to a team of more than 190 full-time employees, 600 part-time employees, as well as offices in the U.S., Canada, China, amongst other countries.

What We Do:
Our primary focus is assisting students in applying to U.S. Colleges and Graduate schools. Our company is fast-paced and exciting. We operate as a team, and everyone is given opportunities to advance in the organization.

How You’ll Help:
我们正在寻找一位细致、可靠、善于沟通的家庭支持顾问，成为学生与家长在整个留学规划旅程中的陪伴者和桥梁。您将代表公司与家长保持高质量、持续的沟通，同时与内部导师团队紧密协作，确保服务顺利进行。

We’re looking for a thoughtful, dependable, and communicative Family Success Manager to act as a trusted bridge between families and our internal advising team. You’ll be the key point of contact for parents throughout their child’s study abroad journey—providing timely updates, thoughtful recommendations, and genuine care as their child progresses toward their goals.

What You’ll Do:

1. 家长最安心的沟通窗口 The Trusted Contact for Families

  • 主动与家长建立长期、积极的沟通关系，及时反馈学生在学业、申请等方面的进展
  • 了解每个家庭的关注点、沟通习惯和期望，给予适当建议和情绪支持
  • 遇到问题时，第一时间回应与协调，让家长感到被理解和支持
  • 基于学生学习路径的变化或新目标，协助匹配相关的支持产品，如课程、导师服务或外部资源
  • 收集反馈并协助服务流程优化，提升客户口碑与转介绍率
  • Build long-term, positive relationships with families and keep them informed on academic planning and application progress
  • Understand each family’s concerns, preferences, and expectations, offering encouragement and insight
  • Respond promptly and helpfully when challenges arise, ensuring families always feel heard and supported
  • Proactively suggest internal offerings—such as courses, mentorship, or partner programs—based on the student’s progress and future goals
  • Collect feedback to support continuous improvement of the customer journey and enhance client satisfaction and referral rates

2. 项目进度与服务质量保障 Project Progress & Service Quality Oversight

  • 与升学导师、前招生官顾问、项目管理老师协同，确保服务满足家庭需求
  • 当导师团队为学生制定升学辅导路径，选校计划、申请规划时，将家庭需求和考量及时反馈和体现在规划中
  • 跟踪服务完成率、家长沟通记录、学生状态等关键数据，提前识别服务风险并介入协调
  • Collaborate closely with Graduate Coach, Former Admissions Officer, and course managers to ensure services are delivered to fulfill family needs.
  • Contribute and integrate the family’s needs and perspectives when the counselor team develops roadmaps, application plans, and school lists, etc., for the student
  • Track key performance indicators such as service completion rates, parent feedback records, and student engagement to identify risks early and intervene when necessary

3. 跨部门沟通与协作 Cross-Department Collaboration

  • 向教研、课程、运营等团队反馈家庭需求
  • 协调内部导师与外部家长的信息流通，确保表达一致、节奏统一
  • Share frontline insights about family’s needs with curriculum, operations, and product teams
  • Coordinate all communication between internal advisors and external parents, ensuring messaging is aligned and delivery meets family needs

You'll be a good fit if you:

  • 本科及以上学历，教育、心理、管理、传播等相关专业优先

jobs.title: Team Lead, Android Core Product - Eindhoven, Netherlands
jobs.excerpt: RemoteThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

The Netherlands Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-120,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

jobs.title: Team Lead, Android Core Product - Prague, Czech Republic
jobs.excerpt: RemoteThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

The Czech Republic Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-100,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

jobs.excerpt: Are you the kind of professional who doesn’t stop at theory — who steps into the case, resolves the motion, and leads the team forward before the Immigration Court?
jobs.description:
Are you the kind of professional who doesn’t stop at theory — who steps into the case, resolves the motion, and leads the team forward before the Immigration Court?

If your answer is a resounding YES!!! — then this opportunity is for you!

About Us

At Mangone Law Firm, excellence is intentional, quality is uncompromised, and going above and beyond is part of who we are.

Mangone Law Firm, LLC is a New Jersey-based immigration law firm that has been dedicated since 2012 to helping new Americans obtain legal status in the U.S. We proudly represent immigrants nationwide and are fully committed to excellence in customer service — deeply understanding our clients’ challenges and genuinely caring about their outcomes. We’re fueled by a strong corporate culture and clear core values. We’re prepared for a bright future and we’re looking for talented people who want to grow professionally and never settle for stagnation.

🌟 We’re an Inc. 5000 Honoree! 🌟

Mangone Law Firm is proud to be recognized on the 2025 Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies! This honor celebrates our team’s resilience, innovation, and dedication to delivering outstanding results for our clients — even in the most challenging times.

When you join Mangone Law Firm, you become part of a thriving, forward-moving team that’s committed to growth, excellence, and making an impact every single day. If you’re driven, proactive, and ready to grow with a company that’s nationally recognized for its success — we invite you to apply and build your career with us!

We’re looking for an enthusiastic and talented Court Paralegal to our Legal team!

Requirements

What are we looking for in you?

  • Minimum 2 years of demonstrable experience at immigration law firms, with direct and active handling of cases before the Immigration Court (EOIR / removal defense) — not solely in administrative or support functions.
  • Bilingual (Spanish / English) – fluent in speaking and writing (minimum B2 level).
  • Legal Team Leadership: Prior experience supervising, coordinating, or leading paralegals or legal staff, preferably in remote environments.
  • EOIR Procedure Mastery: Master Calendar Hearings, Individual Hearings, the BIA appeal process, and e-filing.
  • Motion Review: Ability to review and validate motions such as Continuance, Change of Venue, Reopen, Reconsider, Terminate, Withdraw, Administrative Closure, and Bond requests.
  • Knowledge of Immigration Relief available in removal proceedings: asylum, cancellation of removal, adjustment of status, among others.
  • Action-Oriented Profile: Willingness to personally step into a case or motion and set the example of execution for the rest of the team.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Quality Control: You will conduct Pre-Attorney and Post-Attorney Reviews of 12–15 packages weekly each, ensuring every motion and filing meets the firm’s legal and formatting standards.
  • Strategic Case Management: You will assign and balance the team’s caseload (Court/ICE cases, USCIS motions, SIJ, and declarations) according to complexity and availability, while maintaining a master deadline calendar.
  • Continuous Improvement: You will implement at least one process improvement every two weeks (documents, templates, or automations) and verify its actual use in the team’s daily work.

Benefits

What do we offer you?

  • A competitive compensation: base payment per hour (14–17 USD]), and hourly rate increase after the first six months, depending on performance.
  • Ongoing professional development opportunities for you to strengthen your skills and grow in your career.
  • A dynamic and challenging work environment, where your talent will be valued and recognized.
  • The opportunity to make a positive impact on people’s lives, helping them achieve their dreams of a better life in the United States.
  • Eligibility to participate in company retreats and corporate events after six months.
  • Paid Time Off after twelve months tenure.

jobs.title: Business Segment Lead B2B SaaS / Software Features - (alle Identitäten)
jobs.excerpt: das erwartet dichDein Hebel für die Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen Bei Caspar Health arbeiten wir an der Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen – digital, nachhaltig und ganzheitlich.
jobs.description:
das erwartet dich

Dein Hebel für die Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen
Bei Caspar Health arbeiten wir an der Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen – digital, nachhaltig und ganzheitlich. Unsere innovativen Lösungen verändern die medizinische Nachsorge und Prävention grundlegend. Um diesen Impact auf das nächste Level zu heben, suchen wir eine strategisch starke und diplomatisch geschickte Persönlichkeit für unser Kernsegment.

Warum diese Rolle ein absoluter Gamechanger istVergiss den klassischen, starren Konzern-Strategen und das monotone Verwalten von Roadmaps. In dieser Rolle bist Du Macher*in und Intrapreneur zugleich: Du steuerst Dein Segment wie Dein eigenes Unternehmen im Unternehmen. Du bist die kommerzielle Speerspitze für unsere Software-Lösungen, um maximalen Markterfolg und echten, spürbaren Mehrwert im Leben von Patient:innen und Ärzt:innen zu stiften. Das ist kein seelenloses B2B-Dashboard – das ist Tech mit echtem Purpose und klarem Business-Impact.

Deine Rolle im Ökosystem & das Team-Set-UpAls Commercial Segment Lead übernimmst Du die unternehmerische End-to-End-Verantwortung für den kommerziellen Erfolg unserer Software-Lösungen. Da wir in einer agilen Matrix-Struktur arbeiten, steuerst Du das Segment horizontal: Du ziehst die Fäden als zentraler, cross-funktionaler Knotenpunkt zwischen Sales, Marketing und CSM zusammen. Du musst keine Code-Zeile verstehen und versinkst nicht im Tech-Deep-Dive – dafür steht Dir eine Product Commercial Managerin als dedizierte Übersetzungsschnittstelle und starker Gatekeeper zur Produktorganisation zur Seite. Deine Aufgabe beginnt dort, wo die Technik aufhört: Du machst aus Features echten Umsatz und nachhaltiges Wachstum.

deine herausforderungen

  • Strategische Segment-Steuerung: Definition der ganzheitlichen Segment-Strategie sowie Übernahme der vollen P&L-Verantwortung (ARR und Churn) zur Maximierung des kommerziellen Erfolgs
  • Go-to-Market-Ownership: Verantwortung für das strategische Positioning, Messaging, Pricing und Packaging auf Basis kontinuierlicher Markt-, Kunden- und Wettbewerbsanalysen
  • Datengestützte Priorisierung: Übersetzung der Bedarfe unserer B2B-Kunden in klare Business Cases sowie treffsichere, KPI-basierte Argumentation der Business-Anforderungen gegenüber der Produktorganisation
  • Feature-Storytelling & Sales Enablement: Strategische Einordnung von Produktentwicklungen sowie verständliche Formulierung und Verpackung des konkreten Mehrwerts für den Vertrieb und unsere Kunden
  • Cross-funktionale Orchestrierung: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, Marketing und CSM zur Erstellung hochwertiger, vertriebsrelevanter Assets und zur Steigerung der Win-Rate
  • Laterale Führung: Fachliche Steuerung interdisziplinärer Teams und Zusammenziehen von Ressourcen aus den Fachabteilungen über exzellentes Stakeholder-Management

dein profil

  • B2B SaaS Commercial Background: Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Product Marketing Management (PMM), im Business Development oder als Commercial Product Manager im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld mit. (Healthcare-Erfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss – wir geben Dir die Zeit für ein fundiertes Onboarding)
  • Nachweisbare P&L-Verantwortung: Du hast bereits erfolgreich Umsatz- und Budgetverantwortung getragen. Eine reine Roadmap- oder Feature-Verantwortung reicht für diese Rolle nicht aus – Du musst aktiv Umsatz und P&L gesteuert haben
  • Vertriebs- und Markt-Affinität: Du weißt genau, wie B2B-Vertriebszyklen funktionieren und wie man komplexe Software-Features in glasklare Value Propositions für den Vertrieb übersetzt
  • Analytische Steuerung: Sicherer Umgang mit Kern-KPIs (ARR, Churn, Net Retention) und die Fähigkeit, auch bei unvollständiger Datengrundlage im Scale-Up fundierte kommerzielle Entscheidungen zu treffen
  • Starke Matrix-Resilienz: Ausgeprägte Kompetenz im cross-funktionalen Management und die Fähigkeit, Teams ohne disziplinarische Weisungsbefugnis auf ein gemeinsames Ziel einzuschwören
  • Kommunikative Diplomatie: Psychologisch stabiles und souveränes Auftreten bei gegensätzlichen Stakeholder-Interessen (z. B. zwischen Sales und Produkt), gepaart mit hoher Pro-Aktivität und absoluter Verbindlichkeit

warum caspar health?

  • Remote-first mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten – Office optional in Berlin Mitte oder 90 Tage im Jahr außerhalb Deutschlands
  • Passend dazu, unterstützen wir Dich mit einer monatlichen Homeoffice Pauschale und einem Essenszuschuss on Top
  • Genug Zeit zum erholen – mit 30 Tagen Urlaub im Jahr
  • Budget für Weiterbildung, Konferenzen & Coaching, passend zu deinen Potentialen und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung & Entscheidungsfreiheit: kein Mikromanagement – wir stellen Expert*innen ein, die wissen was sie tun #MakeAnImpact!
  • Echte Zusammenarbeit: keine Silos, keine Eitelkeiten – wir haben schließlich alle die gleiche Vision vor Augen #ValueFocus!
  • Zugang zu allen Caspar-Angeboten im Bereich mentale & physische Gesundheit #HealthyTogether!
  • Und ja – Alle Snack-Wünsche die das Herz begehrt, gemeinsame Sport-Sessions, ein nie endender Getränke Kühlschrank & eine gute Portion Humor gibt’s auch

Was uns als Team ausmacht

  • Wir leben Vielfalt – Diversität ist bei uns kein Aushängeschild, sondern Alltag

  • Feedback ist kein Tool, sondern Teil unserer Kultur

  • Wir glauben daran, dass Technologie nur dann sinnvoll ist, wenn sie Menschen hilft

  • Unser Antrieb ist Purpose – aber unser Anspruch ist Professionalität

dein kontakt

Hannah Christiani, Talent Acquisition Specialist

Außerdem sind wir an deinem frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin und deinen Gehaltsvorstellungen interessiert. Solltest du weitere Fragen haben, wende dich bitte an . Wir werden uns so schnell wie möglich mit dir in Verbindung setzen.

Unser Produkt CASPAR Health wird im Umfeld von medizinischen Einrichtungen, Patient*innen, Ärzt*innen und Therapeut*innen eingesetzt. Zu unserem beruflichen Alltag gehört es, mit (sensiblen) personenbezogenen Daten (z.B. Gesundheitsdaten) zu arbeiten. Daher fordern wir von unseren Mitarbeiter*innen ein hohes Commitment zum Schutz personenbezogener Daten ein, um die Rechte der Betroffenen bestmöglich zu schützen.

Diversität und Inklusion:Bei Caspar Health sind wir bestrebt, für alle Casparianer*innen eine freundliche, sichere und einladende Umgebung zu bieten, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Geschlechtsidentität und -ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, Einschränkungen aller Art, körperlicher Erscheinung, sozialer Herkunft, Alter oder Religion (oder deren Nichtvorhandensein).
Bei Deiner Bewerbung stehen für uns Deine Erfahrung und Motivation im Vordergrund. Du entscheidest, welche zusätzlichen Informationen du preisgeben möchtest (Bild, Familienstand, Religion, Geschlecht, Nationalität, etc.). Wir schätzen und behandeln alle Bewerbungen gleich.

Hinweis zum Datenschutz:

Bitte bewirb Dich ausschließlich über unseren Bewerbungslink, da wir nur so den Schutz Deiner Daten gewährleisten können. Unsere Datenschutzerklärung findest Du hier.

jobs.description:
Senior Engineer, Network Security- Remote

Location: Brentwood, TN | Remote

*Potential for up to 10% travel

Lifepoint Health has an opportunity for a Senior Engineer, Network Security!

About Lifepoint Health:

Lifepoint Health is a leading healthcare provider driven by a mission of Making Communities Healthier®. Our diversified healthcare delivery network spans 34 states and includes 68 community hospital campuses, more than 70 rehabilitation and behavioral health hospitals, and more than 300 additional sites of care across the healthcare continuum, including acute rehabilitation units, outpatient centers, and post-acute care facilities. We believe our success is achieved through talented people and are committed to creating places where employees want to work, with opportunities to build meaningful and rewarding careers that make a lasting difference in communities across the country.

Summary:

The Senior Network Security Engineer is responsible for interfacing directly with end-users and vendors to assess, recommend, design, and implement network security solutions, firewall rules, and policies. Manage Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet security devices. Conduct regular network reviews to identify opportunities to improve security posture. This role requires a strong networking, infrastructure, systems, and software background and will focus heavily on designing, deploying, managing, securing, and troubleshooting enterprise security infrastructure. The ideal candidate should be a self-starter and self-motivator, flexible, and able to excel at multi-tasking and flourish in a fast-paced, challenging environment.

Essential Functions:

  • Serves as Network Security lead on multifunctional project teams within IT and across lines of business.
  • Participates in network security planning, design, and implementation efforts.
  • Serves as an escalation point for complex network security and remote connectivity challenges; collaborates cross-functionally with engineering and operations teams to gather requirements, design secure solutions, and communicate best practices.
  • Provides subject matter expertise on network security, firewalls, zero-trust architectures, and industry best practices.
  • Designs and implements firewall rules to support business needs while maintaining adherence to security policies and best practices.
  • Configures and maintains firewalls, VPN, and IPSEC tunnel solutions. Vendors include Palo Alto, Cisco, and Fortinet.
  • Configures and maintains Palo Alto Prisma Access SASE to secure internet egress for locations transitioning to SD-WAN, partnering with network engineering and other teams on broader deployment efforts.
  • Works with the Cybersecurity team to identify opportunities to improve network security and implement solutions to mitigate risks.
  • Performs periodic firewall reviews, evaluates against company standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best-practices.
  • Configures, deploys, and supports VPN clients across multiple platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android) while performing advanced troubleshooting of complex connectivity and performance issues.
  • Applies upgrades, system patches, performs periodic maintenance, and continuously improves the reliability and security posture of the environment.
  • Works with management to develop, communicate, implement, and maintain network policies, standards, and procedures.

jobs.title: Director of Technology & AI
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT 321 THE AGENCY321 is a full-funnel creative agency built for brands that operate in complex, regulated industries — healthcare, insurance, legal services, home services, entertainment, and travel and tourism.
jobs.description:
ABOUT 321 THE AGENCY

321 is a full-funnel creative agency built for brands that operate in complex, regulated industries — healthcare, insurance, legal services, home services, entertainment, and travel and tourism. We're a remote, AI-first team that combines strategic creative with CRM infrastructure, performance marketing, and paid media to drive real, measurable business outcomes for our clients.

Technology isn't a support function at 321 — it's the foundation everything else runs on. Our CRM builds, paid media measurement, AI workflows, and client reporting all depend on systems that are well-architected, secure, and connected. The Director of Technology is the leader who makes that foundation work as one.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As Director of Technology at 321, you will lead the agency's technology function across internal systems, MarTech and CRM infrastructure, data and integrations, AI enablement, and information security. This is a senior leadership role with real strategic authority — you'll own the agency's technology roadmap, set standards for how our platforms are built and governed, and serve as the senior technical voice in client strategy, new business, and agency planning conversations.

The right person for this role thinks in systems, not tools. You understand that a CRM workflow is only as reliable as the integration feeding it, that clean data is the difference between real attribution and guesswork, and that AI only creates leverage when it's built into the way a team actually works. You're as comfortable reviewing a webhook payload or a High Level workflow as you are presenting a technology roadmap to agency leadership — and you lead a team that delivers both.

You'll also work in close coordination with 321 AIM, the agency's proprietary performance marketing platform, ensuring that its technology, data flows, and integrations stay aligned with the systems that power our client programs.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Technology Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, manage, and grow the Technology department, including CRM/MarTech engineers, integration specialists, and systems administration
  • Own the agency's technology roadmap, aligning platform investments with client delivery needs, agency growth goals, and operational efficiency
  • Set the department's operating model: build standards, QA and testing practices, documentation requirements, change management, and support processes
  • Conduct regular 1:1s and performance reviews; provide technical coaching and actively develop team capabilities
  • Define role scopes, skill development paths, and staffing recommendations as the department grows to warrant additional headcount
  • Serve as the escalation point for system outages, integration failures, data issues, and complex technical questions across the client portfolio

Agency Systems, Infrastructure & Security

  • Own the agency's internal technology stack, including collaboration, project management, identity, file storage, and communication tools
  • Manage user access, single sign-on, device policies, and account provisioning and offboarding for a fully remote team
  • Establish and enforce information security policies, password and access standards, backup practices, and incident response procedures
  • Ensure agency and client systems meet applicable privacy and compliance requirements, including HIPAA, TCPA, A2P 10DLC, CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and CCPA
  • Manage technology vendors, licenses, contracts, and costs; evaluate build-versus-buy decisions

MarTech, CRM & Integration Architecture

  • Set architecture and governance standards for client CRM and marketing automation programs built primarily on High Level, with additional work in Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and HubSpot
  • Oversee integrations between CRMs, ad platforms, websites, call tracking, payment processors, and third-party systems using APIs, webhooks, and middleware such as Zapier, Make, or n8n
  • Standardize snapshots, templates, naming conventions, tagging, and data hygiene practices across client accounts
  • Lead technical discovery for new client onboarding and CRM migrations, including data mapping, cleansing, and cutover planning
  • Review complex builds for scalability, reliability, and maintainability before launch

AI Enablement & Automation

  • Champion the integration of AI across the agency — from internal operations and reporting to CRM personalization, conversational AI, and workflow automation
  • Evaluate, pilot, and roll out AI tools and LLM-powered solutions, with clear standards for data privacy, accuracy, and appropriate use
  • Build and maintain internal automations and AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort and improve delivery quality
  • Stay current on emerging AI and MarTech capabilities and proactively introduce relevant innovations to the agency and its clients

Data, Analytics & Measurement Infrastructure

  • Own the agency's data and measurement infrastructure, including conversion tracking, Google Tag Manager, GA4, server-side tracking, and offline conversion imports
  • Partner with the Director of Digital Marketing to ensure lead source tracking, cost-per-lead reporting, and audience syndication between CRMs and ad platforms work reliably
  • Build and maintain data pipelines and reporting infrastructure that feed client dashboards in Looker Studio, Power BI, or similar tools
  • Establish data quality standards and monitoring across connected systems

Client Engagement & Agency Growth

  • Serve as the senior technology authority in client strategy sessions, QBRs, and new business pitches — translating technical solutions into clear, business-outcome terms
  • Contribute technology recommendations, solution architecture, and implementation estimates to agency proposals and RFP responses
  • Partner with 321 AIM on shared clients and platform needs to ensure technology, data flows, and lead infrastructure are coordinated and mutually reinforcing
  • Identify opportunities to productize repeatable technology solutions into new agency service offerings

WHAT YOU HAVE

  • 8+ years of experience in technology, MarTech, or systems roles, with demonstrated depth in CRM architecture, integrations, and data infrastructure — agency experience strongly preferred
  • At least 2–3 years in a department leadership, team lead, or senior manager role with direct reports
  • Hands-on experience architecting and governing CRM and marketing automation programs in High Level is strongly preferred; Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and/or HubSpot experience also valued
  • Deep experience with APIs, webhooks, and middleware (Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar), including troubleshooting integrations across multiple systems
  • Strong command of conversion tracking and measurement infrastructure: Google Tag Manager, GA4, server-side tracking, and offline conversion imports
  • Working knowledge of data pipelines, data warehousing, and reporting tools (BigQuery, Looker Studio, Power BI, or similar)
  • Experience administering cloud-based business systems, identity and access management, and security for a remote team
  • Working knowledge of privacy and compliance requirements affecting marketing technology in regulated industries, including HIPAA, TCPA, A2P 10DLC, CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and CCPA
  • Practical experience deploying AI tools and LLM-powered workflows, with sound judgment on data privacy and appropriate use
  • Scripting or development ability in JavaScript, Python, SQL, or similar is a strong plus
  • Excellent communication skills — able to explain technical decisions clearly to clients, agency leadership, and non-technical teammates
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to manage department operations across a remote, multi-client environment
  • Platform certifications (High Level, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google, cloud or security certifications) are a plus
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Marketing Technology, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated experience

REPORTING STRUCTURE

The Director of Technology reports directly to the SVP of Strategy and is a member of the agency's leadership team. This role directly manages the Technology department, encompassing CRM/MarTech engineers, integration specialists, and systems administration. The Director of Technology maintains a working relationship with 321 AIM leadership to align platform technology and data infrastructure, and collaborates closely with the Director of Digital Marketing, Director of Client Strategy, and Creative Director on integrated account delivery.

COMPENSATION

Salary Range: $100K+ annually, based on experience

321 uses a structured compensation framework aligned to role scope, department impact, and agency revenue contribution. Salary placement within range is based on demonstrated experience, leadership depth, and technical breadth across CRM, integrations, data, and AI. Performance bonus eligibility applies at the director level.

321 BENEFITS

  • 100% remote work environment
  • Flexible scheduling with core collaboration hours
  • Paid time off + agency-observed holidays
  • Professional development and platform/tool access budget
  • Collaborative, AI-forward team culture that values innovation and continuous learning
  • Opportunity to build and lead the technology foundation of a high-growth agency operating at the intersection of performance marketing and marketing technology
Salary: $100,000+ based on experience
