jobs.excerpt: Job Description A bit more about this role: Devoted Medical was founded on the belief that if we treat each patient like we would our loved ones, we can meaningfully improve healthcare experiences and outcomes for some of America’s most vulnerable patient populations.
jobs.description:
Job Description

A bit more about this role:

Devoted Medical was founded on the belief that if we treat each patient like we would our loved ones, we can meaningfully improve healthcare experiences and outcomes for some of America’s most vulnerable patient populations. We help members navigate the healthcare system in a better and safer way. This means getting the right care at the right place at the right time.

Our virtual Palliative Care program serves Devoted members with complex needs and life-limiting illness who otherwise would not have access to specialized palliative care. We pride ourselves on providing highly compassionate, patient-centered goals of care counseling, advanced care planning and symptom management for members projected to be in the final year of life. We meet patients where they are and support them in defining quality of life, achieving meaningful goals, and transitioning to hospice care.

Virtual, multi-state palliative care is a novel concept and we are looking for a highly motivated, innovative, experienced palliative care nurse practitioner to help build the foundation of our clinical team. Our ideal NP is an expert palliative clinician with excellent communication and team-building skills who is adaptable to a continuously evolving startup environment.

Skills and experience:

Required:

  • Must possess a current, active, and unrestricted Nurse Practitioner (NP) or Physician Assistant (PA) license in at least one U.S. state.

  • Must be willing to obtain additional state licenses as required by the business. (We provide administrative assistance and cover 100% of the associated fees.)

  • 5 years in advanced practice, with at least 3 in Palliative care

  • ACHPN® credential, or ability/ willingness to obtain within first six months of employment

  • Willingness to flex between time zones

  • Comfortable with technology and a fast-paced environment

  • Self-starter with ability to succeed in a work-from-home environment

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills

  • Comfort working within an interprofessional care team

Preferred:

  • ELNEC® or EPEC® training

  • Prior ICU, oncology or geriatrics nursing experience

  • Prior home-based palliative care experience

  • Prior interprofessional team leadership experience

  • Prior program development experience

A Day in the life:

  • Panel management

    • Perform initial assessments and develop Palliative Plans of Care for members newly enrolling to the Palliative Care Program.

    • Follow a longitudinal panel of the highest risk patients via regular telephonic and/or video encounters.

    • Provide consultative visits to patients empaneled to the RNs, including but not limited to: advanced symptom management; complex goals of care; advanced disease education; prognostication; medical orders for home health, DME, medications, and hospice transitions.

    • Evaluate hospital admissions for root-cause; support transitions of care for engaged patients, identify trends in readmissions and help develop solutions for achieving/ maintaining readmission rate less than or equal to 15%

  • Required Palliative team activities:

    • Regular huddles with clinical & ops team members

    • Weekly interprofessional team meetings

    • Monthly panel reviews with your Medical Director & Operations Manager

    • Help support the team during periods of rapid growth or PTO/absences; you may be asked to help man the phone line, make outreach calls, perform initial visits, monitor incoming consults, etc.

    • Collaborate with interdepartmental clinical teams and leadership to help coordinate seamless care of shared patients

  • Required Devoted Medical activities:

    • Attend Devoted Medical meetings as role appropriate. These may include but not limited to All-Hands, Clinical Excellence and Orinoco Updates meetings

    • Provide on-call weekend/holiday coverage on a rotating basis

    • Support the Devoted Health mission by caring for members like family

Attributes to success:

  • You have great clinical and non-clinical judgment.

  • You are thorough and take the time to address the needs of your patients.

  • You understand that seamless interprofessional teamwork and communication is fundamental to the success of a palliative care program; you prioritize caring for yourself and your teammates with patience, compassion, curiosity, and resilience.

  • You are deeply empathetic and humanistic, and want to go the last mile for your patients.

  • You are comfortable working with members over video and phone.

  • You enjoy a fast-paced, high-energy, organization. Agility and collaboration are key as we will change and improve quickly.

  • You are comfortable engaging and learning new technologies including electronic health records, operating systems and programs (Google Office, Slack). You thrive on knowing your work can help make these technologies better for you and your patients.

  • You learn from every experience and are not afraid to fail - that's how you're wired.

  • Finally and most importantly, you have a passion for making healthcare better for patients with serious illness, solving complex problems, and supporting the delivery of healthcare that we would want for our own family members.

Salary Range: $120K-155K base range plus performance based bonus paid out quarterly or annually ($10K-$20K) for a total comp range of $130K-170K

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.


Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. We value diversity and collaboration. Individuals are respected for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is embodied in Devoted’s Code of Conduct, our company values and the way we do business.

A BigDataCorp é a maior datatech da América Latina, e democratiza, desde 2013, o acesso aos dados, aumentando possibilidades e certezas em um mundo repleto de incertezas.

Somos pioneiros na captura, estruturação, armazenamento e distribuição de dados no Brasil. Nosso processo é único. Já nascemos adequados à LGPD e às demais regulamentações, garantindo a origem das informações fornecidas, obtidas sempre de forma ética.

Sobre a área e a vaga

A equipe de P&D tem como principais funções a exploração e validação de novas tecnologias, o desenvolvimento de Provas de Conceito (POCs) e a estruturação de novos bancos de dados. A equipe dedica uma parte significativa de seu tempo e esforço à pesquisa, realização de testes de viabilidade e documentação técnica, em vez de se concentrar exclusivamente no desenvolvimento e na manutenção de rotinas em produção.

Requirements

O que vai fazer no dia a dia

  • Pesquisa e execução: Conduzir experimentos, testes ou provas de conceito a partir de novas tecnologias de mercado.

Economics & Market

About the Role:

Do you have a background in Economics or Finance? AI models are often used to summarize market trends, explain supply and demand, or give business advice, but they can sometimes get the "logic of money" wrong. At TELUS Digital, we are looking for people who understand how economies work to help our AI become a better financial thinker. You don’t need to be a data scientist—you just need to use your degree to keep the AI’s economic facts and reasoning accurate.

What You’ll Do (Simple Tasks):

  • Check Economic Logic: Read an AI’s explanation of a market event and make sure it correctly understands concepts like inflation, interest rates, or opportunity cost.

  • Verify Data & Trends: Look at simple charts or economic summaries generated by the AI and ensure the numbers and conclusions match real-world data.

  • Review Business Advice: If the AI is asked to help a small business with pricing or competition, you check to make sure its advice follows sound economic principles.

  • Local Market Context: Help the AI understand how the economy works in your specific country, including local currencies and regional trade habits.

Qualification path

Mandatory Qualifications:

  • Education: A minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in Economics, Finance, or International Trade

  • Native Language: Native-level proficiency in your primary language. We need experts who understand how economic terms are used in their home markets.

  • English Proficiency: Basic (B1) English so you can follow project guidelines.

Analytical Thinking: You are good at looking at a situation and seeing the "cause and effect" behind the numbers.

In order to be hired into our community, you’ll go through a subject-specific qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification.

About the Role

Our client is a US-based healthcare organization seeking an experienced Medical Billing Coordinator to join their Customer Service team. This role sits at the front line of patient access — handling inbound and outbound calls, verifying insurance benefits, scheduling appointments, and ensuring that every patient interaction is handled with accuracy, professionalism, and care.

This is not an entry-level position. The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience in US healthcare call center operations, a solid working knowledge of insurance verification and benefits, and the ability to navigate payer portals and EHR systems with confidence.

Key Responsibilities

Insurance Verification and Benefits (VOB)

  • Verify patient insurance eligibility, network status, and active coverage prior to appointments
  • Confirm deductibles, copays, coinsurance, out-of-pocket maximums, and service-specific benefits
  • Identify referral requirements and prior authorization (PA) needs by payer and service type
  • Navigate payer portals and contact insurance carriers directly to verify benefits when portal information is insufficient
  • Accurately document all insurance verification details in the EMR/EHR

Patient Communication

  • Handle inbound patient calls with professionalism, warmth, and efficiency
  • Make outbound calls to patients for scheduling, benefit confirmations, document collection, and follow-up
  • Clearly communicate insurance benefit information to patients in plain, understandable language
  • Address patient questions and concerns with patience and accuracy

Scheduling and Administrative Support

  • Schedule, reschedule, and confirm patient appointments across providers and service lines
  • Process referrals and coordinate with internal teams and external providers as needed
  • Verify and update patient demographic information to maintain accurate records
  • Maintain complete and organized documentation across all patient interactions and transactions

What This Role Requires

Required Experience

  • Demonstrated experience in a US healthcare call center environment — this is a firm requirement
  • Hands-on experience conducting insurance verification and benefits checks (VOB) for US payers
  • Working knowledge of deductibles, copays, coinsurance, out-of-pocket costs, and benefit structures across commercial and government payers
  • Experience identifying referral and prior authorization requirements by payer
  • Proficiency navigating payer portals and contacting insurance carriers
  • Experience documenting insurance verification and patient interactions in an EMR or EHR system
  • Medical scheduling experience, including referral coordination

Skills and Attributes

  • Detail oriented. Accurate verification and documentation are the foundation of this role — errors have real consequences for patients and the practice.
  • Organized and dependable. You manage a high volume of calls and tasks without losing accuracy or follow-through.
  • Clear and professional communicator. You speak with patients and insurance representatives confidently and with care.
  • Patient and composed. You handle difficult conversations, confused patients, and complex payer situations calmly and professionally.
  • HIPAA aware. You handle all patient information with discretion and in full compliance with HIPAA requirements.

Technical Requirements

  • EMR/EHR proficiency — required; specific system training provided
  • Payer portal navigation — required
  • Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace — proficient
  • Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet dedicated workspace, and a quality headset

Work Details

  • Schedule: Full-time, Monday through Friday, aligned to US business hours
  • Location: Fully remote
  • Call volume: Mix of inbound and outbound patient calls
  • Compliance: HIPAA-compliant environment required

Who Will Thrive Here

This role is the right fit for someone who has worked in US healthcare call center operations and understands the pace, the stakes, and the standards that come with it. You know your way around a payer portal, you verify benefits without cutting corners, and you communicate with patients in a way that puts them at ease. If you take pride in getting the details right and following through on every task, we want to hear from you.

This is a full time role

Up to $6/hr

100% Remote

If you have experience in luxury sales, private aviation, high-ticket services, hospitality, travel, real estate, financial services, or other relationship-driven sales environments, this could be an excellent fit.

  • Contribute directly to revenue and booking growth

On-Call Client Coverage

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You’re polished, confident, and highly professional with clients
  • You understand how to sell high-ticket products or services
  • You build trust naturally rather than relying on aggressive sales tactics
  • You’re comfortable communicating with executives and affluent clientele
  • You respond quickly and understand that speed can determine whether a deal closes

  • You understand the importance of discretion and confidentiality
  • You enjoy building relationships that lead to repeat business

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven success in:
    • Sales
    • Business Development
    • Account Management
    • Client Relationship Management
  • Experience selling high-ticket products or services strongly preferred
  • Exceptional spoken and written English
  • Strong consultative selling and relationship-building skills
  • Demonstrated ability to close sales and manage client relationships
  • Strong follow-up and organizational discipline
  • Experience using CRM platforms and sales tools
  • Ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, performance-driven sales environment
  • Flexibility to support clients outside standard hours when scheduled

Highly Preferred Experience

Experience within one or more of the following:

  • Private aviation or jet charter
  • Luxury travel
  • Yacht charter
  • Luxury hospitality
  • Concierge services
  • Executive services
  • Luxury real estate
  • Financial services
  • Other high-ticket, relationship-driven sales environments

Additional advantages include:

  • Familiarity with Avinode or similar charter platforms
  • Knowledge of private aircraft categories and cabin configurations
  • Understanding of charter operations
  • Experience serving high-net-worth or ultra-high-net-worth clients
  • Familiarity with cryptocurrency transactions

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start by reviewing active charter inquiries and following up with clients considering flight options.

Throughout the day, you’ll speak with prospective and existing clients, understand their travel requirements, recommend appropriate solutions, coordinate with operations, manage bookings, and follow up on active opportunities.

You’ll keep the CRM current, maintain visibility across your pipeline, and ensure clients receive prompt communication throughout their journey.

In short: you turn qualified private aviation inquiries into booked flights while building trusted client relationships that generate repeat business.

Apply Now

jobs.excerpt: Your Future Evolves HereEvolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions.
jobs.description:
Your Future Evolves Here

Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.

Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Role Overview

As a Senior Platform Engineer in Evolent's Platform Engineering & Operations (PEO) organization, you will build, automate, and improve the cloud and infrastructure platforms that Evolent's applications run on. You will work inside one PEO function and be measured on how much manual effort you remove from the way Evolent delivers and operates technology.


Why This Role Matters

Evolent is transforming how it builds and operates infrastructure under a refreshed Platform Engineering & Operations operating model, grounded in four principles: Architecture First, Automation by Default, Reliability is a Shared Responsibility and Golden Paths Over Custom Solutions. You will turn approved designs into provisioned, automated, and documented platforms, and you will do it transparently, through formal handoffs, Office Hours reviews, and documentation your peers can actually rely on.


Agentic AI: Platform Engineering is moving toward agentic AI as a standard part of how the organization works. As agentic AI transforms the way we work, we expect our engineers to be at the forefront of that change, designing and building intelligent solutions rather than simply consuming them. This builder mentality is a core attribute we assess from the first conversation.


What You'll Be Doing

  • Provision and change infrastructure exclusively as code, so that every environment is reproducible, reviewable, and free of manual drift.
  • Reverse engineer the applications and infrastructure you inherit: trace dependencies, integrations, and data flows end to end until you can explain how a system actually works.
  • Design and build agentic AI solutions for platform, delivery, and operations work: identify the toil worth automating, then build, evaluate, and harden the agent that removes it.
  • Build security and compliance into the delivery path: least-privilege access, secrets handling, policy-as-code guardrails, and audit evidence produced by design rather than assembled under deadline.
  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines that deliver consistent, secure, and repeatable deployments.
  • Enable container-based application delivery on Docker and Kubernetes, with a focus on Azure Kubernetes Service and Azure Container Apps.
  • Build reusable cloud-native infrastructure, pipelines, and self-service capabilities that support secure and scalable delivery, including AI and ML workloads.
  • Develop APIs, automation scripts, and platform integrations that remove repeat manual requests from engineering teams.
  • Support and guide application teams through containerization and modern deployment patterns, and debug complex issues across the application, platform, and infrastructure layers.
  • Work within agile delivery practices such as Kanban, Scrumban, and sprints to plan and deliver your work transparently.

What You'll Need to Be Successful

  • 5-7 years of hands-on experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or a related discipline, with demonstrated ownership of enterprise-scale cloud platforms and automation initiatives.
  • Demonstrates humility, openness to feedback, and a team-first mindset.
  • Comfortable with a high level of transparency, surfacing risks and mistakes early.
  • Ability to create high-quality technical diagrams and documentation.
  • Deep knowledge of agentic AI concepts: agents and tool use, orchestration, context and retrieval, evaluation, guardrails, and the limits of each. This is one of the most important requirements for the role, because every person in Platform Engineering & Operations is expected to become a builder of agentic AI solutions rather than only a user of them.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to reverse engineer application architecture: take an unfamiliar application and the infrastructure under it, trace its components, dependencies, and data flows.
  • Working fluency in Infrastructure as Code and Configuration as Code. Terraform and Ansible are Evolent's standard tooling.
  • A DevOps mindset: you debug complex systems patiently, automate manual work by default, and treat operational excellence as part of the job rather than afterthought.
  • Proficiency in a modern language such as Python, Go, or TypeScript, used to build APIs, automation frameworks, and platform integrations.
  • A solid grasp of software design principles, testing strategies, and code quality standards, applied to automation and platform code.

Domain Expertise — DevOps

  • CI/CD pipeline engineering depth: Experience designing, building, and scaling pipelines in GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines, including branching and release strategy, artifact and dependency management, and automated quality and security gates.
  • Container and artifact management in production: Experience with Docker and Kubernetes on Azure Kubernetes Service and Azure Container Apps, Helm packaging, and GitOps-based delivery with ArgoCD.
  • Experience with infrastructure and configuration automation at production scale with Terraform and Ansible, provisioning infrastructure exclusively as code.
  • Working knowledge of the Azure services that carry delivery, including Azure Functions, Logic Apps, ACA, and Service Fabric, with a practical grasp of identity, networking fundamentals, and cost awareness.
  • Scale and environment context: Experience with production healthcare workloads under HIPAA and SOC 2, where deployment reliability, change discipline, and audit evidence are non-negotiable.

Nice to Have (Preferred)

  • Experience applying agentic AI concepts, whether through professional experience, personal projects, academic work, or other relevant initiatives: what it does, the choices you made, what failed, and what you would change.
  • Proficiency in a scripting or programming language used for automation and tooling, such as Python, Go, PowerShell, or Bash.
  • Experience in a regulated environment, for example healthcare and HIPAA, SOC 2, or similar.
  • Familiarity with CNCF projects such as ArgoCD, Kyverno, and KEDA.
  • Experience building the delivery path for AI and ML workloads, including the infrastructure and pipelines those workloads depend on.

Certifications (Preferred)

  • Relevant Azure certifications (e.g AZ-104, AZ-400, or AZ-305).
  • HashiCorp Terraform Associate preferred, or equivalent.
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) preferred, or equivalent.

Academic Qualification

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.

To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in-person I-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration.

jobs.excerpt: RemoteThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

The United States Based Salary range for this role is: 140,000-200,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Refer them!

The Financial Post is looking for an experienced, ambitious editor to join our editorial leadership team as National Bureau Chief. Based in Toronto, the National Bureau Chief will play a central role in shaping our coverage of Canadian business and the economy from coast to coast. You will work closely with senior editors in Toronto and regional bureau chiefs across the country to identify the stories that matter and sharpen our national coverage. The role also includes directing a team of reporters in Ontario and Quebec.

This is a role for an editor with strong news judgment who can see beyond the day's headlines, identify the forces driving the news and help reporters produce journalism that is timely, authoritative and valuable to Financial Post readers.

  • You are an experienced editor with at least five years in a daily newsroom, ideally with a background in business, financial or economic journalism

Who We Are

Mission Telecom is a 501(c)(4) nonprofit wireless broadband provider and grantmaking foundation. We partner with nonprofits, schools, and libraries to close the digital divide through reliable, affordable wireless broadband and connected devices, and through Mission Telecom Giving, we fund social impact organizations working to advance equity and justice. Our grantmaking focuses on multiracial democracy, movement infrastructure and innovation, and telecom justice, including broadband affordability policy.

About the Role

The Senior Manager of Growth Marketing and Communications leads two connected mandates. For our broadband program, you will build a repeatable B2B marketing engine that generates qualified demand and drives revenue growth. For Mission Telecom Giving, our grantmaking program, you will build the public communications and thought-leadership platform. We expect about 75% of your time on broadband and 25% on Giving.

This role reports jointly to Mission Telecom's Executive Director and the Executive Director of Mission Telecom Giving. It is a hands-on leadership role: you will set strategy, run campaigns, work directly with our partnerships team, manage specialized partners when needed, and use data to keep improving results. The Giving work is supported by a communications consulting firm that knows the grants program.

The broadband work centers on six core growth programs: targeted email and nurture; sales-aligned outbound and account-based marketing; website, SEO, and conversion optimization; associations, cooperatives, and strategic partners; webinars and targeted conferences; and customer expansion and referrals.

Case studies, LinkedIn, paid search, retargeting, PR, direct mail, and selective sponsorships support these programs rather than run on their own. If you want to build a marketing system from the ground up instead of inheriting one, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

Mission Telecom Broadband Program (75% of time)

Demand Generation and Campaigns

  • Build and manage an always-on demand generation engine around our priority products and offers, including hotspots, fixed wireless, mobile phone service, connected devices, and savings opportunities.

Account-Based Marketing and Sales Alignment

  • Build targeted account-based marketing programs for high-value organizations, including school districts, library systems, nonprofits, and other eligible organizations.

Email, Nurture, and Lifecycle Marketing

  • Develop segmented email and nurture programs that convert inbound leads, move prospects toward purchase, and reactivate older leads and customers.

Website and Conversion Optimization

  • Own the marketing contribution to website conversion, including landing pages, product and vertical pages, messaging, calls to action, forms, value propositions, and conversion paths.
  • Develop product-by-vertical content that addresses prospect needs.
  • Use analytics and experimentation to improve qualified-lead conversion and lead quality.

Sales Enablement

  • Equip sales with practical, current tools, including case studies, one-pagers, comparison sheets, presentations, email templates, proposal content, customer proof, and objection-handling resources.

Content, Events, and Thought Leadership

  • Develop content that supports demand generation, including customer stories, webinars, guides, newsletters, educational resources, thought leadership, and quantified customer proof.
  • Turn conferences, sponsorships, and webinars into measurable pipeline through coordinated pre-event targeting, engagement, and post-event follow-up with sales.

Marketing Operations and Analytics

  • Own marketing operations across lead routing, automation, segmentation, attribution, CRM discipline, funnel definitions, dashboards, and reporting, in alignment with sales.
  • Measure performance across the funnel and identify conversion gaps.
  • Report on marketing-sourced pipeline and revenue, marketing-influenced revenue, acquisition cost, conversion rates, and marketing ROI.

Paid Acquisition

  • Manage targeted paid acquisition across channels such as Google Search, LinkedIn, retargeting, and affiliate marketing, prioritizing high-intent audiences and target accounts over broad awareness.
  • Set clear performance benchmarks, optimize campaigns, and scale spending where pipeline and ROI can be shown.

Agency and Vendor Management

  • Manage external agencies, consultants, and vendors supporting website development, creative and design, public relations, paid media, SEO/AEO, content, and other specialized marketing work within an approved annual budget.
  • Set clear scopes, priorities, timelines, budgets, and performance expectations for external partners.
  • Coordinate partner work across internal teams and hold vendors accountable for quality, results, and return on investment.

Mission Telecom Giving Communications (25% of time)

Communications Strategy

  • Own Giving's editorial calendar and work with external vendors supporting writing, design, PR, and other communications needs.
  • Set and report against measurable communications goals, including earned media, thought-leadership placements, website and email engagement, social reach, partner amplification, audience growth, and visibility with priority philanthropy and policy audiences.
  • Develop and maintain a rapid-response protocol for reputational or political developments touching our issue areas.
  • Support board communications for Mission Telecom Giving, including board updates and materials prepared with the Executive Director of Mission Telecom Giving.

Thought Leadership and Content

  • Support Mission Telecom Giving's thought leadership and social media across our grantmaking pillars: multiracial democracy, movement infrastructure and innovation, and telecom justice.
  • Produce public-facing work such as reports, articles, op-eds, social media, and email.
  • Translate grantmaking insights, portfolio outcomes, and policy and sector developments into compelling narratives, such as annual reports, for philanthropic, policy, and partner audiences.

Other Responsibilities

What Success Looks Like

Broadband Program

  • Monthly qualified lead generation
  • Growth in marketing-sourced pipeline and closed revenue
  • Growth in marketing-sourced new lines of service
  • Improved lead-to-opportunity and website-to-qualified-lead conversion

Mission Telecom Giving

  • Growth in earned media placements and thought-leadership citations in philanthropy and policy publications
  • Clear influence on how peer funders and policy audiences talk about our issue areas
  • Timely, high-quality board and public communications support for the Executive Director of Mission Telecom Giving

  • Experience building and running account-based marketing (ABM) programs with a sales team, including target-account lists, coordinated outreach, and shared lead definitions.
  • Experience with marketing operations, attribution, full-funnel reporting, conversion optimization, and testing, and the ability to turn data into decisions.

  • Experience with partner, channel, or referral marketing, such as programs run through associations or cooperatives.
  • Experience with earned media and thought leadership, such as pitching reporters, placing op-eds, managing an editorial calendar, or handling rapid response.
  • Strong writing across sales copy and policy-literate thought leadership, with the range to keep each voice distinct.
  • Experience managing outside agencies, freelancers, technology vendors, or specialized partners within a set budget.
  • Sound judgment in managing competing priorities across two reporting lines, and the discipline to focus resources on programs that produce measurable results.
  • Travel up to 10% for conferences and events.

  • Experience marketing to K-12 school districts, libraries and library systems, nonprofits and foundations, government or public-sector organizations, or other institutional buyers.
  • Experience selling into organizations with complex procurement processes.
  • Experience in telecommunications, wireless, connectivity, technology, SaaS, or other recurring-revenue B2B businesses.
  • Interest in philanthropy and policy, ideally touching multiracial democracy, movement infrastructure, or telecom and broadband justice, or the ability to learn quickly.
  • Familiarity with E-Rate or other public funding that schools and libraries use to buy connectivity.
  • Experience in foundation, philanthropy, or policy advocacy communications.
  • Experience as a first or solo marketing hire who built the function from the ground up.
  • Experience at a nonprofit, social enterprise, or other mission-driven organization working with a lean budget.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully paid medical, dental, vision, short- and long-term disability, and life/AD&D insurance
  • 85% of dependent coverage for medical, dental, and vision
  • Partial phone and internet reimbursement
  • 5% Safe Harbor contribution into a 401(k)
  • Unlimited PTO plus 14 paid holidays per year

Our Culture

Mission Telecom fosters an environment of innovation, collaboration, and purpose-driven work. We align ourselves with staff, partners, and clients who are passionate about creating measurable impact and expanding access to opportunity.

How to Apply

Apply online via Mission Telecom's Greenhouse platform by October 20, 2026. Please include a cover letter and a resume that shows your experience relevant to this position.

We encourage you to include a portfolio or examples of your work, such as campaigns, landing pages, email sequences, dashboards, case studies, or published writing. jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

The United States Based Salary range for this role is: 140,000-200,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Business Automation & Systems Specialist (Zoho, PHP, AI)

Compensation range: $2,000 - $3,000 AUD Monthly

Engagement type:Full-time, Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9:00AM - 6:00 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration.

Who We Are:

At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is:

The client is an Australian-based software company specialising in digital forensics, eDiscovery, and information-governance technology. They develop software that helps organisations search, analyse, and manage large volumes of electronic data for areas such as legal matters, investigations, compliance, and cybersecurity. Their products are used by enterprises, financial institutions, government agencies, and law-enforcement organisations.

Role Overview:

This isn’t your typical developer role. We’re looking for a MacGyver-type problem solver who can connect systems, build clever solutions, and make complex business processes run seamlessly. The ideal candidate is someone who combines technical capability with curiosity, initiative, and a strong “figure it out” mindset.

In this role, they’ll be responsible for building and managing the company website using PHP, automating financial and marketing workflows through Zoho and automated invoicing, configuring AI prompts, and developing smart chatbots that improve business productivity and operational efficiency. Formal qualifications are important, but practical capability, adaptability, and the ability to independently solve problems are equally valued.

Key Responsibilities

PHP & Website Development

• Build, maintain, and edit our custom company website code using PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
• Develop custom PHP scripts, template files, and backend functionalities or plugin/CMS extensions.
• Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize server-side PHP performance, database queries, and web forms.

Zoho & Automated Invoicing

• Configure, customize, and maintain Zoho (Zoho Books, CRM, Flow, Deluge, or Creator) to automate billing and invoicing workflows.
• Streamline recurring invoicing, payment gateways, automated payment reminders, and data sync between sales and finance systems.

AI Prompts & Chatbot Integration

• Build, train, and deploy AI chatbots for client engagement, customer support, or internal queries.
• Engineer, optimize, and automate AI prompts (e.g., OpenAI/LLMs) to enhance operational efficiency, email drafting, and content processing.

Business Process & Marketing Automation

• Map, redesign, and automate routine business tasks, email marketing sequences, and cross-platform workflows using tools like Zapier, Zoho Flow, or custom PHP/API webhooks.
• Integrate marketing, web, and operational platforms to maintain high data integrity across all systems.

Documentation & Maintenance

• Produce clear, structured technical documentation for custom PHP code, AI prompts, integrations, and automated workflows.
• Proactively monitor, test, and debug existing automations and web infrastructure for speed, security, and reliability.

Requirements

• Strong proficiency in PHP backend web development alongside core frontend technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript).
• Hands-on experience with the Zoho Ecosystem (Zoho CRM, Zoho Books, Zoho Flow, Deluge scripting).
• Solid understanding of automated invoicing systems, billing logic, and payment gateway integrations.
• Direct experience building AI chatbots and optimizing AI/LLM prompt automation.
• Experience with APIs, webhooks, and custom integration development, as well as no-code/low-code tools (e.g., Zapier, Make).
• Strong understanding of business process mapping, conditional logic, and database management (MySQL or similar).

Professional & Personal Attributes

• Problem Solver: A proactive "MacGyver" mindset—you take ownership from idea to deployment and enjoy figuring things out.
• Business Acumen: Ability to translate non-technical business requirements into reliable technical solutions.
• Attention to Detail: Excellent debugging skills and a high standard for data accuracy, web security, and workflow reliability.
• Autonomy & Collaboration: Comfortable working independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams.

Why Join our client?

• Real Impact: Work in a nimble team where your PHP code and automated solutions directly save time, increase efficiency, and drive growth.
• Autonomy & Flexibility: Enjoy freedom in how you solve technical problems and build systems from the ground up.
• Diverse Tech Stack: A dynamic role blending PHP development, business logic, AI tools, and system integration.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

jobs.excerpt: RemoteThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

The Lithuania Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-90,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

jobs.excerpt: RemoteThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

The France Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-100,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Refer them!

jobs.description:
​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: E-Commerce Marketing & Content Creator

Compensation range: $900 AUD - $1,400 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type:Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: The company is an Australian sports nutrition and supplements brand selling direct to consumers online, with a growing wholesale and ambassador-driven distribution channel. The business is investing in its e-commerce foundations ahead of a major brand launch, including new ambassador partnerships and a build-out of a dedicated wholesale ordering platform for retail stockiest

Role Overview: You will own how the company looks and sells online. As the in-house designer and content creator, you will produce the graphics, photography and short-form video behind every campaign, keep Shopify storefront visually current, and run the company’s social media channels so that every launch and promotion lands with one message and one look, from the website banner to the last Instagram Story.

This is a hands-on creative role with a commercial edge. You will be the person who designs the campaign in Photoshop and Illustrator, updates the homepage, schedules the Reels and checks the results the next morning. We are looking for a strong graphic designer who understands what makes people buy, and who brings ideas to grow sales rather than waiting for a brief. Experience in sports nutrition or supplements is highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities:

Campaigns and Sales Growth

  • Plan and deliver campaigns for product launches, promotions, seasonal offers and key dates in the sporting calendar, working to the promotional calendar set with the E-Commerce Systems & Operations Manager.
  • Bring practical ideas to grow traffic, conversion and repeat purchase: bundles, launches, giveaways, collaborations and limited-time offers.
  • Line up every campaign across Shopify, social media, email, the mobile app and wholesale promotions: same message, same look, same launch date.
  • Track results (reach, engagement, click-through, conversion and revenue by campaign) and report monthly on what is working and what to change.
  • Communicate product benefits accurately and in line with Australian advertising rules for supplements and sports foods (TGA and Food Standards Code).

Graphic Design and Content Creation

  • Design campaign assets in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator: web banners, product tiles, promotional graphics, email headers, social posts, Stories, Reels covers and ad creative.
  • Produce, shoot and edit product photography and short-form video for products, athletes and promotions.
  • Take content from concept to final delivery, including copywriting, editing and exporting files to the right size and format for each platform.
  • Bring every SKU up to a consistent visual standard across fonts, graphics, product imagery and renders, as part of the clean-up of our current B2C store.
  • Create and maintain brand guidelines, design templates and an organised, searchable asset library.

Shopify Website and Campaign Updates

  • Update Shopify storefront graphics for each campaign: homepage banners, collection pages, product images and promotional sections.
  • Work with the E-Commerce Systems & Operations Manager on landing pages, product page presentation and A/B test creative.
  • Check that every graphic displays clearly and loads quickly on desktop and mobile before launch.
  • Design trade-facing promotional graphics for the wholesale (B2B) store, such as banners shown to logged-in trade accounts and pre-season offers.
  • Spot opportunities to improve the shopping experience and conversion, and raise them with the team.

Social Media

  • Plan, create, schedule and publish content across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube, adding Pinterest, LinkedIn or X only where our customers are.
  • Own a monthly content calendar tied to launches, promotions and business goals.
  • Grow and engage the community: reply to comments and DMs, encourage user-generated content and manage collaborations with athletes, ambassadors and creators.
  • Supply creative for paid social campaigns (Meta and TikTok ads), with variations built for testing.
  • Stay across trends, formats and competitor activity in sports nutrition, and turn them into content.

Mobile App and Membership

  • Create launch and ongoing creative for the Big E shopping app and paid membership programme: app store imagery, in-app banners and member-exclusive offer graphics.
  • Write and design push notifications and campaign assets that drive app downloads, member signups and repeat orders.

Operations and Stakeholders

  • Work closely with the E-Commerce Systems & Operations Manager, sales (wholesale), warehouse and customer service so that creative is ready before each launch.
  • Brief and manage external photographers, videographers or freelancers when needed, within agreed budgets.
  • Work independently from home, keeping the team updated on progress, deadlines and results.

Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications:

Must have

  • 3+ years in e-commerce marketing, content creation or graphic design, with extensive hands-on campaign work.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, supported by a strong portfolio of campaign and social media work.
  • Extensive experience across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube, including platform-specific formats and what performs on each.
  • Hands-on experience updating Shopify storefronts (themes, banners, collections, product images) or a comparable e-commerce platform.
  • Track record of content and campaigns that measurably grew audience, engagement or online sales.
  • Photo and short-form video skills: comfortable shooting product content and editing (Premiere Pro, CapCut or similar).
  • Working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and analytics (Meta Insights, Shopify Analytics, GA4), and the ability to turn data into practical improvements.
  • Strong eye for layout, typography and brand consistency, plus sharp copywriting for captions and promotions.
  • Organized, self-managing and reliable working from home part-time, juggling several campaigns against launch dates.

Nice to have

  • Experience in the sports nutrition, supplement, fitness or health industry.
  • Understanding of Australian advertising rules for supplements and sports foods.
  • Email marketing and customer retention campaigns (e.g. Klaviyo, Shopify Email).
  • Influencer, athlete and fitness creator partnerships.
  • Motion graphics (After Effects) and quick templating in Figma or Canva.
  • Experience in a wholesale-plus-retail business, or creating content for a mobile app or membership programme.
  • A genuine interest in training, sport or fitness.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)
