jobs.excerpt: Our team members are at the heart of everything we do.
jobs.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

The Senior Specialist, Pharmacovigilance System serves as the strategic and operational bridge between the Pharmacovigilance (PV) business/operations teams and the technical organization. This individual acts as the system champion, business representative, and end-to-end accountability owner for one or more pharmacovigilance platforms and integrated solutions — ensuring these systems meet regulatory, operational, and quality standards throughout their lifecycle.

This is a highly cross-functional role that requires a unique blend of deep PV domain expertise, systems thinking, stakeholder management, and a forward-looking understanding of emerging technologies including AI. This person ensures those technical workstreams are effectively directed and aligned to business needs.


Key Responsibilities

System Ownership and Governance

  • Serve as the accountable business system owner for PV-related platforms, including safety databases, signal management tools, medical information systems, literature monitoring solutions, and reporting platforms
  • Own and maintain the system roadmap, prioritizing enhancements, upgrades, and new feature rollouts in alignment with business strategy and regulatory requirements
  • Lead and manage system lifecycle activities — from business requirements definition, UAT, deployment, through to retirement — ensuring timely and quality delivery of all system milestones
  • Maintain and govern all business-owned system documentation, including Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), functional specifications, SOPs, user guides, and validation plans (in close collaboration with validation/QA teams)
  • Drive business sign-off and acceptance for all system changes, releases, and validation activities

Business–IT Liaison and Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact for all system-related matters between PV Operations, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Quality Assurance, and the Technical/IT organization
  • Translate complex business and regulatory needs into clear, actionable technical requirements for IT developers and vendors
  • Facilitate regular forums, governance meetings, and working groups to ensure alignment across business and technical stakeholders
  • Manage relationships with external system vendors and platform providers, including participating in vendor performance reviews, roadmap discussions, and contract input where applicable
  • Escalate risks, issues, and decisions through appropriate channels with clear business impact framing

System Champion and Change Enablement

  • Serve as the internal ambassador for PV systems — promoting best practices, driving adoption, and advocating for user-centric design
  • Lead change management efforts for system rollouts and upgrades, including communication planning, training coordination, and stakeholder engagement
  • Represent the PV systems landscape in cross-functional forums, steering committees, and process improvement initiatives
  • Champion the adoption of innovative technologies — including AI/ML-assisted capabilities — within the PV ecosystem, evaluating feasibility and business value in partnership with IT

Compliance, Quality & Regulatory Alignment

  • Ensure all systems under ownership comply with applicable global regulatory frameworks, including ICH E2B(R3), EMA EVMPD, FDA requirements, and GVP modules
  • Collaborate with Quality Assurance to ensure systems are maintained in a validated state in accordance with GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, and EU Annex 11
  • Support and participate in internal and external audits and regulatory inspections related to PV systems
  • Monitor the regulatory landscape and proactively identify impacts to systems from evolving guidance, communicating these to relevant stakeholders
  • Ensure data integrity, traceability, and audit trail standards are upheld across all system interactions

Operational Performance & Continuous Improvement

  • Define, track, and report on system KPIs and performance metrics, driving continuous improvement initiatives based on operational data
  • Identify and implement process optimizations at the intersection of business workflows and system capabilities
  • Support business continuity planning related to system downtime, data recovery, and disaster recovery scenarios
  • Contribute to strategic planning for the PV systems portfolio, including build/buy/partner evaluations and technology investment recommendations

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing, Health Informatics, or a related field; Master's degree preferred
  • 3–5 years of experience in Pharmacovigilance, Drug Safety, or a closely related discipline
  • Demonstrated experience owning or managing PV systems or technology platforms in a business capacity
  • Strong understanding of the end-to-end life science lifecycle, from case intake through aggregate reporting and signal management
  • Experience working in a regulated GxP environment and with validated systems

Key Skills and Competencies

Business and Stakeholder Skills

  • Exceptional cross-functional communication — able to speak both "business" and "technology" fluently
  • Strong project and program management skills; ability to manage multiple system workstreams simultaneously
  • Proven ability to influence without authority across organizational levels and functions
  • High-level analytical and critical thinking — able to assess complex problems and drive solutions
  • Skilled in requirements gathering, business process mapping, and gap analysis
  • Effective vendor management and negotiation capabilities
  • Comfortable presenting to and engaging senior leadership

Personal Competencies

  • Detail-oriented with a quality-first mindset
  • Proactive, self-directed, and comfortable operating with ambiguity and autonomy
  • Collaborative and empathetic — a natural team enabler and culture carrier
  • Adaptable to a rapidly evolving technology and regulatory landscape
  • Demonstrates integrity and accountability, especially in a patient safety context

Technical Knowledge Requirements

PV Safety Databases & Case Management

  • Hands-on familiarity (business user level) with leading safety databases.
  • Understanding of E2B(R3) case data structure, ICSR processing workflows, MedDRA coding, and regulatory submission timelines (e.g., 7/15-day reporting)

Reporting & Analytics Tools

  • Experience with PV reporting platforms and dashboards, Power BI or equivalent BI tools for operational metrics CIOMS and PSUR/PBRER report generation workflows
  • Ability to define and validate KPI reporting requirements in collaboration with data teams

Signal Detection & Management Tools

  • Familiarity with signal management platforms.
  • Understanding of disproportionality analysis (PRR, ROR, EBGM) and signal workflow from detection through evaluation and escalation
  • Knowledge of EudraVigilance and FDA FAERS database structures and access

Literature Monitoring & Search Tools

  • Experience with or oversight of systematic literature search tools.
  • Understanding of ICSR extraction from literature, deduplication, and integration with safety databases.
  • Awareness of AI-powered literature monitoring solutions and automation capabilities in this space

Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Technologies

  • Awareness of AI/ML applications in pharmacovigilance, including: AI-assisted case narrative generation and MedDRA auto-coding NLP for literature monitoring and social media surveillance Predictive analytics for signal detection and risk assessment Large Language Models (LLMs) and their responsible use in PV workflows
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI vendor claims and assess technology fit for regulated PV environments
  • Understanding of AI governance requirements in GxP contexts (data lineage, explainability, auditability)

Data and Integration Knowledge

  • Understanding of PV data flows and system integrations (e.g., CRO feeds, affiliate submissions, E2B gateway connections)
  • Familiarity with HL7, FHIR, E2B XML data standards
  • Comfort with data mapping, data quality principles, and working alongside data architects and engineers
  • Basic understanding of API-based integrations and middleware concepts (not hands-on, but enough to direct and review)

Regulatory & Quality Frameworks

  • Solid knowledge of GVP Modules (especially I, V, VI, VIII, IX, XVI)
  • Working knowledge of GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and CSV/CSA (Computer Software Assurance) principles
  • Familiarity with ICH E2A, E2B, E2C, E2D, E2E guidelines
  • Understanding of audit trail requirements, data integrity standards (ALCOA+), and inspection readiness

Summary

Description

Purpose of Role:

This role oversees forecasting, capacity planning, staffing, scheduling, real-time management, adherence, reporting, and workforce optimization across internal teams and BPO partners. The Manager owns the NICE IEX WFM platform, builds the reporting that Operations and Finance rely on, and uses data, technology, and automation to improve service performance, workforce efficiency, and labor cost while developing and leading a high-performing WFM team.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Forecasting & capacity planning — Lead short-, medium-, and long-term forecasting and capacity planning across multiple languages, channels, locations, and BPO vendors. Own weekly forecast-vs-actual tracking, forecast-bias correction, and reforecasting.
  • NICE IEX ownership — Use NICE IEX WFM 8.x (NICE Cloud) to build forecasts, staffing requirements, schedules, adherence strategies, and intraday plans. Administer the system end to end, including management units, activity codes, agent profiles, security/permissions, and schedule-change and time-off workflows.
  • Staffing models — Build staffing and workload models that account for volume, handle time (talk + ACW), shrinkage, occupancy, service level, skills/language mix, employee availability, and business growth; translate requirements into FTE by skill, vendor, and interval.
  • Line adherence staffing model — Apply line adherence (scheduled-vs-actual staffed time against interval requirements) to measure coverage, manage vendor FTE commitments, and support adherence-based billing and staffing decisions.
  • Scheduling — Oversee schedule shell design, schedule development, and optimization to maximize coverage, utilization, adherence, and cost efficiency, including off-phone and project time.
  • Real-time management — Provide strategic oversight of RTA/intraday management: monitor volume, staffing, service level, ASA, abandonment, and adherence, and direct corrective actions across internal and vendor teams.
  • Metrics & analysis — Analyze forecast accuracy, fulfillment rate, service level, ASA, abandon rate, AHT, occupancy, adherence, shrinkage, productivity, staffing variance, and labor cost; investigate variances (e.g., month-over-month hours) and explain root cause.
  • Reporting — Develop and present daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting (forecast vs. actual, fulfillment, FTE coverage, vendor performance) with clear recommendations for Operations and senior leadership.
  • Vendor billing & governance — Manage WFM relationships with BPO and external vendor partners, including staffing requirements, capacity commitments, performance scorecards, service-level governance, and validation of vendor billing. Support new vendor onboarding from a WFM perspective.
  • Data integrity & automation — Use SQL and WFM data integrations to automate reporting, roster/headcount processes, and data feeds. Validate data quality and work with the system vendor to resolve platform issues.
  • Cross-functional partnership — Partner with Operations, Finance, Data/Analytics, and Technology to align staffing plans with client demand, budget, and growth; contribute to annual budget and headcount planning.
  • Scenario analysis — Provide workforce recommendations and what-if scenarios (volume shifts, vendor mix, staffing distribution) to support operational, financial, and strategic decisions.
  • People leadership & enablement — Lead, coach, mentor, and develop WFM analysts. Build and deliver WFM/IEX training and maintain process documentation.
  • Subject-matter expertise — Serve as the WFM SME for NICE IEX and support system enhancements, configuration changes, implementations, integrations, and process improvements.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • 5+ years of progressive Workforce Management experience, preferably in a high-volume contact center or BPO environment.
  • 2+ years of WFM leadership or people-management experience.Hands-on NICE IEX experience across forecasting, staffing, scheduling, adherence, and intraday/real-time management, including system administration.
  • Strong understanding of forecasting, capacity planning, Erlang/workload-based and line adherence staffing models, shrinkage, occupancy, service level, adherence, and productivity.
  • Experience supporting multi-skill, multi-channel, multi-site, multilingual, and outsourced operations.
  • Working SQL skills.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and experience with BI/analytics tools such as Power BI, Sisense, Tableau, or Python.Experience managing BPO/vendor partners, including capacity commitments, performance reporting, and validating FTE- or adherence-based billing.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; able to trace a number back to source data and explain it in plain language to non-WFM leaders.Strong communication, presentation, and documentation skills.Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and develop WFM professionals.Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Experience with multilingual operations preferred.

Relevant Working Conditions/Physical Demands:

  • Sitting/Stationary: Often requires sitting at a desk and looking at a computer screen for 70% - 90% of the workday.
  • Fine Finger Dexterity: High use of keyboards, computer mice, and standard office equipment.
  • Lifting/Moving: Minimal physical exertion; occasionally required to lift or carry office supplies, files, or packages weighing up to 20 lbs.
  • Mobility: Intermittent standing, walking, and bending or stooping to retrieve files.

jobs.description:
At Summit, we build and operate the infrastructure behind some of the most critical applications in regulated industries. The work is complex, expectations are high, and the environments we support require precision and thoughtful execution.

We specialize in enterprise-class Application Hosting, Managed Services, and Cloud Solutions, with deep expertise in compliance, security, and performance. Our focus is simple: make the complex manageable and deliver technology that works - reliably, securely, and at scale.

Complex technology environments need someone who can see the whole picture: how the infrastructure works, where the risks are, and what the business will need next.

As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you’ll be a key technical relationship partner for enterprise clients with complex infrastructure environments. You’ll develop a deep understanding of their business and technical goals, helping them maximize value from our platform while partnering with internal teams to mitigate risks, plan for future needs, and drive long-term success.

You’ll own the ongoing technical relationship for your assigned clients, working across client stakeholders and Summit teams to connect strategy with execution. This role calls for deep infrastructure knowledge, sound judgment, and the ability to bring the right people together when the work gets complicated.

What You’ll Do:
  • Own the technical relationship across a portfolio of complex enterprise clients, serving as a trusted advisor to technical leaders and executive stakeholders.
  • Develop deep knowledge of each client’s business, infrastructure, architecture, stakeholders, priorities, technical dependencies, and use of Summit services.
  • Build relationships across client teams and identify opportunities to strengthen those connections over time.
  • Lead proactive conversations about technical governance, operational health, capacity, resilience, scalability, technical debt, and infrastructure lifecycle needs.
  • Identify risks and dependencies early, working with clients and Summit teams to develop plans before they become larger issues.
  • Provide strategic technical recommendations and roadmaps aligned with each client’s business objectives and technology strategy.
  • Bring technical insight and account context to QBRs, architecture discussions, business reviews, and strategic planning conversations.
  • Partner with account teams on customer health, renewal readiness, and expansion opportunities grounded in client needs.
  • Guide clients through major transitions, including onboarding, steady-state support, expansions, upgrades, and migrations.
  • Maintain technical and relationship oversight during delivery to keep requirements, commitments, communication, and handoffs aligned.
  • Lead structured remediation efforts for technically complex accounts that need elevated attention.
  • Coordinate across Support, Engineering, Delivery, PMO, Operations, Sales, and other Summit teams to keep technical priorities visible and actions moving.
  • Stay current on emerging technologies and infrastructure practices, translating relevant developments into useful guidance for clients.
What You’ll Deliver:
  • Trusted relationships with senior technical and executive stakeholders.
  • A clear, current understanding of complex client environments and how Summit services support them.
  • Technical recommendations and roadmaps that strengthen resilience, scalability, and long-term infrastructure health.
  • Early visibility into technical risks, with clear plans and ownership for addressing them.
  • Valuable QBRs, architecture discussions, and strategic planning conversations.
  • Smooth transitions across sales, onboarding, delivery, projects, and ongoing support.
  • Strong technical input into renewal planning and qualified expansion opportunities.
  • Coordinated remediation efforts with clear client communication and internal accountability.
You’ll Thrive in This Role If You:
  • Bring deep experience in infrastructure design, implementation, architecture, operations, or technical advisory work.
  • Have worked with complex enterprise environments and understand how infrastructure decisions affect critical business operations.
  • Can connect a client’s business objectives to practical technical recommendations and longer-term plans.
  • Build credibility with engineers, technical leaders, and executives.
  • Translate complex technical topics into clear conversations and actionable decisions.
  • Can guide work across multiple teams and drive accountability without direct authority.
  • Spot risks, ask good questions, and follow through when the path forward is complicated.
  • Stay curious about emerging technologies while keeping your recommendations grounded in what the client needs.
Bonus Points:
  • Experience in Technical Account Management, technical consulting, or another customer-facing advisory role.
  • Experience in managed services, cloud infrastructure, hosting, MSP, or data center environments.
  • Broad knowledge of public and private cloud, virtualization, compute, networking, storage, backup and disaster recovery, security, containers, and related technologies.
  • Experience conducting architecture, capacity, resilience, operational health, or infrastructure lifecycle reviews.
  • Technical certifications across AWS, Azure, GCP, VMware, networking, security, or related technologies.
  • Familiarity with ITIL, TOGAF, or business analytics tools such as Power BI.
How We Work at Summit

How you approach the work matters just as much as what you do. At Summit, our core values show up in how we make decisions, work together, and support our customers.

We build the infrastructure that keeps businesses running. We need people who take that seriously, and have fun doing it.

Our Core Values:

  • Empower our people
  • Constant elevation
  • Customer first
  • Focus on outcomes
  • Embrace curiosity
Benefits

Summit offers a total rewards package designed to support you at work, at home, and everywhere in between. Here’s a snapshot of what that looks like:

  • Flexible Time Off (yes, really) – take what you need, we trust you to manage it

Compensation

The salary range for this role is $115,000 – $130,000 annually. Compensation is based on the responsibilities of the role, experience, skills, geographic market, and internal equity. We believe great careers are built one step at a time, and compensation should grow alongside your impact.

jobs.excerpt: RemoteThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

The United States Based Salary range for this role is: 140,000-200,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

jobs.excerpt: See your work in a new light. At LUX Infusion, we’re reimagining infusion care to be more human, supportive, and connected.
jobs.description:
See your work in a new light.

At LUX Infusion, we’re reimagining infusion care to be more human, supportive, and connected. Inspired by lux—meaning light - we guide patients, providers, and partners through complex therapies with clarity, compassion, and confidence.

As a clinician-led, U.S.-based organization, we put people first - helping patients feel seen and supported through faster therapy starts, dedicated care coordination, and meaningful collaboration. Our commitment to inclusion, diversity, equity, and advancement (IDEA) is central to our culture, ensuring every team member feels valued and empowered to make a difference.

We’re looking for a Director, Talent Acquisition Strategy who wants their work to mean something—someone who brings care, accountability, and purpose to what they do every day.

Schedule & Location

Location: Overland Park, KS, or Plantation, FL or Remote

Schedule:

  • Monday - Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Why This Role Matters

As a Director, Talent Acquisition Strategy, you play a critical role in ensuring patients receive safe, effective, and timely specialty infusion therapies. Your expertise helps guide medication management, support clinical decision-making, and ensure every prescription is reviewed with accuracy and care.

In this role, you’ll contribute to work that:

  • Helps patients feel informed, supported, and confident throughout their treatment journey
  • Ensures safe and compliant specialty pharmacy operations
  • Supports clinicians, providers, and care teams through clinical expertise and collaboration
  • Advances positive patient outcomes through thoughtful medication management and oversight

Everything we do connects back to real people navigating complex healthcare journeys—and this role helps make that journey brighter.

What You'll Do

The Director, Talent Acquisition Strategy leads the development and execution of LUX Infusion's enterprise-wide talent acquisition strategy. This role is responsible for building a scalable, data-driven recruiting function that anticipates workforce needs and supports clinical, operational, professional, and leadership hiring across multiple states and markets.

The Director partners closely with executive leadership, Human Resources, Finance, Operations, and hiring leaders to translate business plans into workforce strategies; strengthen the employer brand and talent pipelines; optimize recruiting and onboarding processes; and use meaningful KPIs and analytics to improve hiring outcomes. The ideal candidate is a strategic, hands-on leader who can build systems, influence stakeholders, and operate effectively in a fast-paced, growing organization. Success in this role requires the ability to connect enterprise strategy with disciplined execution, create transparency through reliable data, and build a recruiting function that consistently delivers talent needed for growth.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Talent Acquisition Strategy and Workforce Planning
• Develop and execute an enterprise-wide talent acquisition strategy aligned with LUX Infusion's growth plans, operating priorities, and long-term workforce needs.
• Partner with Finance, Operations, Human Resources, and business leaders to translate growth projections, turnover trends, labor availability, and productivity expectations into short- and long-term workforce plans.
• Create hiring forecasts, capacity models, prioritization frameworks, and recruiting resource plans that improve organizational readiness and reduce reactive hiring.
• Advise executive leadership on talent availability, geographic labor-market conditions, hiring risks, recruiting investments, and workforce implications of business decisions.
• Establish consistent, equitable, and legally compliant standards for job intake, candidate evaluation, interviewing, selection, and hiring decisions nationwide.
• Support workforce planning and talent acquisition needs for acquisitions, integrations, and new-market expansion as a recurring, core component of this role, not an incidental one.

Sourcing, Pipeline Development, and Employer Brand
• Build sustainable talent pipelines for critical, recurring, and difficult-to-fill positions across clinical, operational, professional, and leadership functions.
• Develop data-driven sourcing strategies using labor-market intelligence, geographic analysis, candidate and conversion data, referrals, professional networks, educational partnerships, and digital channels.
• Measure source quality and channel effectiveness to focus recruiting resources on approaches that produce qualified, durable hires drawn from broad candidate pools.
• Develop and maintain a compelling employer value proposition and partner with Marketing and Communications to strengthen the LUX Infusion employment brand.
• Create strategies for passive-candidate engagement, talent-community management, and market-specific outreach within a consistent national framework.

Recruiting Operations, Technology, and Onboarding
• Evaluate and optimize the end-to-end recruiting process, including requisition approval, sourcing, screening, interviewing, selection, offers, pre-employment requirements, and transition to onboarding.
• Establish recruiting service levels, standardized workflows, clear decision rights, and accountability for recruiters, hiring managers, and business partners.
• Lead the effective use and ongoing optimization of the applicant tracking system, including Greenhouse configuration, workflows, data integrity, reporting, user adoption, and compliance.
• Evaluate recruiting technology and automation opportunities that improve scheduling, candidate engagement, analytics, reporting, and team productivity, and confirm that any automated or AI-assisted screening tools comply with applicable law.
• Partner with Human Resources, IT, Compliance, and Operations to create a coordinated preboarding and onboarding experience, including licensure and credential verification and federal exclusion screening where applicable, that reduces delays and pre-start attrition and accelerates new-hire readiness.
• Use candidate and new-hire feedback to continuously improve the candidate, preboarding, and onboarding experience.

Analytics, KPIs, and Continuous Improvement
• Develop and maintain a comprehensive talent acquisition measurement framework, including KPIs, dashboards, targets, benchmarks, and reporting standards.
• Track and analyze measures such as hiring-plan attainment, time to fill, time to hire, cost per hire, source effectiveness, pipeline conversion, offer acceptance, candidate withdrawal, recruiter productivity, quality of hire, early retention, and stakeholder satisfaction.
• Conduct regular business reviews with leadership to assess performance, forecast needs, identify risks, and recommend corrective actions or resource changes.
• Ensure data integrity and disciplined system use so recruiting analytics are accurate, timely, consistent, and actionable.
• Develop leading and predictive indicators that allow the organization to anticipate hiring challenges rather than react after vacancies affect operations.

Leadership, Partnership, and Compensation Review
• Lead, coach, and develop the talent acquisition team, establishing clear expectations, performance standards, operating rhythms, and accountability.
• Serve as a strategic advisor to hiring leaders and provide training, tools, and guidance that improve interview quality, decision-making, and candidate engagement.
• Partner with Human Resources and Finance to evaluate compensation competitiveness using market data, internal equity, candidate feedback, offer outcomes, and hiring performance.
• Recommend adjustments to compensation ranges, geographic differentials, hiring incentives, or offer practices when supported by market and performance data.
• Assess when external search firms, agencies, contract recruiters, or other resources are warranted and manage those relationships and investments effectively.
• Manage recruiting spend within the approved annual budget.

NON-ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES
• Represent LUX Infusion at recruiting events, professional conferences, educational programs, and community partnerships, as appropriate.
• Support enterprise projects and special workforce initiatives as requested.
• Maintain professional knowledge of recruiting practices, labor-market trends, technology, and applicable employment laws.
• Participate in quality assurance, compliance, and process audits as directed.
• Perform other related duties as assigned.

What We're Looking For

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, Analytics, or equivalent experience in a related field.
• Minimum of 10 years of progressive talent acquisition or human resources experience, including at least 5 years in a leadership or enterprise recruiting role.
• Demonstrated experience developing and executing talent acquisition strategies across multiple states or on a national scale.
• Strong background in workforce planning, recruiting analytics, dashboard development, and the design and implementation of KPIs.
• Proven ability to analyze recruiting data, identify trends and operational risks, and translate findings into clear recommendations for senior leadership.
• Experience building proactive pipelines and sourcing strategies for high-volume, specialized, clinical, professional, and leadership positions.
• Demonstrated success improving recruiting processes, technology, candidate experience, and hiring-manager effectiveness.
• Demonstrated knowledge of compensation benchmarking, market analysis, internal equity considerations, and offer strategy.
• Knowledge of federal, state, and local laws and regulations applicable to recruiting and hiring across multiple jurisdictions, including pay transparency, fair-chance and background check, salary history, and automated employment decision tool requirements.
• Strong executive communication, stakeholder-management, project-management, and team-leadership skills.

QUALIFICATIONS PREFERRED
• Experience administering or materially optimizing Greenhouse ATS.
• Experience supporting healthcare, infusion, specialty pharmacy, or another highly regulated and competitive labor environment.
• Experience in a rapidly growing, geographically dispersed, or private equity-backed organization.
• Experience supporting acquisitions, new-market expansion, organizational integration, or high-volume growth initiatives.
• Advanced degree or professional certification in Human Resources, talent acquisition, analytics, or a related discipline.

CORE COMPETENCIES

• Enterprise and strategic thinking

• Attention to detail

• Workforce planning and business acumen
• KPI development and analytical judgment
• Talent pipeline and sourcing strategy
• Process design and continuous improvement
• Executive communication and influence
• Team leadership and talent development
• Cross-functional collaboration
• Change management and operational discipline
• Professionalism, integrity, and sound judgment

Performance Measures
• Achievement of approved hiring plans and critical-role staffing priorities.
• Time to fill, time to hire, and vacancy aging by role, market, and business unit.
• Pipeline health, source effectiveness, funnel conversion, and qualified-candidate flow.
• Offer acceptance, candidate withdrawal, and pre-start attrition rates.
• Quality of hire and new-hire retention.
• Recruiter productivity, process compliance, and data integrity.
• Hiring manager and candidate satisfaction.
• Effectiveness of recruiting investments, including cost per hire and agency utilization.

Communication Skills
• Communicates clearly, persuasively, and appropriately with executives, hiring leaders, candidates, and team members; listens and seeks clarification; presents complex workforce and recruiting data in an accessible manner; and prepares concise, accurate written communications and executive-level reports.

Computer Skills
• Advanced proficiency with applicant tracking systems, reporting and dashboard tools, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft Office applications.

You don’t need to check every box—we care just as much about how you show up as what’s on your resume.

Why LUX Infusion

At LUX Infusion, we believe infusion care deserves more light—more warmth, more clarity, and more connection.

Here, you’ll find:

  • Purpose-driven work with real impact
  • A patient-first, clinician-led culture
  • Supportive, collaborative teammates
  • Opportunities to expand your clinical expertise and professional growth
  • The chance to help shape the future of specialty infusion care

Come help us elevate infusion care—and see what’s possible when care comes first.

Pay Range/Rate
$145,000—$160,000 USD

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here represent those required for an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact the LUX Infusion Talent Team at or 954.385.7322 x 1425.

While performing the duties of this position, the employee may occasionally be required to stand, walk, or sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear. The employee may also be required to occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this role include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS

Employees are expected to:

  • Participate annually in required legal and ethical compliance training
  • Consistently act in compliance with LUX Infusion’s legal, ethical, and compliance policies
  • Adhere to all standards and procedures outlined in the LUX Infusion Compliance Manual
  • Refrain from any behavior that could be considered unethical or unlawful

EXPECTATIONS FOR ALL EMPLOYEES

All LUX Infusion team members are expected to support the organization’s mission, vision, and values by demonstrating integrity, dedication, compassion, and enthusiasm. This includes placing patients first, working collaboratively with a “stacked‑hands” mindset, and maintaining a consistent focus on quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

GENERAL INFORMATION

The statements above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by individuals in this role. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required.

This role operates in a fast‑paced environment and requires the ability to prioritize competing demands, manage multiple tasks effectively, and seek guidance when appropriate.

Employees in this position may be required to assist directly - or coordinate appropriate assistance - to ensure access to LUX Infusion’s services for individuals with disabilities, including patients, visitors, employees, or others.

Become a part of our caring community

The Senior Full Stack Engineer for Platform Quality and Reliability owns the operational health of the NBA platform after it is built. This is a hands-on engineering role first. You are expected to be a significant individual contributor every sprint. You take handoff from the delivery pods and are accountable for ensuring the platform scales, stays up, fails gracefully, and is covered by rigorous testing and observability. You are not building new features you are making sure what gets built is production-ready and stays that way.

What You'll Own

  • Platform reliability - own uptime, performance, and resilience across NBA platform services; identify and resolve bottlenecks, failure points, and scaling constraints before they become incidents

  • Hands-on development - actively write and ship production code alongside your team; this is not a supervisory role

  • Testing frameworks - build and maintain automated testing infrastructure across unit, integration, and end-to-end layers; establish testing standards and ensure pods are handing off code that meets the bar

  • Observability and logging - own the platform's logging, alerting, and monitoring stack; ensure the team has visibility into what the system is doing in production at all times

  • Error management - design and enforce error handling patterns across platform services; ensure failures are caught, logged, surfaced, and resolved systematically

  • Scalability engineering - evaluate platform components under load and lead efforts to ensure the system scales reliably as member volume and data throughput grow

  • Handoff and quality gates - define and enforce the criteria pods must meet before handing off new services or features; own the process that gets code from delivery to production safely

  • Contractor management - manage quality and reliability engineers within your pod; set expectations, review work, and hold the team to standards

  • Cross-pod coordination - work closely with all delivery pod leads to catch quality and reliability concerns early; be the voice that asks how something breaks before it ships

  • 5+ years of experience designing, developing, and testing of software applications and/or infrastructure

jobs.excerpt: Sobre a BigDataCorpA BigDataCorp é a maior datatech da América Latina, e democratiza, desde 2013, o acesso aos dados, aumentando possibilidades e certezas em um mundo repleto de incertezas.
jobs.description:
Sobre a BigDataCorp

A BigDataCorp é a maior datatech da América Latina, e democratiza, desde 2013, o acesso aos dados, aumentando possibilidades e certezas em um mundo repleto de incertezas.

Somos pioneiros na captura, estruturação, armazenamento e distribuição de dados no Brasil. Nosso processo é único. Já nascemos adequados à LGPD e às demais regulamentações, garantindo a origem das informações fornecidas, obtidas sempre de forma ética.

Sobre a área e a vaga

Os times de infraestrutura são responsáveis por organizar, manter e evoluir as diferentes plataformas que constituem a base da operação da empresa, da organização dos serviços de computação na nuvem empregados pelos diferentes times técnicos até a definição e implantação de processos relacionados com a segurança da informação na empresa como um todo.

Requirements

O que vai fazer no dia a dia

  • Arquitetura de Observabilidade: Projetar, implantar e manter a infraestrutura de telemetria (OpenTelemetry Collectors, agentes de métricas/logs/traces, concentradores e ferramentas de visualização), garantindo alta disponibilidade da própria plataforma de observabilidade.
  • Governança de Alertas e Métricas: Configurar o ecossistema de observabilidade para coletar dados de aplicações e infraestrutura, definindo regras de alerta acionáveis (Alertmanager/Incident.io) e reduzindo o ruído operando no modelo Observability-as-a-Service para os times de desenvolvimento.
  • Arquitetura e Nuvem: Projetar, operar e evoluir a infraestrutura em AWS utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC).
  • Gestão de Kubernetes: Administrar clusters em produção, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e controle de custos.
  • CI/CD e Automação: Construir e otimizar pipelines de entrega contínua rápidas e confiáveis, eliminando trabalho operacional repetitivo (toil).
  • Liderança e Mentoria: Guiar o time de infraestrutura/plataforma, organizar o backlog, distribuir tarefas e atuar como mentor(a) para os demais engenheiros.
  • Ponte com Produto: Negociar prioridades técnicas com os times de desenvolvimento e produto.

Habilidades necessárias

  • Cloud: Experiência profunda com provedores de nuvem pública (preferencialmente AWS).
  • Containers: Domínio avançado de Kubernetes e ecossistema de containers (Docker/containerd).
  • Vivência madura na operação e sustentação de sistemas distribuídos e de alta disponibilidade em produção.
  • Infraestrutura de Observabilidade (Hands-on): Experiência comprovada implantando e configurando a pilha de observabilidade via código (IaC/Helm). É necessário dominar o deploy e gerenciamento de ferramentas como Prometheus Operator, OpenTelemetry Collector, Grafana Stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir) ou agentes/arquitetura em soluções proprietárias (Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace), incluindo gestão de retenção e custo de dados de telemetria.
  • Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas resilientes e escaláveis na nuvem.
  • Visão sistêmica de ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento de software (SDLC) para melhorar a experiência dos desenvolvedores (DevEx).
  • Visão de Engenharia de Telemetria: Entendimento profundo de como os dados de observabilidade são gerados, coletados, processados e armazenados (não apenas criar dashboards, mas entender o caminho que o log, a métrica e o trace percorrem desde a aplicação até o banco de dados de telemetria).
  • Experiência em protocolos de resposta a incidentes.
  • Experiência ou forte aptidão para facilitação de ritos ágeis e gestão de entregas de um pequeno time técnico.
  • IaC: Proficiência em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Pulumi ou similar).
  • Programação/Scripting: Capacidade real de codificar para automação (Python, Go ou Bash avançado).
  • CI/CD: Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.).
  • Comunicação e Negociação: Saber traduzir dívidas técnicas e riscos de infraestrutura para uma linguagem de negócios, conseguindo negociar espaço no backlog com os demais times internos.
  • Inteligência Emocional: Resiliência e frieza para tomar decisões rápidas sob pressão durante incidentes (quedas de produção).
  • Perfil Mentoria (Servant Leadership): Gostar de ensinar, destravar o time e formar novos talentos, não apenas querer brilhar sozinho no código.
  • Pragmatismo: Saber equilibrar a "arquitetura perfeita" com as necessidades reais e o tempo de entrega que o negócio exige.
  • Requisitos diferenciais:
      • GitOps & Service Mesh: Prática com Argo CD, Flux, Istio ou Linkerd.
      • FinOps: Experiência prática na redução e otimização de custos de infraestrutura em nuvem.
      • Observabilidade Avançada e eBPF: Uso de eBPF (Cilium, Pixie) para observabilidade sem instrumentação pesada no código.
      • Otimização de Custos em Observabilidade: Estratégias de amostragem (sampling) de traces, agregação/descarte de logs em nível de coletor para evitar explosão de custos de ingestão na nuvem ou SaaS.
      • Segurança (DevSecOps): Gestão de segredos, políticas como código (ex: OPA/Gatekeeper) e segurança de supply chain.
      • Certificações: CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator), AWS Solutions Architect ou equivalentes.
      • Idiomas: Inglês técnico avançado (para leitura, conversação e condução de fóruns com eventuais fornecedores/times globais).

Benefits

O que oferecemos

    • Trabalho 100% remoto (trabalhe de onde quiser);
    • Escritório em RJ e SP com ambiente de trabalho descontraído (para quem quiser utilizar);
    • Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento;
    • Flexibilidade de horários (sim, mesmo em home office);
    • Férias flexíveis (além do regime CLT);
    • Plano de saúde e dental Bradesco;
    • Seguro de vida em grupo;
    • Benefício Refeição via cartão Caju;
    • Auxílio mensal ao home office (móveis e internet);
    • Vale Home Office;
    • OrienteMe (apoio psicológico);
    • Conexa Saúde (apoio psicológico e nutricional);
    • Wellhub;
    • Day Off para aniversários;
    • Licença Maternidade de 6 meses;
    • Licença Paternidade de 1 mês;
    • Auxílio-creche;
    • Convênio SESC;
    • Game night (presencial no escritório do RJ e online no Discord);
    • BDC Learning e BDC Decola (programa de desenvolvimento e crescimento dos nossos profissionais através do subsídio de treinamentos diversos, como cursos, palestras, livros e outros);
    • Equipe unida e sempre pronta para apoiar.

Intelligence Center X is Siemens' platform for the agentic enterprise

The next wave of enterprise software isn't about writing more code — it's about giving organizations the tools to combine trusted data, AI, and applications into systems that can reason and act on their own. Intelligence Center X delivers that today, through five capabilities — an Enterprise Knowledge Graph, AI/ML, agentic application development, orchestration, and governance — that together move enterprises from static software to intelligent, autonomous systems.

For the customers we serve, that shift shows up in very concrete ways: engineers and data leaders who can finally find and trust the data buried across decades of enterprise systems; teams that go from idea to working application in days instead of quarters; and AI initiatives that move out of pilot purgatory and into production because the underlying data and governance can actually support them. Whether you're building this platform, proving its value to customers, or bringing it to market through our partner ecosystem, your work directly drives those outcomes for some of the most complex organizations in the world.

This is one of the most ambitious enterprise AI platforms in the market — built on decades of deep domain expertise across industries as varied as manufacturing, banking, insurance, financial services, and healthcare, and already running in production at real scale for organizations with some of the most demanding data and compliance requirements in the world. If you want to work at the intersection of enterprise AI, knowledge graphs, and agentic applications — with real customers and real production stakes, across nearly every major industry — this is where that work is happening.

Customer Stories Lead

Location

United States (Remote)

About Siemens Digital Industries Software

Siemens Digital Industries Software helps organizations of all sizes digitally transform using software, hardware, and services from the Siemens Xcelerator business platform. Our software enables companies to optimize their design, engineering, and manufacturing processes to turn today's ideas into the sustainable products of the future.

Position Overview

Siemens Digital Industries Software is seeking a Customer Stories Lead to execute a customer storytelling and advocacy strategy developed in partnership with the Head of Customer Marketing. This role will own the day-to-day operation and activation of a high-impact customer stories program, transforming customer successes into compelling narratives that strengthen the Siemens brand, accelerate sales, support product marketing, and cultivate customer advocates.

Working closely with Growth leadership, the Customer Stories Lead will translate strategic priorities into a scalable customer proof engine that highlights measurable business outcomes and showcases the value of our solutions. The ideal candidate is an exceptional storyteller with strong customer empathy, commercial acumen, and the ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear business value for enterprise audiences.

Key Responsibilities

Execute the Customer Storytelling Strategy

  • Partner with the Head of Customer Marketing to operationalize the customer storytelling, advocacy, and reference strategy.
  • Own the end-to-end customer story pipeline, including customer identification, qualification, outreach, interviews, content development, approvals, publication, and activation.
  • Develop customer-friendly processes for participation, permissions, approvals, advocacy tracking, and ongoing reference management.
  • Identify and address story and reference gaps across industries, buyer personas, use cases, products, geographies, and sales segments.
  • Recommend strategies to strengthen customer proof coverage in priority growth areas.

Create and Activate Exceptional Customer Stories

  • Lead customer discovery sessions, interviews, and narrative development efforts.
  • Help customers articulate their business challenges, implementation journeys, measurable outcomes, and future vision.
  • Translate complex platform, AI, automation, workflow, integration, data, and cloud capabilities into technically credible and commercially compelling stories.
  • Create and oversee a variety of customer assets, including:
    • Case studies
    • Customer videos
    • Executive interviews
    • Sales presentations
    • One-pagers
    • Testimonials
    • Keynote content
    • Award submissions
  • Collaborate with Brand, Product Marketing, Communications, and Field teams to activate stories across:
    • Marketing campaigns
    • Product launches
    • Digital experiences
    • Sales plays
    • Industry events
    • Public relations initiatives
    • Social media programs
    • Executive communications

Support Sales and Customer Advocacy

  • Build and maintain a portfolio of referenceable customers in partnership with Sales, Account Management, and Revenue Operations teams.
  • Manage customer reference requests by identifying appropriate advocates and ensuring a positive experience for both customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Develop sales-ready customer proof points, making it easy for account teams to access relevant stories, metrics, quotes, and peer examples.
  • Prepare customer advocates for:
    • Webinars
    • Industry events
    • Executive briefings
    • Prospect conversations
    • Analyst engagements
    • Media opportunities
    • Other strategic customer-facing activities

Qualifications

Required Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in Customer Marketing, Customer Advocacy, Content Strategy, Product Marketing, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience developing customer stories for B2B SaaS, enterprise software, AI, automation, cloud, workflow, data, or technical platform solutions.
  • Proven ability to create compelling customer-facing content that drives engagement and business impact.
  • Experience working directly with senior customer stakeholders and executive audiences.

Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional interviewing, writing, editing, and storytelling skills.
  • Strong portfolio of customer success stories, case studies, executive content, videos, or integrated campaigns.
  • Ability to uncover, quantify, and communicate customer business outcomes while maintaining technical accuracy and credibility.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with experience partnering across Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Field Marketing, Brand, PR, Legal, and Executive Leadership teams.
  • Excellent program and project management skills, including stakeholder coordination, editorial planning, approvals management, production timelines, and content operations.
  • Sound judgment regarding customer confidentiality, consent management, legal review processes, and responsible use of customer data and claims.

Why Join Siemens?

This is an opportunity to shape how Siemens tells its most important customer success stories and to build a world-class customer advocacy program that influences brand perception, pipeline growth, sales success, and customer loyalty. You will work across marketing, sales, and executive leadership teams to bring the voice of the customer to life at scale.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Siemens is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse workforce that reflects the communities we serve. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Salary Transparency Statement

The pay range for this position is $102,500 - $184,500 USD annually. The actual compensation offered will depend on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, and business considerations.

In addition to base salary, Siemens offers a comprehensive benefits package that may include performance-based incentives, healthcare coverage, retirement savings programs, paid time off, and other employee benefits. Eligibility for specific programs may vary based on employment status and location.

jobs.title: KIP Spring 2027 - Economic Research Intern - Fulcrum Foundation
jobs.excerpt: The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States.
jobs.description:
The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!

Overview

The Fulcrum Foundation seeks an intern to support research on state government regulatory policy and its effects on economic growth, entrepreneurship, labor markets, housing, occupational licensing, permitting, and related public policy issues.

Interns will work closely with senior researchers to gather and organize data, review proposed rules and administrative records, assist with research for public comment letters submitted to state agencies and legislatures, and contribute to policy briefs and reports intended for policymakers and the broader public.

The internship is designed for undergraduate students, recent graduates, and early-stage graduate or law students interested in public policy, economics, law, or government. Prior research experience is helpful but not required; we are looking for careful, curious people who write well and can work independently in a remote setting.

Research Areas

Potential areas of work include:

  • Administrative law, rulemaking, and the public comment process
  • Occupational licensing
  • Business permitting and approvals
  • Housing and land-use regulation
  • Small business and entrepreneurship policy
  • State economic development
  • Regulatory impact analysis
  • Government modernization and process reform
  • Labor market regulation
  • Institutional determinants of economic growth

Responsibilities

  • Assist with research for public comment letters on proposed state rules and regulations, including reviewing rulemaking notices, summarizing proposed rule text and agency justifications, and identifying relevant statutes, prior comments, and existing research.
  • Help draft and fact-check sections of comment letters, and compile supporting evidence, citations, and data appendices under the direction of senior staff.
  • Track state regulatory proposals, legislative activity, and agency actions relevant to Fulcrum’s research agenda.
  • Collect, organize, and document data from government websites, administrative records, and other publicly available sources.
  • Help maintain measures of regulatory burden, permitting processes, occupational licensing requirements, and related policy variables.
  • Conduct literature reviews and summarize academic and policy research for ongoing projects.
  • Draft sections of policy briefs, research summaries, and other written products, and assist with editing and citation.
  • Assist with basic descriptive analysis, tables, and charts using spreadsheet or statistical software.
  • Participate in research team meetings and contribute to project planning.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Current undergraduate, graduate, or law student, or recent graduate, in economics, public policy, political science, law, public administration, or a related field.
  • Strong writing skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to read and accurately summarize dense material such as proposed rules, statutes, and academic research.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines in a remote environment.
  • Located in and authorized to work in the United States for the duration of the program, and able to attend all required KIP programming, including the two-day summit in Arlington, Virginia.

Preferred:

  • Coursework in economics, statistics, public policy, or administrative law.
  • Familiarity with R, Stata, Python, or another statistical program (not required).
  • Prior research experience through coursework, a research assistant position, or an internship.
  • Interest in state government policy, regulatory institutions, and economic development.
Stand Together Fellowships believes that diversity in experiences, perspectives, knowledge and ideas fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success. Our admissions office treats all program participants and applicants with honesty, dignity, respect and sensitivity. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of color, race, religion, religious creed, sex, gender or gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, ethnicity, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy (including medical needs which may arise from pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), military and veteran status, genetic information, marital or familial status, political affiliation, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state or local laws, regulations or ordinances.

About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritise candidate safety. Please be aware that official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the Role

As an HR Associate - Partner EOR, you will play a critical role in ensuring seamless HR generalist and operational support for clients and their employees utilising the Rippling Employer of Record services.

You will manage key processes such as onboarding, payroll data management, employee changes, and terminations by working closely with internal teams and external stakeholders. This role is highly detail-oriented, requiring strong organizational skills to handle data transfers and ensure compliance with regional regulations.

In addition to handling inquiries from the ticketing system, you will take ownership of operational tasks, including downloading, uploading, and transferring employee data across systems. You’ll act as a liaison between Ripplings partners, clients, employees, and internal teams to coordinate processes and provide efficient, accurate support across regions.

What you will do

  • Operational Support
    • Manage the onboarding process for new hires, including collecting required information from clients, completing intake forms, and preparing employment agreements in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
    • Facilitate employee onboarding by coordinating documentation, approvals, and secure data transfers between systems.
    • Ensure accurate and secure transfer of employee information between internal systems and external platforms, including uploading, updating, and synchronizing data.
    • Assist with payroll processes when required by preparing, uploading, and verifying data templates for payroll instructions and expenses, ensuring timely and accurate processing.
    • Handle ongoing employee changes, such as salary adjustments or role updates, by coordinating the preparation, review, and execution of necessary addendums and documentation.
    • Support the termination process by coordinating the collection of required information, and ensuring timely communication and execution of tasks.
  • Ticketing & Client Support
    • Serve as the first point of contact for HR inquiries, providing professional and timely first-line support for routine questions related to leave policies, performance management, HRIS navigation, and employee data updates.
    • Own the ticketing system, maintaining the queue and ensuring all inquiries receive prompt initial responses and are resolved within established KPIs for response and resolution times.
  • Documentation & Data Management
    • Develop and maintain process documentation, templates, and SOPs to standardize operations and enhance efficiency.
    • Ensure employment agreements, employee documentation, and other key records are accurately prepared, reviewed, and securely stored.
    • Prepare detailed metrics and reporting on task completion, ticket resolution, and process performance to support continuous improvement.
  • Collaboration & Cross-Functional Coordination
    • Collaborate closely with Regional Managers, Partner Managers, and internal teams to resolve escalations, coordinate multi-step processes, and ensure smooth operations.
    • Monitor and track progress on assigned tasks, ensuring deadlines are met and stakeholders are informed of updates.
    • Research and provide guidance on HR matters across multiple countries, ensuring compliance with local regulations and industry best practices.
  • Operational Efficiency
    • Create templates and macros for consistent responses and streamlined processes.
    • Maintain a high level of attention to detail and accuracy in all operational tasks, ensuring data integrity and compliance with relevant regulations.

What you will need

  • 3+ years of experience in HR support, operations, or a related role within a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong understanding of HR processes, including onboarding, payroll, employee changes, and terminations.
  • Experience with HRIS platforms and data management, including transferring and reconciling data across systems.
  • High attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple tasks with competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively liaise with clients, employees, and internal teams.
  • Proficiency with ticketing systems (e.g., Salesforce) and HRIS platforms (e.g., Rippling, Workday).
  • Experience working in a global business and working with stakeholders in other countries is a plus
  • Professional working proficiency in English; additional language skills are a plus.

Through a partnership-based approach, Coterie helps insurance professionals unlock untapped revenue in the small commercial space. With an innovative quoting platform that delivers accurate pricing and bindable quotes in less than one minute, Coterie makes small business insurance effortless.

We are on a mission to build and foster a world-class team to bring speed, simplicity, and service to commercial insurance. We value integrity, humility, passion, and intelligence. If you want to push yourself and reshape a $200B+ market, we’re excited to talk to you!

Position Summary:
The Director, Partner Distribution is responsible for leading the performance, growth, and execution of Coterie’s partner distribution organization across high-potential and developing partner accounts. This leader will oversee Partner Account Executives and Partner Development Managers while driving strategic initiatives that increase partner production, activation, engagement, and profitable growth.

This role is responsible for establishing scalable frameworks for partner growth, account segmentation, performance management, and partner engagement strategies across traditional distribution channels.

The Director, Partner Distribution will collaborate closely with Insurance, Product, Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Partner Success teams to improve partner outcomes, strengthen relationships, and scale Coterie’s distribution footprint.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Partner Account Executives and Partner Development Managers.
  • Develop and execute growth strategies across strategic, emerging, and developing partner segments.
  • Drive partner production growth, activation, and engagement across assigned distribution channels.
  • Establish performance expectations, accountability frameworks, and operating cadences for the distribution team.
  • Monitor partner performance metrics including premium growth, submission activity, activation, engagement, and retention. • Collaborate with Revenue Operations to support forecasting, account segmentation, territory alignment, and reporting.
  • Partner with Marketing, Product, Insurance, and Revenue Operations teams to support partner growth initiatives and enablement strategies.
  • Identify opportunities to improve partner lifecycle management and distribution scalability.
  • Support strategic partner initiatives and executive relationship management activities.
  • Develop processes and programs that improve partner activation, expansion, and long-term growth.
  • Represent Coterie at industry conferences, partner events, and distribution forums as needed.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and proactive relationship management.

Required Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Insurance, Marketing, or related field required.
  • 7+ years of experience in insurance distribution, partner management, sales leadership, or agency development.
  • Proven success leading revenue-generating teams and driving partner growth initiatives.
  • Experience managing agency, broker, embedded, or hybrid distribution relationships preferred.
  • Experience developing scalable distribution and engagement strategies.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Strong leadership and team development capabilities.
  • Exceptional relationship-building and communication skills.
  • Strong strategic planning and operational execution abilities.

Our hiring process generally consists of 3 phases. The goal is to provide an opportunity for us to learn more about our candidates while allowing them to get to know us as well!

  • Phase 3: Top candidates will receive an invite for our final interview series via Teams video. This series will include an experiential exercise project (provided in advance), 1:1 interviews with selected team members. The final series is roughly 1.5-3 hours in total but can be scheduled over a few days for flexibility.

Candidates who meet all the minimum requirements and possess additional relevant experience, as outlined in the job description, may be considered for a salary above the midpoint of the above range. Salary is based on internal equity; internal salary ranges; market data/ranges; applicant’s skills; prior relevant experience; degrees or certifications, etc.
