Our business purpose: We are a purpose-driven team working to drive life-changing clarity in precision diagnostics that helps uncover what’s hidden inside the body – enabling earlier, more confident decisions in the fight against diseases like Alzheimer's, cardiovascular conditions, and cancer. As part of a company that delivers both radiopharmaceutical doses and the PET imaging infrastructure needed to use them, we play a critical role in expanding access to precision diagnostics – for providers, for systems, and most importantly, for patients. What sets us apart is a combination of unmatched clinical expertise, unwavering commitment to advancing science, as well as our deep commitment to showing up with urgency, care, and empathy – helping more people move from uncertainty to understanding. We believe that behind every scan is a heartbeat and behind every heartbeat is a story, and we treat each one like it matters – because lives are shaped in moments like these.

Who thrives here: You’ll thrive here if you care deeply – about your teammates, about the people we serve, and about doing what’s right, even when it’s hard. You bring both heart and discipline to your work, with a curiosity to uncover what customers truly need and the courage to make tough calls when clarity is elusive. This is a space where ambiguity is real, decisions carry weight, and collaboration isn’t optional – it’s how we move forward. If you find meaning in building something that matters and supporting others while doing it, you’ll feel at home here.

GE HealthCare’s US Radiopharma business is seeking Executive, Market Access, HEOR and Patient services to lead the market access strategy for a growing portfolio of molecular imagine and radiopharmaceutical products across cardiology, neurology and oncology.

Job Description

This role will be responsible for leading US market access strategies across payer access, reimbursement policy, CMS and Medicaid strategy, HEOR, coverage/payment pull through, field reimbursement, patient services and provider-facing access support. This leader will play a critical role in shaping how providers, patients and health systems gain access to our products, including influencing the broader reimbursement, coverage and policy environment to support long-term RP growth.

The ideal candidate will bring strong market access leadership in complex, specialty healthcare markets, including deep understanding of reimbursement, provider economics, government payer dynamics and access execution in the field. This individual should be equally comfortable shaping strategy at the leadership level and overseeing practical execution across the market access verticals.

This is a highly visible leadership role at GE HealthCare and will partner closely with Commercial, Marketing, Sales, Medical Affairs, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and Commercial Operations leadership.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Create and lead the US market access strategy for RP portfolio aligned to business priorities, growth objectives and future launches
  • Develop and execute strategies across commercial and government payer access, reimbursement policy, providers reimbursement, and access pull-through
  • Lead planning related to Medicare, Medicaid, CMS, and reimbursement policy, including assessment of coding, coverage and payment dynamics impacting the entire portfolio
  • Define and lead the HEOR and value evidence strategy in support of payer engagement, provider economics and broader market adoption
  • Oversee development of access related tools and programs including economic models, value communication assets, and evidence-based support for payer and provider discussions
  • Lead field reimbursement and patient service strategy, including education, escalation support, service model, and access-related operational support
  • Partner closely and compliantly with commercial teams to ensure access strategy supports customer onboarding, reimbursement readiness and utilization growth
  • Provide strategic guidance on provider economics and practical reimbursement barriers across hospitals, FSICs, physician practices and other target sites of care
  • Lead external market access and policy engagement strategies that help shape reimbursement and coverage environment for the entire GE HealthCare portfolio, including other segments, new product launches and acquisition product lines
  • Identify, develop and support opportunities to influence coverage frameworks, reimbursement policies
  • Help shape the evidence, health economic, and value narrative needed to support broader clinical acceptance, guidelines evolution and favorable healthcare coverage decisions
  • Support launch readiness and lifecycle management with accountability for market access SME and workstreams
  • Build, lead and develop a high-performing team and scalable operating model to support a rapidly growing business

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree required, advanced degree in business management, public health, healthcare administration preferred
  • Minimum of 15 years of progressive experience in market access, reimbursement, HEOR, health policy, payer strategy and patient services
  • Significant experience in specialty pharma, Radiopharma, molecular imaging, oncology, specialty biopharma or other complex provider-administered healthcare segments
  • Demonstrated expertise in US reimbursement an access, including Medicare/CMS and government payer strategy
  • Experience leading or shaping field reimbursement, provider support, and patient service capabilities
  • Experience leading and shaping external policy, reimbursement trends, guidelines and stakeholder engagement that influence access and coverage
  • Proven ability to lead large teams, influence senior stakeholders and operate effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment
  • Experience launching new products or categories
  • Experience supporting buy and bill, outpatient and imaging center site of care
  • Strong knowledge of HEOR and real-world evidence strategies for access strategies
  • Experience engaging with provider organizations, professional societies, policy stakeholders to support favorable market access conditions

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.excerpt: About ShippaboShippabo is a tech-enabled ocean freight forwarder.
jobs.description:
About Shippabo

Shippabo is a tech-enabled ocean freight forwarder. Founded in 2016, we have raised $22 million from Wonder Ventures, TenOneTen Ventures, Double M Partners, and Slow Ventures. Our platform gives importers one place to book, track, and manage ocean shipments, with their internal teams and their overseas suppliers working from the same data. Behind the platform sits a real forwarding operation: a dedicated ocean contracts and pricing team that negotiates carrier rates, and a team in China that works directly with shippers at origin. We’re about 40 people across the US, Canada, Vietnam, Philippines, and China. Our engineering team builds the software that makes the operation faster and more transparent than a traditional forwarder can be.

About the role

This is an account management role built around retention, service quality, and problem solving. It’s not a quota-carrying sales job. There’s no cross-sell or upsell target, and no cold outbound. The one exception is re-engaging importers who have gone quiet or moved volume elsewhere, where the goal is to understand what went wrong and win the volume back. What we actually need is someone who can look at an account and a shipment and figure out what is really going on, then drive it to resolution without needing to hand it off.

What you’ll do

Own a portfolio of importer accounts. You are the primary relationship owner for a book of existing importers. You are accountable for retention, satisfaction, and the health of the relationship over time.

Diagnose before you escalate. When a client raises an issue, your first job is to determine what kind of issue it is. Is it a rate problem, a service failure, an expectation that was set wrong, or a process that broke internally? The answer determines who needs to be involved and what the fix is. We want you to make that call, not pass it off to someone else.

Review shipments and catch problems early. You should be able to look at a booking and know when something is off before the customer tells you. Rolled bookings, a vessel schedule change that will miss a delivery window, drayage constraints at the port of discharge, a document mismatch that will hold a container at customs. You’ll know when to dig into carrier schedules, customs entry, drayage, or documentation, and when it is normal activity not worth alarming a customer over.

Balance the client and the business. Understand what each importer is optimizing for, whether that’s landed cost, transit reliability, or predictability, and weigh that against what makes commercial sense for Shippabo. Advocate hard for the client, and be honest internally about what we got wrong.

Drive quote acceptance and forecast accuracy. Make sure forecasted volume actually books, quotes are accepted or the reason they were not is understood, and that feedback goes back to the supply/pricing team so our rates stay competitive on the lanes that matter.

Own outcomes across teams. Many customer requests require Product, Operations, Finance, or the origin team in China. You’re the owner of the outcome. You map the steps, set the timeline, follow up, and close the loop with the customer.

Monitor and report on your portfolio. Track operational and revenue metrics across your accounts. Surface trends, at-risk accounts, and volume shifts before they become surprises.

Serve as an advisor, not an order taker. Educate importers on supply chain practices and on what Shippabo's platform and network can do for them. Communicate market conditions, rate trends, surcharges, and capacity shifts in terms of what they mean for that specific customer’s business.

Handle inbound small and new importer leads. Own inbound marketing leads from smaller importers, qualify them, and get them onboarded and running.

Re-engage churned and dormant accounts. Work through importers who have reduced or stopped shipping with us, understand why, and rebuild the relationship where the fit is still there.

What we’re looking for

  • Direct experience in ocean freight forwarding, NVOCC, or as an importer managing ocean freight. You understand the mechanics of an ocean shipment end to end, from booking and origin cargo receipt through customs clearance and final delivery.
  • The ability to troubleshoot independently. You form a hypothesis about what went wrong, check it against the data, and act. You don’t need a manager to tell you where to look.
  • Strong commercial judgment. You know the difference between a concession that’s worth making and one that sets a bad precedent.
  • Structured thinking. You can take a messy situation with many moving parts, prioritize it, map out next steps, and communicate clearly what happens next and by when.
  • Clear written communication. Much of this job is explaining a complicated logistics situation to a customer in plain language, quickly.
  • Comfort in a small company. About 40 people, no large support layer, a lot of ownership.

Helpful but not required

  • Experience with a freight forwarding TMS or a modern digital forwarder platform.
  • Familiarity with customs documentation and entry requirements
  • Working knowledge of demurrage, detention, and how to keep clients out of accessorial charges.

Compensation

Base salary is $110,000 to $120,000.CAD. An annual performance bonus brings expected Year 1 total cash compensation to $120,000 to $140,000 CAD. Actual compensation is dependent upon many factors, such as training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, location, and market demands. This range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Benefits for our Shipmates

At Shippabo, our benefits are a reflection of our core values and our commitment to making healthy living affordable and accessible to everyone on board. Our team members enjoy ample Vacation and Sick time, allowing you to take the breaks you need to recharge and ensuring your well-being remains a priority as you grow with us. We offer multiple health plan options and contribute meaningfully toward the cost of coverage for you and your dependents, in addition to a RRSP Plan with matching contributions.

Position Overview

This is a hands-on engineering role requiring strong Python skills and practical experience with LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, AI APIs, and modern AI frameworks. AI System Development

  • Develop chatbots, copilots, intelligent automation tools, and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Build and optimize RAG pipelines using embeddings, vector search, and structured or unstructured data.

  • Develop backend services and APIs using Python, FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks.
  • Design prompts, system instructions, and context-management strategies to improve model performance and reliability.
  • Build scalable AI services that can move from prototypes into production.

Production & Optimization

Required Qualifications

  • Strong proficiency in Python.
  • Practical experience building applications using LLMs.
  • Hands-on experience with RAG, embeddings, semantic search, and vector databases.
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or similar platforms.
  • Understanding of prompt engineering, model behavior, context management, and LLM evaluation.
  • Experience developing APIs or backend services using FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including Git, REST APIs, testing, debugging, and system design.
  • Familiarity with Docker and modern development practices.
  • Ability to take an AI use case from requirements through development, testing, and deployment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building production AI copilots, chatbots, agents, or intelligent automation systems.
  • Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, or similar AI orchestration frameworks.
  • Experience with Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, FAISS, Chroma, or similar vector databases.
  • Familiarity with agentic workflows, tool/function calling, and multi-step AI systems.
  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning, LoRA, or similar techniques.
  • Experience deploying AI applications in AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Familiarity with model monitoring, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and responsible AI practices.
  • Experience with SQL, CI/CD, Kubernetes, or model-serving infrastructure.

Working Relationships

jobs.excerpt: Enterprise is a national nonprofit that exists to make a good home possible for the millions of families without one.
jobs.description:
Enterprise is a national nonprofit that exists to make a good home possible for the millions of families without one. We support community development organizations on the ground, aggregate and invest capital for impact, advance housing policy at every level of government, and build and manage communities ourselves. Since 1982, we have invested $92.0 billion and created 1.1 million homes across all 50 states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands – all to make home and community places of pride, power and belonging.

Join us at enterprisecommunity.org

Working at Enterprise

At Enterprise, you’ll be part of a diverse, committed team making a difference every day. You will collaborate with some of the smartest minds and biggest hearts in our field. You’ll be empowered to drive systems change and take bold steps to advance racial equity. And you will find a career home where you’re valued and supported in your growth journey.

Enterprise offers career opportunities in our offices across the country with an exceptional benefits package.

Job Description Summary

The Sponsor Support, Lead Analyst serves as a key member of the Sponsor Support Team within Enterprise's Asset Management division and plays a critical role in monitoring and supporting the financial and organizational health of nearly 600 affordable housing organizations nationwide. The position will have direct interaction with external sponsors, investors, lenders, state agencies, and internal stakeholders to help organizations address challenges, strengthen operations, and pursue sustainable growth opportunities.

Using advanced corporate finance analysis, AI-enabled tools, and data analytics, the Lead Analyst evaluates sponsor and guarantor strength, identifies emerging risks, and develops recommendations that support long-term organizational sustainability. The role combines financial analysis, strategic thinking, problem-solving, and stakeholder engagement to help Enterprise proactively manage portfolio risk and strengthen partner capacity.

Working within a fast-paced and highly collaborative environment, the Lead Analyst will assess corporate financial statements, their liquidity, leverage, cash flow, organizational capacity, governance structures, real estate portfolios and operational performance to identify strengths, vulnerabilities, and opportunities for intervention. Findings are synthesized using various AI tools into actionable recommendations, sponsor improvement plans, and executive-level summaries, that support decision-making within Asset Management and other capital business lines.

The Lead Analyst will contribute to the development of innovative tools and processes that improve the consistency, scalability, and effectiveness of sponsor evaluations. This includes leveraging Microsoft Copilot, AI-powered workflows, Excel modeling, dashboards, and data visualization tools to automate processes, increase capacity, identify portfolio and sponsor level trends, and improve risk monitoring capabilities.

Successful candidates will possess a strong foundation in corporate finance, credit analysis, financial modeling, multi-family housing and problem-solving, combined with intellectual curiosity, a customer-service mindset, and enthusiasm for leveraging technology and AI to improve outcomes. As performance and expertise grow, opportunities will expand to include direct management of sponsor relationships, ownership of a portfolio of monitoring-stage sponsors, and leadership of strategic sponsor support initiatives.

Job Description

Responsibilities:

The Sponsor Support, Lead Analyst will:

  • Develop and maintain risk-monitoring dashboards, sponsor health metrics, and portfolio analytics that identify emerging organizational, operational, and financial risks across Enterprise's national sponsor portfolio. Utilize data visualization, trend analysis, and AI-enabled tools to support proactive decision-making.
  • Conduct comprehensive analyses of sponsor, guarantor, and affiliate financial statements, including assessments of liquidity, leverage, cash flow, net asset position, operational sustainability, and organizational capacity.
  • Prepare multi-year financial models, risk assessments, and organizational health evaluations that identify strengths, vulnerabilities, and leading indicators of financial or operational stress.
  • Synthesize financial, operational, governance, and market information into clear executive summaries, risk narratives, and actionable recommendations for Directors, Senior Directors, and other internal stakeholders.
  • Develop preliminary sponsor support strategies, stabilization plans, and capacity-building recommendations designed to improve organizational resilience, strengthen financial sustainability, and mitigate portfolio risk.
  • Identify portfolio-wide patterns from Real Estate Owned (REO) schedules, recurring challenges, and systemic risks and communicate findings to leadership to inform strategic planning, policy development, and resource allocation.
  • Champion the use of Microsoft Copilot, AI-enabled workflows, automation tools, and advanced Excel solutions to improve the efficiency, consistency, and scalability of sponsor assessments, reporting, and risk-monitoring activities.
  • Design, test, and continuously improve analytical tools, prompts, templates, dashboards, and reporting processes that enhance team productivity and improve organizational insights.
  • Coordinate internal communication throughout sponsor assessment and support activities, documenting findings, recommendations, action plans, and key decisions while ensuring consistency and accountability across stakeholder groups.
  • Engage directly with sponsor and guarantor leadership, finance teams, and external stakeholders to gather information, validate findings, and strengthen Enterprise's understanding of organizational opportunities and challenges.
  • Support the development and refinement of sponsor risk-rating methodologies, monitoring frameworks, assessment criteria, and performance indicators used to evaluate organizational health and measure progress over time.
  • Assist in coordinating technical assistance resources, strategic interventions, and cross-functional support efforts that help sponsors address challenges and pursue sustainable growth opportunities.
  • Maintain strict compliance with Enterprise policies and procedures governing the handling, protection, and confidentiality of sensitive financial, operational, and organizational information.
  • Lead the assessment and summation of portfolio and market data from internal and external sources for contractual engagements with public entities and private contractors.
  • Contribute to the ongoing enhancement of Sponsor Support policies, procedures, analytical frameworks, and best practices to improve organizational effectiveness and portfolio outcomes.
  • Address other tasks, as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Data Analytics, or related field.
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of professional experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Corporate finance
    • Commercial banking
    • Credit underwriting
    • Financial planning and analysis (FP&A)
    • Investment analysis
    • Management consulting
    • Risk management
    • Affordable housing finance or real estate finance
  • Advanced proficiency in financial statement analysis, including evaluation of liquidity, cash flow, leverage, profitability, net asset position, and organizational financial health.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform complex financial modeling, trend analysis, scenario planning, and risk assessments using advanced Excel skills and other analytical tools.
  • Experience synthesizing complex financial, operational, and organizational information into concise recommendations for executive-level audiences.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple competing priorities, coordinate complex projects, and consistently meet deadlines in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts to both financial and non-financial audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to build productive relationships with internal stakeholders, external partners, and senior organizational leaders.
  • High degree of intellectual curiosity, professional judgment, integrity, and accountability.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and an investigative mindset with the ability to identify patterns, risks, and opportunities that may not be readily apparent.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience utilizing AI-enabled technologies such as Microsoft Copilot, Power BI, automation platforms, large language models (LLMs), or similar analytical solutions to improve business processes and decision-making.
  • Experience developing dashboards, visualizations, reports, prompts, workflows, or analytical tools that improve operational efficiency and organizational insights.
  • Knowledge of credit analysis methodologies, risk-rating frameworks, portfolio monitoring practices, or organizational health assessments.
  • Experience evaluating nonprofit organizations, affordable housing developers, community development organizations, or mission-driven enterprises.
  • Knowledge of Low-Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC) programs, affordable housing finance, multifamily housing operations, real estate feasibility analysis, or community development finance.
  • Experience working with large datasets to identify emerging trends, portfolio risks, and strategic opportunities.
  • Demonstrated track record of improving processes, implementing innovative solutions, and leveraging technology to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

Characteristics of a Successful Candidate

  • Possesses a "credit mindset" and naturally seeks to understand risk, sustainability, and long-term organizational performance.
  • Combines rigorous analytical thinking with practical business judgment.
  • Enjoys solving ambiguous and complex problems using both quantitative and qualitative information.
  • Takes initiative to improve existing processes, systems, and tools and embraces innovation as a core part of their work.
  • Demonstrates a customer-service orientation and a commitment to helping partners achieve stronger organizational outcomes in line with Enterprise’s mission.
  • Thrives in a collaborative environment while remaining highly self-directed and accountable for results.

Additional Requirements

  • Ability to travel periodically to attend sponsor meetings, project site visits, conferences, and team meetings as needed.
  • Ability to conduct onsite assessments at multifamily housing properties and organizational offices, including occasional exposure to outdoor weather conditions, construction environments, and active project sites.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel independently.

Salary Transparency


You will be joining a team of talented professionals motivated by serving the community and addressing the need for affordable housing.


Enterprise offers a comprehensive total rewards package for you and your family. The pay range for this position is $85,000 – $98,000. The salary range represents the low and high end of what may be paid for this position. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range, and compensation decisions may be influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, qualifications, experience, and location.


Total Rewards at Enterprise


This range is just one component of our total rewards package, which also includes annual performance bonuses and generous paid leave programs.


Our benefits form a major part of the total rewards package. These include dental, health, and vision care plans, as well as family-building benefits such as adoption and surrogacy support. Enterprise supports flexible work arrangements to promote work-life balance and offers health advocacy, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and mental health benefits. We round out our package with financial education, wellness programs, and auto-enrollment in the company’s 401(k) plan with employer matching contributions.


Finally, you will have access to learning and development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement for job-related courses and certifications. Thank you for your interest in joining the Enterprise team and contributing to our mission to serve others.

  • 1:1s and career development running for every engineer.
  • A first version of Pawlicy's AI development policy and best practices in place.

First 12 months

  • A technical roadmap has been executed with security investments sequenced against business priorities.
  • Delivery measurably improved: velocity, quality, and production stability all trend the right way.
  • Carrier and vendor security reviews handled end to end without external help.
  • Engineers are growing against clear development plans, and the team is confident in the technical bar you set.
  • AI-assisted development is ingrained in the culture and adopted with measured results.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years managing engineers and 2+ years in a senior engineering leadership role (Director, or senior-most technical leader), ideally at an early stage startup or fast-moving environment.
  • The stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Node, GraphQL, Postgres, AWS.
  • Proven technical ownership and leadership: you have owned the technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap for a production consumer product, and built or scaled the team that delivered it.
  • Still hands-on: comfortable reviewing PRs, reading code deeply, and jumping into an incident.
  • Experience with application security and third-party compliance: security reviews, vendor questionnaires, and audits.
  • Track record of excellent cross department communication and relationships leading to business success
  • Practical enthusiasm for AI-assisted development.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
  • Preferred: experience in insurance or fintech, or with partner API integrations.
  • Extra points if you love animals and believe pet healthcare is a serious, underserved problem.

How You Work

  • You set your own technical agenda: there is no CTO above you defining priorities, and you generate the roadmap rather than execute one handed down.
  • You fix things nobody asked you to fix: architecture, process, or tooling..
  • You enjoy teaching non-technical colleagues and working with cross functional teams.
  • You push back, disagree, and align without it becoming political.
  • You lead from the front with AI tool adoption and usage and evangelize across the company

AI and the Hiring Process

We embrace AI at Pawlicy and our work still relies on what the humans bring to it.

So please leave the AI out of interviews and case studies. Prep with it all you like, but in the room, we want your thinking, your questions, your judgment. These stages exist so we can get to know you and how you'd work with our team. We're hiring you, not a model and it is you we want to see.

To be concrete: no AI assistants or chatbots on any device during your interviews, and nobody else feeding you answers. Spell-check, autocomplete and notes you wrote yourself are all completely fine.

If it turns out AI was used where we've asked you not to, it may end your candidacy.

If any part of our process is a barrier because of how you read, write or communicate, email before that stage and we'll talk through the options. The skills we're assessing stay the same; what changes is the format. Asking has no bearing on how we assess you.

Benefits

  • Base salary range: $215,000 - $240,000
  • Startup equity grant.
  • Top-tier medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) employer contributions; flexible vacation.
  • Remote-first within the United States.

Career Path

This role is scoped as Director of Engineering and is the senior-most technical seat at the company, with a path to VP of Engineering as the team grows from ~20 today to 25-30 in 2027. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in NYC, Pawlicy Advisor is a licensed insurance agency and the leading pet insurance marketplace in the US.

If you want real technical ownership, thrive in a fast paced environment, and care about developing engineers, Pawlicy would like to talk. Learn more at

Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know.

WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE

Why Syneos Health

Job Responsibilities

Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
  • Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete. Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines. Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements.
  • May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
  • For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.

  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes; completes assigned training as required. For Real World Late Phase, the CRA II will use the business card title of Site Management Associate II. Additional responsibilities include:Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close-out. Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs.Chart abstraction activities and data collection
    Collaboration with Sponsor affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff. The SMA II may be requested to train junior staff. Identify and communicate out of scope activities to Lead CRA/Project Manager. Qualifications:

Further, a Site may ask you for additional information beyond that which Syneos Health has in its possession. You are required to comply with any such Site requests as a condition of your employment with Syneos Health. Please note that failure to provide requested information may result in a Site barring you from entry, which could put your ongoing employment at risk.

We are always excited to connect with great talent. This posting is intended for a [possible] upcoming opportunity rather than a live role. By expressing your interest, you'll be added to our talent pipeline and considered should this role become available.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

jobs.description:
Join Kainos and Shape the Future

At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.

We believe in a people-first culture, where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.

Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.

As a Workday FSI Financials Solution Architect at Kainos, you will own the overall finance solution design for financial services and insurance customers. You will translate finance outcomes into decisions about processes, accounting, data and systems, and guide teams through delivery. Alongside customer engagements, you will shape opportunities and strengthen our sector capability through reference designs, reusable assets, and coaching.


We value depth in a relevant subsector and the judgement to draw on specialists.


Key responsibilities


  • Lead discovery and Phase 0 engagements, producing a target architecture, key design decisions, delivery options and a phased roadmap. Make assumptions, dependencies, trade-offs and readiness gaps clear to customer sponsors.
  • Own the end-to-end Financials design, with depth in record to report, the Foundation Data Model (FDM), chart of accounts, work tags, multi-entity and multi-currency accounting, intercompany and reporting.
  • Define how Workday Financials, Prism Analytics and Accounting Center fit alongside operational platforms, specialist accounting engines and reporting tools. Allocate responsibility for accounting generation, data enrichment, reconciliation, and settlement explicitly.
  • Translate sector requirements into practical design choices. For insurance, address premium and claim flows, commissions, reinsurance balances and reporting dimensions with the relevant business and accounting specialists.
  • Establish design governance across functional, data, integration, reporting and security teams. Resolve cross-workstream decisions and ensure designs address control evidence, access, traceability, transaction volumes and operational support.
  • Guide delivery from design through testing, cutover and stabilisation. Review critical configurations and prototypes, challenge unresolved assumptions, and assure reconciliations and readiness evidence before recommending design acceptance.
  • Support the FSI go-to-market and account teams with discovery, demonstrations, proposals and estimates. Explain solution value and delivery risks and agree achievable scope and assumptions with delivery leaders.
  • Develop sector reference architectures, decision guides and recipe cards. Set quality standards for model-tenant scenarios and accelerators, documenting validation, applicability and limitations before reuse.
  • Coach lead consultants and architects, review solution quality and feed delivery lessons into the practice. Assess relevant Workday releases and automation opportunities with the appropriate specialists.

Working relationships and accountability


You will partner with the FSI sector lead, Financials capability and delivery leaders, account teams and customer finance leadership. You own solution coherence on assigned engagements; project managers own the delivery plan and budget, while account leads own commercial relationships. Customer approvals follow the agreed design governance. Time for sector assets and presales will be planned alongside delivery commitments.


Experience and capabilities


We are looking for a finance-led architect who can explain why a design fits the customer, make sound decisions under uncertainty, and remain close enough to the platform to challenge implementation choices.


Essential requirements

  • Substantial Workday Financials experience across multiple deployments, including ownership of cross-functional solution design and experience through go-live or major post-deployment change or significant depth in experience on client-side in a relevant sector.
  • Deep practical knowledge of FDM, financial accounting and reporting, with sufficient breadth across procure to pay, customer to cash, banking and settlement, and assets to manage design dependencies.
  • Direct finance transformation or delivery experience in at least one FSI subsector. Ability to explain how its business model, accounting flows and control requirements change a Workday design.
  • Strong accounting fundamentals, including general ledger and subledger relationships, reconciliations, close and consolidation requirements, and multi-entity or multi-currency reporting.
  • Ability to assess when Prism Analytics and Accounting Center are appropriate, distinguish data preparation from accounting rule execution, and define requirements with specialist delivery teams.
  • Experience assessing integration, migration, security and reporting dependencies, including source data quality, audit trails, reconciliation controls, and the granularity needed for finance reporting.
  • Evidence of leading senior customer workshops, resolving competing requirements, documenting decisions, estimating work, and explaining commercial consequences clearly.
  • Experience coaching consultants and reviewing delivery quality. Relevant current or previous Workday Financials certification, with commitment to maintain or renew the certifications required for the role.

Desirable experience


  • Insurance depth in one or more general insurance, life and pensions, health insurance, broking or reinsurance; understanding of how applicable accounting and regulatory reporting requirements affect finance data.
  • Hands-on delivery experience or certification in Workday Prism Analytics or Accounting Center, including operational data ingestion, accounting rules and reconciliation.
  • A recognised accountancy qualification such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA or CPA, or equivalent professional experience; exposure to Adaptive Planning, Workday Extend or finance automation.
  • Experience building reusable sector assets, leading finance architecture across jurisdictions or supporting customer finance teams after deployment.

Embracing our differences  

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

Our friendly talent acquisition team is here to support you every step of the way, so if you require any accommodations or adjustments, we encourage you to reach out.

We understand that everyone's journey is different, and by having a private conversation we can ensure that our recruitment process is tailored to your needs.

jobs.description:
Our Story
Imagine being part of a team that’s not just shaping the future but actively driving it. At Davies North America, we’re at the forefront of innovation and excellence, blending cutting-edge technology with top-tier professional services. As a vital part of the global Davies Group, we help businesses navigate risk, optimize operations, and spearhead transformation in the insurance and regulated sectors.

Davies North America is looking for a candidate responsible for managing and resolving high-severity, complex insurance claims with a strong emphasis on coverage analysis, policy interpretation, and strategic claim resolution. The position focuses on Medical Malpractice and Healthcare Professional Liability claims, particularly within nursing homes, assisted living facilities, and allied healthcare programs, many of which are written as package policies that include both professional liability and general liability coverages.
This role serves as a key subject matter expert for healthcare liability coverage issues, advising internal teams and carriers on complex claims involving clinical care, facility operations, and regulatory exposures.

The successful candidate will manage a portfolio of complex healthcare liability claims that may involve seven-figure exposures, catastrophic injuries, wrongful death, complex causation issues, expert disputes, excess implications, and significant mediation or settlement activity. This role requires strong technical claims expertise, sound litigation judgment, coverage analysis capability, and the ability to partner effectively with carriers, insureds, defense counsel, coverage counsel, medical experts, and internal stakeholders.

This position is well-suited for either an attorney with healthcare liability, medical malpractice, insurance coverage, and litigation experience, or a senior complex claims professional with demonstrated experience managing high-exposure healthcare liability claims through investigation, litigation, mediation, settlement, and trial preparation.

Key Responsibilities

Complex Healthcare Liability Claims Management

  • Independently manage a portfolio of high-severity healthcare professional liability claims from assignment through resolution.
  • Handle matters involving significant financial exposure, including claims with seven-figure reserves, demands, settlements, or potential judgments.
  • Evaluate liability, damages, causation, standard of care, medical documentation, venue risk, comparative fault, and potential excess exposure.
  • Analyze medical records, expert reports, deposition testimony, defense assessments, and damages evaluations.
  • Develop and execute claim resolution strategies based on investigation, legal exposure, coverage obligations, litigation posture, and business objectives.
  • Provide clear, independent evaluations and recommendations to carriers and internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate and thorough documentation of claim strategy, liability evaluation, damages analysis, reserves, coverage issues, and resolution activity.

Litigation Management & Strategy

  • Oversee complex litigated healthcare liability claims, including medical malpractice, hospital liability, physician liability, nursing liability, long-term care, and other healthcare-related professional liability matters.
  • Direct and partner with defense counsel on litigation strategy, discovery, expert retention, dispositive motions, mediation preparation, and trial planning.
  • Review and analyze pleadings, discovery responses, medical records, deposition summaries, expert reports, life care plans, economic loss evaluations, mediation briefs, and trial assessments.
  • Establish litigation plans, budgets, and key milestones in partnership with counsel and carriers.
  • Attend and actively participate in mediations, settlement conferences, strategy meetings, and significant litigation events.
  • Provide strategic recommendations regarding settlement, continued defense, alternative dispute resolution, or trial preparation.

Coverage Analysis & Policy Interpretation

  • Review and interpret healthcare professional liability policies, endorsements, exclusions, conditions, claims-made provisions, consent-to-settle provisions, and applicable statutes.
  • Analyze coverage issues and provide recommendations regarding defense obligations, indemnity exposure, reservation of rights, and potential coverage defenses.
  • Draft, review, or provide input on reservation of rights letters, coverage position letters, disclaimers, and denial letters, as appropriate.
  • Partner with coverage counsel, in-house legal teams, carriers, and internal stakeholders on complex coverage matters.
  • Identify and escalate coverage disputes, bad faith concerns, excess exposure, regulatory issues, and other high-risk claim developments.

Settlement, Negotiation & Resolution

  • Evaluate settlement demands and develop negotiation strategies based on liability, damages, standard of care, causation, venue, coverage, and verdict exposure.
  • Negotiate settlements within authority and make recommendations for matters requiring additional approval.
  • Manage reserves in accordance with carrier guidelines and claim exposure.
  • Participate in mediations and settlement conferences involving high-value healthcare liability disputes.
  • Balance legal risk, financial exposure, policy obligations, and business objectives when recommending claim resolution.

Regulatory Compliance & Quality

  • Ensure claims are handled in accordance with applicable Department of Insurance regulations, statutory requirements, carrier guidelines, and internal protocols.
  • Maintain strong file documentation supporting liability analysis, damages evaluation, coverage positions, reserves, settlement strategy, and litigation direction.
  • Monitor claims for compliance risks, including timeliness, communication standards, fair claims handling practices, and escalation requirements.
  • Support audit readiness and quality claim handling expectations across assigned matters.

Skills, knowledge & expertise

Required (one of the following)
  • Juris Doctor (JD) with active bar membership in good standing, or
  • 7–10+ years of senior-level experience handling medical malpractice, healthcare liability, or complex professional liability claims.
  • Demonstrated experience handling claims with significant financial exposure, including seven-figure settlements, reserves, demands, or potential judgments.
  • Strong litigation management experience, including directing outside counsel and developing litigation strategy.
  • Experience evaluating liability, medical causation, damages, coverage, reserves, settlement value, and trial risk.
  • Demonstrated expertise in insurance coverage analysis and policy interpretation.
  • Experience issuing, drafting, reviewing, or advising on coverage positions, including reservation of rights letters, disclaimers, or denial letters.
  • Active adjuster licenses in applicable jurisdictions, or ability to obtain additional licenses as required.
  • Strong negotiation, analytical, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple high-severity, complex claims in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Experience

  • Healthcare professional liability, medical malpractice, hospital liability, physician liability, nursing liability, allied health, or long-term care claims experience.
  • Experience working in a Major Case Unit, Complex Claims Unit, Specialty Claims Unit, or Excess Claims environment.
  • Prior experience as Claims Counsel, Coverage Counsel, National General Adjuster, Executive General Adjuster, Senior Claims Examiner, Complex Claims Specialist, or Senior Complex Claims Consultant.
  • Experience managing matters through mediation, settlement conference, arbitration, trial preparation, or trial monitoring.
  • Strong understanding of bad faith risk, excess exposure, coverage litigation, healthcare liability evaluation, and medical damages analysis.

Equal Employment Opportunity & Legal Notices

  • A 401(k) plan with employer matching

Davies is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that embraces a wide range of perspectives and experiences. We believe that diversity of thought is essential for innovation and creativity, and we actively promote an environment where all voices are valued and heard.

jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

jobs.excerpt: Department: Client Success Reports to: Head of Client Success Job title: Senior CSM / Account Manager Salary: £55,000-£60,000 base; OTE up to £80,000 Employment Type: Full-time Location: Remote, UK-based, with monthly London meetups About GocertifyGocertify is a bootstrapped UK tech start-up helping brands run smarter, more targeted reward campaigns.
jobs.description:
Department: Client Success

Reports to: Head of Client Success

Job title: Senior CSM / Account Manager

Salary: £55,000-£60,000 base; OTE up to £80,000

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: Remote, UK-based, with monthly London meetups

About Gocertify

Gocertify is a bootstrapped UK tech start-up helping brands run smarter, more targeted reward campaigns.

We verify eligible audiences such as students, key workers and seniors, so brands can move away from broad discounting, protect brand value and offer the right rewards to the right customers.

We are trusted by 500+ brands, including Samsung, Sainsbury's and FARFETCH. We work with 2m+ shoppers a year, drive £125m+ in retail sales, and have grown profitably and bootstrapped since 2020. In 2025 we were named in the Deloitte EMEA Technology Fast 500, the ranking of the fastest-growing technology companies across Europe, the Middle East and Africa.

We are a team of around 20 people, working remotely with monthly meetups in London. We care about staying close to our customers, understanding their goals, and helping brands run targeted discounts that deliver real value.

Why this role exists

Our Client Success team works with a strong portfolio of major e-commerce brands, many of which already see real value in Gocertify. There's also a lot of growth in that book still to unlock - well-known brands doing a fraction of what they could, where the opportunity is there for someone to go and find it.

We are hiring a Senior CSM / Account Manager to help unlock that growth. You will inherit a focused book of high-value and high-potential brand accounts. Some are already commercially significant today, while others have much more value to unlock.

This is a commercial role first. You'll protect what's already working while finding the real growth in the book - spotting where an account could be doing more, then doing the work to get it there, whether that's a stronger campaign, a new market, or bringing the right people on board.

We do not currently separate Account Management from Client Success, so this role sits at the intersection of both. You will fully own the client relationship while driving the commercial strategy needed to turn this book of business into meaningful growth.

Role and scope

As a Senior CSM / Account Manager, you will own a portfolio of brand accounts and be accountable for driving retention, adoption and revenue growth across them.

You will work closely with the Head of Client Success to identify the accounts with the most potential, build structured account plans, run commercial client conversations, and make sure that growth opportunities are identified and progressed.

You will need to combine strong relationship management with strategic thinking. That means understanding what marketing, ecommerce, CRM, loyalty and partnership teams are trying to achieve, then shaping practical campaign recommendations and commercial opportunities around those goals.

You will be expected to hit the ground running, quickly understand where the biggest opportunities are, and build momentum with clients who have the potential to grow with Gocertify.

What you will focus on

Own and grow your portfolio

You will work on

  • Prioritising your time across a broad portfolio based on value, risk and opportunity.
  • Building account plans that connect client goals to practical revenue opportunities.
  • Running structured QBRs that are commercially focused.
  • Identifying and progressing expansion, upsell and cross-sell opportunities across both established and high-potential accounts.
  • Owning a growth and retention target across your book, and reporting against it.
  • Keeping CRM records, next steps and opportunities accurate and up to date.

Own renewals and reduce churn

You will work on

  • Managing renewals across your portfolio and identifying risks early.
  • Using client feedback, usage data and commercial judgement to understand account health.
  • Holding commercial conversations around value, performance, contract terms and next steps.
  • Working with internal teams to resolve blockers that may affect retention.
  • Building practical plans to reduce churn and improve client outcomes.

Help clients get more from Gocertify

You will work on

  • Helping clients connect their goals to practical campaign recommendations.
  • Supporting clients to launch, improve or expand targeted discount campaigns.
  • Identifying where adoption is low and building practical plans to address it.
  • Running early check-ins after launch to make sure clients are set up for success.
  • Spotting friction in the client experience and helping remove it.

Bring insight back into the business

You will work on

  • Sharing client feedback with Sales, Product and Partnerships.
  • Flagging common challenges, requests and growth blockers.
  • Helping the team understand which client segments, use cases or campaigns are creating the most value.
  • Contributing ideas that improve our product, positioning and account management approach.
  • Helping build the processes and playbooks that make Client Success more consistent as we grow.

Requirements

  • Established experience in a commercially accountable Client Success, Account Management or equivalent role, ideally in SaaS or subscription
  • Experience in, or a strong working understanding of, the retail, e-commerce or affiliate/partnerships landscape.
  • A track record of carrying a commercial target and hitting it (tell us your targets in your CV and how you performed, year on year)
  • Experience owning renewals and the commercial conversations around them - pricing, contract terms, holding value under pushback
  • Managed a broad, mixed book of accounts with real commercial value - breadth across varying sizes matters more than depth on a few, but not high volumes of tiny deals
  • A data-informed approach to spotting client risks and opportunities
  • Strong prioritisation - you can triage a large account list and focus on where the value is
  • Confidence with CRM data and disciplined pipeline tracking
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with clients and internally
  • A bias towards action and ownership - you move things forward without being chased
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving, lightly structured environment - as happy building a process that doesn't exist yet as following one that does

Who will thrive in this role

This role is a strong fit for someone who can combine deep client understanding, strong commercial execution and a modern way of working.

  • Strong discovery and client understanding: You’re excellent at understanding what a retailer is trying to achieve, both at a business and individual stakeholder level. You ask good questions, get beneath surface-level requests and identify where Gocertify can create the most value.
  • Strategic solution-selling: You can turn client objectives into a clear recommendation. That means connecting Gocertify’s features to the client’s goals, then telling a compelling story about why that solution makes sense. You’re comfortable using data, ROI forecasts and persuasive commercial thinking to convince clients why they should care.
  • A modern, forward-thinking operator: You are excited by smarter ways of working. We use data, internal systems, automation and increasingly AI-enabled workflows to understand clients, spot opportunities and manage accounts more effectively. You don't need to be an AI expert, but you do need to be curious and keen to use it - it's core to how we work here.

Work environment and tools

  • Fully remote, UK-based, with monthly in-person meetings in London.
  • Core working hours: 10am-4pm UK time, with flexible remote work.
  • Some travel to client meetings and industry events.
  • Tools include; Airtable, , Front, Metabase (Analysing client performance) as well as our Client Hub (our custom-built app to manage clients)

Benefits

  • Salary: £55,000 - £60,000; OTE up to £80,000
  • 25 days annual leave + UK bank holidays
  • Private health insurance with AVIVA, including optical and dental cashback and the option to self-fund partners/dependents
  • EMI share options
  • Work-from-home budget
  • Flexible remote work in many countries around our core hours, 10am-4pm UK
  • Unlimited access to coworking spaces in 48+ countries through Hubble
  • Access to incredible Gocertify offers

jobs.description:
Job Family

Regional / Field Sales

About Us

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests.

Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

   

Who We Are

 

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group servingapproximately 23.9 million customersworldwide.* For more information, visit transamerica.com. 

Job Description Summary

As a member of Transamerica Retirement Solutions, the Regional Vice President is responsible for the sale of qualified retirement plans to small and mid-sized markets through all channels of financial intermediaries including banks, wire houses, regional broker dealers, employee benefit firms, etc. Works within an assigned territory to meet company objectives as a market leader.

Job Description

Responsibilities

  • Prospect for new clients within and assigned territory to achieve sales goals.
  • Develop a network of advisors, consultants, and other third party intermediaries focused on the retirement industry.
  • Develop plan sponsor relationships through direct meetings with key contacts.
  • Participate in proactive marketing campaigns.
  • Manage a territory of target prospects.

Qualifications

  • Three years of sales experience in the retirement plan industry
  • FINRA Series 6 & 63
  • Life & Health License
  • In-depth understanding of the retirement market and ERISA
  • Self-motivated with an instinctive sales acumen to organize thoughts and actions to meet sales goals
  • Outstanding interpersonal, public speaking and presentation skills
  • Ability to manage resources and to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment
  • Technical skills to use state-of-the-art tools

Preferred Qualifications

  • Existing broker relationships within the assigned territory

  • Remote (Field/Travel) Environment
  • Extensive Travel >50%

The range may vary above and below the stated amounts, as permitted by Colorado Equal Pay Transparency Rule 4.1.2.

This position is also typically eligible for Annual Bonus based on the Company Bonus Plan/Individual Performance and is at Company Discretion.


Commissions

This position may be eligible to earn commissions based on applicable sales incentive plan(s). All details pertaining to the calculation and payment of those commissions are available in the individual provisions of the sales incentive plan that applies.

This job description is not a contract of employment nor for any specific job responsibilities. The Company may change, add to, remove, or revoke the terms of this job description at its discretion. Managers may assign other duties and responsibilities as needed. In the event an employee or applicant requests or requires an accommodation to perform job functions, the applicable HR Business Partner should be contacted to evaluate the accommodation request.

What We Offer

For eligible employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support both the personal and financial well-being of our employees.

  • Pension Plan

  • 401k Match

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • Tuition Reimbursement

  • Disability Insurance

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental Insurance

  • Vision Insurance

  • Employee Discounts

  • Career Training & Development Opportunities

Health and Work/Life Balance Benefits

  • Paid Time Off starting at 160 hours annually for employees in their first year of service.

  • Ten (10) paid holidays per year (typically mirroring the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) holidays).

  • Be Well Company holistic wellness program, which includes Wellness Coaching and Reward Dollars

  • Parental Leave – fifteen (15) days of paid parental leave per calendar year to eligible employees with at least one year of service at the time of birth, placement of an adopted child, or placement of a foster care child.

  • Adoption Assistance

  • PTO for Volunteer Hours

  • Employee Resource Groups

  • Inclusion and Diversity Programs

Inclusion & Diversity 

 

We believe our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates a work environment filled with exceptional individuals. We’re thrilled to have been recognized for our efforts through the Human Rights Campaign Corporate Equality Index, Dave Thomas Adoption Friendly Advocate, and several Seramount lists, including the Inclusion Index, 100 Best Companies for Working Parents, Best Companies for Dads, and Top 75 Companies for Executive Women.

 

To foster a culture of inclusivity throughout our workforce, workplace, and marketplace, Transamerica offers a wide range of diversity and inclusion programs. This includes our company-sponsored, employee-driven Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), which are formed around a shared interest or a common characteristic of diversity. ERGs are open to all employees. They provide a supportive environment to help us better appreciate our similarities and differences and understand how they benefit us all.

  

Giving Back 

 

We believe our responsibilities extend beyond our corporate walls. That's why we created the Aegon Transamerica Foundation in 1994. Through a mix of financial grants and the volunteer efforts of our employees, the foundation supports nonprofit organizations focused on the things that matter most to our people in the communities where we live and work.   

 

Transamerica’s Parent Company 

Aegon acquired the Transamerica business in 1999. Since its start in 1844, Aegon has grown into an international company serving more than 23.9 million people across the globe.* It offers investment, protection, and retirement solutions, always with a clear purpose: Helping people live their best lives. jobs.excerpt: About VantumVantum helps fractional operators win new clients while delivering for the clients they already have.
jobs.description:
About Vantum

Vantum helps fractional operators win new clients while delivering for the clients they already have. When you are managing several engagements, client work can consume the week and leave little time to find the next one.

The product is a web app for planning, tasks, calendar, goals, and Ask Vantum, an AI chat that helps an operator decide what to do next.

We are a team of five, working toward product-market fit. We are looking for a QA tester to use the live product the way a customer would, and to write bugs we can reproduce.

You will work directly with the founders.

What you will own

Your job is to find what is broken, write it so someone else can reproduce it, and check that the fix actually holds.

  • Walk the main flows. Sign-in, home, plan, tasks, calendar, goals, notes, and Ask Vantum.

  • Write each bug so it can be reproduced. Steps, what you expected, and what actually happened. Include the page, the account state, and a screenshot when it helps.

  • Recheck fixes. A bug is not done because someone said it was fixed. Confirm the original steps, and check that a nearby flow did not break.

  • Notice gaps. If a button does nothing, a save does not stick, or the page says one thing and the data shows another, file it.

  • Ask when a behavior might be intentional. Do not guess, and do not redesign the product.

You are not building features, and you are not writing production code. Clear written English is the job.

What we are looking for

You notice when software is wrong, and you can describe it without a developer sitting next to you.

You should be able to:

  • Follow a flow from start to finish. Include empty states, errors, and the second time through.

  • Write a bug report a stranger can follow. Steps, expected result, actual result.

  • Tell a display problem from a data problem. The page looks saved, but a refresh brings the old value back.

  • Show the evidence. Use a browser, screenshots, and a short screen recording when steps are hard to write.

  • Communicate clearly in written English. We read your reports every day.

  • Take ownership. Retest what you filed, and say when you cannot reproduce it.

Prior QA employment is useful. It is not required. Testing your own projects, a client product, or a careful write-up of bugs in software you use counts.

We do not need test automation, a computer science degree, or experience with our stack.

Why join

You will see real product decisions, talk to the founders, and watch your reports turn into fixes.

The work is part-time and remote. You set a steady weekly rhythm with us, and you tell us what you found in writing.

Compensation and working arrangements

  • $500 to $1,000 USD per month, depending on hours and how clearly you report what you find.

  • Part-time, remote.

  • At least three hours of weekday overlap with Bangkok (GMT+7), so we can review bugs the same day.

  • Hours are agreed on the call. This is not a full-time engineering role.

How we hire

1. Written application. We read how you describe a bug.

2. Screening call. We talk through a product you tested and a bug you filed.

3. A short look at the live app. You walk one flow and write up what you find.

Apply

Describe one bug you found that was easy to miss. Include the steps, what you expected, and what actually happened.

Tell us your timezone, your weekday overlap with Bangkok, when you can start, how many hours a week you can give, and your expected monthly pay.
